scripts.translation: 光是想到他们，我就脊背发凉！你能去东边那座桥尽头看看住着什么种族吗？

scripts.text: I want to know if they're friendly or hostile to us.
scripts.translation: 我想知道他们对我们是友善还是敌对。

scripts.text: Welcome back. Did you find out about them?
scripts.translation: 欢迎回来。查明他们的情况了吗？

scripts.text: The owner of the tricorn hat
scripts.translation: 这顶三角帽的主人是一种叫作.

scripts.text: {0}...? I don't think that was the name...
The size of Tatacho is about...
Tatachos are usually sitting on the ground, but they roll around if their body temperature goes down too low because of the cold weather.
scripts.translation: 塔塔乔通常坐在地上，但天气太冷、体温过低时，它们就会在地上打滚。

scripts.text: About that tricorn hat, I've concluded, based on my opinion about their appearance and their movement patterns, that it is not active or productive at all:
scripts.translation: 关于这顶三角帽，根据它们的外形和行动方式，我得出结论：它们根本没有能力制作这顶帽子。

scripts.text: They are not intelligent enough to produce a sophisticated hat like that.
scripts.translation: 它们的智力不足以制作如此精致的帽子。

scripts.text: You now sound like me... I guess I've stained you with my academic manner of speech. Oh, I'm not saying it is bad, but...
scripts.translation: ...你现在说话都像我了......看来我把这股学究腔传染给你了。哦，我不是说这样不好，只是......

scripts.text: Anyways, according to your conclusion, the hat must have been given to them by someone else, or they could have picked it up after another creature dropped it.
scripts.translation: 总之，根据你的结论，这顶帽子一定是别人送给它们的，或者是它们捡到了其他生物掉落的帽子。

scripts.text: Thank you for such valuable information.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你提供这么宝贵的信息。

scripts.text: It's enough to write a report.
scripts.translation: 这些足够写一份报告了。

scripts.text: I should make a brief report and then submit it to management. Hopefully, a new monster scholar after me will do a better job in actually studying them.
scripts.translation: 我该写一份简短的报告交给管理层。希望接替我的怪物学者能真正把它们研究透彻。

scripts.text: There are many cold places in my country, the Schwarzwald Republic, but none are as cold as this place. This weather is freezing my senses, dulling my passion toward my studies.
scripts.translation: 我的祖国修瓦尔兹巴鲁德共和国有很多寒冷的地方，但没有一处像这里这么冷。寒冷的天气冻僵了我的感官，也消磨了我研究的热情。

scripts.text: I shall go back home faster than anyone else in this camp. I'm tired of this world...
scripts.translation: 我会比营地里其他人更早回家。我受够这个世界了......

scripts.text: ...{0}, I thank you so much for helping me despite my self-centered behavior.
scripts.translation: .{0}.....，尽管我这么自私，你还是愿意帮我，真的非常感谢。

scripts.text: I'll repay your favor as soon as I go back home.
scripts.translation: 等我回家后一定会报答你。

scripts.text: I hope you'll make yourself known in Ash Vacuum with your great accomplishments.
scripts.translation: 希望你能在阿什真空建功立业，扬名四方。

scripts.text: Can you please go check what kind of races reside at the end of the land over the rightward bridge? I want to know if they're friendly or hostile to us.
scripts.translation: 你能去东边那座桥尽头看看住着什么种族吗？我想知道他们对我们是友善还是敌对。

scripts.text: Mr. Rumis! Take a look at this!
I'm extremely frustrated. I feel helpless because I wasn't able to go back home last time...
scripts.translation: 我很沮丧，上次没能回家让我觉得很无助......

scripts.text: I've found this horn from a monster in the Splendide Area.
scripts.translation: 我在辉煌领域从一只魔物身上找到这只角。

scripts.text: That monster was very mysterious, and its body was covered with grass.
scripts.translation: 那只魔物非常神秘，身上覆盖着草。

scripts.text: ...I know you're excited, but that doesn't sound interesting to me. Sorry.
scripts.translation: ......我知道你很兴奋，但这听起来没什么特别的。抱歉。

scripts.text: Let me take a look at the horn.
...This horn looks very similar to that of the Hillsrions that inhabit the Manuk area.
scripts.translation: ......这只角很像栖息在马努克地区的丘陵狮的角。
我想知道它们是否有亲缘关系，

scripts.text: or if this is an evolved Hillsrion.
scripts.translation: 或者这是不是一种进化后的丘陵狮。

scripts.text: Ah, and there's the possibility of mutation caused by the environment.
scripts.translation: 啊，还有可能是由环境引起的变异。

scripts.text: Are you saying the monster has been mutated by environmental causes?
scripts.translation: 你是说这种魔物受环境影响发生了变异吗？

scripts.text: Well, that's possible, isn't it? Haha!
scripts.translation: 嗯，这也有可能，不是吗？哈哈！

scripts.text: - You told Rumis what you've heard from Botanist Terris: some plants are already showing signs of mutation. -
scripts.translation: - 你把从植物学家泰瑞斯那里听到的消息告诉了鲁米斯：有些植物已经出现变异迹象。 -

scripts.text: If such a device really exists, it's possible to cause abnormal growth to monsters by injecting them with special energy.
scripts.translation: 如果这种装置真的存在，那么通过注入特殊能量，确实可能导致魔物异常生长。

scripts.text: By the way, who came up with the idea of that device?
scripts.translation: 对了，那个装置是谁想出来的？

scripts.text: Mutants caused by a man-made device... Then there might be more mutated creatures in addition to Tendrillion.
scripts.translation: 人为装置造成的变异......那么除了三角兽之外，可能还有更多变异生物。

scripts.text: But... I want to go back home... It's no use studying them if the management will order me to return.
scripts.translation: 可是......我想回家......如果管理层会命令我回去，那继续研究也没意义。

scripts.text: I guess my brother really likes this place.
scripts.translation: 看来我哥哥真的很喜欢这里。

scripts.text: I mean, he's working so hard to figure things out...
scripts.translation: 我是说，他为了弄清楚这里的一切，工作得非常努力......

scripts.text: Well, not everyone can live the same life.
scripts.translation: 唉，不是每个人都能过一样的生活。

scripts.text: I just hope he'll have a better understanding about me...
scripts.translation: 我只希望他能更理解我......

scripts.text: I don't know if people in Midgard will welcome me back.
scripts.translation: 我不知道米德加尔特的人是否会欢迎我回去。

scripts.text: Thanks to you, I at least have a few interesting stories to tell them.
scripts.translation: 多亏了你，我至少有几个有趣的故事可以讲给他们听。

scripts.text: If you're going to stick around here longer, please help my brother with his study.
scripts.translation: 如果你还会在这里待一阵子，请帮我哥哥做研究。

scripts.text: I might want to come back later once this area is fully explored and developed...
scripts.translation: 等这个区域彻底探索、开发完毕后，我或许会再回来......

scripts.text: - With a shy smile on the face, Rumis Block asked you to shake hands, and then turned around hurriedly. -
scripts.translation: - 鲁米斯·布洛克羞涩地笑了笑，伸手与你握手，随后匆匆转身离开。 -

scripts.text: - You really hope that Rumis will be able to go back home. -
scripts.translation: - 你真的希望鲁米斯能回家。 -

scripts.text: ...I submitted the report to the management, but they have not yet ordered me to go back home...
scripts.translation: ......我已经向管理层提交了报告，但他们还没下令让我回家......

scripts.text: ...*Sigh* I guess nothing's as easy as I'd hoped.
scripts.translation: ......*叹气*看来事情没我想得那么顺利。
- 鲁米斯看起来焦虑不安，心神恍惚。 -

scripts.text: When can I go back to Midgard...? *Sigh*
scripts.translation: 我什么时候才能回米德加尔特......？*叹气*

scripts.text: Everything about this world excites me.
scripts.translation: 这个世界的一切都让我兴奋。

scripts.text: Everything about this world excites me.
scripts.translation: 这个世界的每一样东西都让我兴奋。

scripts.text: Everything about this world excites me.
scripts.translation: 这个世界的每一样东西都让我兴奋。
你的兴奋劲儿让我有些烦躁。

scripts.text: Oh, come on! I'm just being happy.
scripts.translation: 别这样嘛！我只是太高兴了。

scripts.text: By the way, is there anything I can help you with?
scripts.translation: 对了，有什么我能帮你的吗？

scripts.text: I agree. There's so much to see around here!
scripts.translation: 我同意。这里有很多值得看的东西！

scripts.text: Nice to meet you, my friend.
scripts.translation: 很高兴认识你，我的朋友。

scripts.text: So, is there anything I can help you with?
scripts.translation: 那么，有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Your brother wanted me to send this to you. Maybe it'll help with your study.
scripts.translation: 你哥哥让我把这个带给你。也许对你的研究有帮助。

scripts.text: - You have given the Nepenthes Specimen to the botanist. -
scripts.translation: - 你把猪笼草标本交给了植物学家。 -

scripts.text: ...Well, I've got a ton of samples of this specimen. Sorry.
scripts.translation: ......好吧，我有一大堆这种标本。抱歉。

scripts.text: - He points at a pile of specimens in the tent. -
scripts.translation: - 他指向帐篷里的一堆标本。 -

scripts.text: Still, I'm impressed. I always thought my brother could never do anything on his own. But look, he was able to collect a Nepenthes specimen.
scripts.translation: 不过，我还是很佩服。我一直以为我哥哥什么都做不成。可你看，他居然采集到了猪笼草标本。

scripts.text: Then again, I had this strong feeling that someone has helped him.
scripts.translation: 不过，我总觉得有人帮了他。

scripts.text: That someone was probably you, right?~
I'm just happy that he cares about me...
scripts.translation: 我只是很高兴他关心我......

scripts.text: Can't you just thank him for trying to help you?
scripts.translation: 难道不能感谢他愿意帮你吗？

scripts.text: Well, you must forget that he and I are twins.
scripts.translation: 嗯，你别忘了我和他是双胞胎。

scripts.text: We are spiritually connected to each other.
scripts.translation: 我们之间有种心灵感应。

scripts.text: Usually twins share the same feelings and ideas, I can see what he does or thinks if I try hard.
scripts.translation: 双胞胎通常会有相同的感受和想法。只要我集中精神，就能看到他在做什么、想什么。

scripts.text: Let me see what Rumis is doing right now... Oh, he's picking his nose with his left hand and eating a slice of bread with his right.
scripts.translation: 让我看看鲁米斯现在在做什么......哦，他左手在挖鼻孔，右手还拿着面包吃。

scripts.text: Go check Rumis if it's true.
scripts.translation: 去检查鲁米斯是否属实

scripts.text: Let me guess, you want to go check Rumis to see if I'm telling the truth. Am I wrong?
scripts.translation: 让我猜猜，你想去看看鲁米斯，验证我说的是不是真的，对吧？

scripts.text: Hahahaha! Sorry, but I lied. I mean, remote vision? Because we're twins?
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈！抱歉，我骗你的。双胞胎还能远程视物？

scripts.text: You please me, just like the new creatures blooming on the World Tree.~
scripts.translation: 你让我很开心，就像世界树上绽放的新奇生命一样。～

scripts.text: won't you cut me some slack? I was just joking to melt the ice.
scripts.translation: 别跟我计较嘛。我只是开个玩笑缓和气氛。

scripts.text: This world is too barren and tough to live without good humor and jokes, you know?
scripts.translation: 这个世界太荒凉、太艰难了，不开点玩笑怎么活下去？

scripts.text: Anyways, as I said, I've got a lot of Nepenthes specimens.
scripts.translation: 总之，正如我说的，我已经有很多猪笼草标本了。

scripts.text: But I'll gratefully take this pretentious gift of his.
scripts.translation: 不过，我还是会欣然收下他这份自以为是的礼物。

scripts.text: This may be an unexpected question, but... Are you interested in meeting dangerous girls playing on a field?
scripts.translation: 这个问题可能有点突兀......你对在野外出没的危险女孩感兴趣吗？

scripts.text: I've seen girls that are so beautiful.
scripts.translation: 我见过一些美得惊人的女孩。

scripts.text: They're too dangerous to get close, but that's what make them so irresistibly attractive. Do you understand what I'm saying?
scripts.translation: 她们危险得让人不敢靠近，可正因如此才格外迷人。你明白我的意思吗？

scripts.text: Have you explored the area over the bridge at the right side of the united expedition camp?
scripts.translation: 你探索过联合远征营地右侧桥梁另一边的区域吗？

scripts.text: Then you know the area is so cold that it'll instantly freeze your heart.
scripts.translation: 那里冷得能瞬间冻透你的心。

scripts.text: You should go across the leftward bridge, you'll be surprised to see what's ahead of you.
scripts.translation: 你应该走过左边的桥，前方的景象会让你大吃一惊。

scripts.text: It's yet to be known how such a thing can happen.
scripts.translation: 没人知道那样的景象是怎么形成的。

scripts.text: I suppose I don't have the words to really describe such an amazing scene.
scripts.translation: 我想我实在找不到合适的话来形容那样惊人的景象。

scripts.text: I'll send a message to the garrison for you. Why don't you go see it with your own eyes? You won't be disappointed!
scripts.translation: 我会替你给驻军捎个信。你何不亲眼去看看？保证不会让你失望！

scripts.text: Of course, I'm offering such an extraordinary service because there's something I want in return. Ahahaha!
scripts.translation: 当然，我这么热心是有条件的。啊哈哈！

scripts.text: ...Truth be told, I'm having some trouble. And I need someone to help me.
scripts.translation: ......说实话，我遇到了一些麻烦，需要有人帮忙。

scripts.text: For now, you should go across the leftward bridge. Speak to a guard over there, and then just go ahead.
scripts.translation: 现在先走过左边的桥，和那里的卫兵交谈，然后继续往前走。

scripts.text: A group of beautiful girls will welcome you. I hope you'll enjoy having a conversation with them. Maybe you'll get to understand the mystery of nature.
scripts.translation: 一群美丽的女孩会欢迎你。希望你和她们聊得愉快，也许还能发现自然的奥秘。

scripts.text: Yes, I only need... ^3131FF30^000000 of them.
On the right side of this united expedition camp,
scripts.translation: 在联合远征营地的右侧，

scripts.text: we have a land surrounded by roaring blizzards.
scripts.translation: 有一片被呼啸的暴风雪包围的土地。
另一边则是一片宁静的绿色土地，

scripts.text: we have a peaceful green land
where we can enjoy Mother Nature's warm embrace.
scripts.translation: 们可以享受大自然温暖的怀抱。
两个截然不同的世界近在咫尺，

scripts.text: within a short distance of each other.
Where else can you see such amazing contrasts at a glance?
scripts.translation: 还有哪里能一眼看到如此鲜明的对比？

scripts.text: I'm curious to know all secrets about this world.
scripts.translation: 我很好奇，想要了解这个世界的所有秘密。

scripts.text: I'm so excited that I can't hide it!
scripts.translation: 我太兴奋了，根本藏不住！*气喘吁吁*

scripts.text: What a mysterious world this is!
Actually I'm here to study this strange phenomenon.
scripts.translation: 其实我来到这里，是为了研究这种奇怪的现象。

scripts.text: 5.....and check the families and growth of plants,
scripts.translation: 并调查植物的科属和生长情况，

scripts.text: I've installed several special environmental meters
scripts.translation: 我在这片区域安装了几台特殊的环境监
不幸的是，一些邪恶的魔物
罪魁祸首叫作科尔努斯。

scripts.text: I'd like to ask you to teach them not to destroy my devices again.
scripts.translation: 能请你教训它们一下，让它们别再破坏我的设备吗？

scripts.text: How'd you like to hunt ^3131FF10 of them^000000 to set an example? Good luck!
scripts.translation: 你愿意猎杀其中^3131FF10只，给它^000000们一个教训吗？祝你好运！

scripts.text: For now, you should go across the leftward bridge. Speak to a guard over there, and then just go ahead.
scripts.translation: 现在先走过左边的桥，和那里的卫兵交谈，然后继续往前走。

scripts.text: A group of beautiful girls will welcome you. I hope you'll enjoy having a conversation with them. Maybe you'll get to understand the mystery of nature.
scripts.translation: 一群美丽的女孩会欢迎你。希望你能和她们聊得愉快，也许还能发现自然的奥秘。

scripts.text: Hopefully the Cornuses have learned their lesson, and won't touch my special environmental meters anymore.
scripts.translation: 希望科尔努斯已经吸取教训，不会再碰我的特殊环境监测仪了。

scripts.text: Oh Karyl, while you were away, I received an interesting report from one of my research machines that remained intact.
scripts.translation: 哦，卡里尔，你离开期间，一台幸存的研究仪器传回了一份有趣的报告。

scripts.text: According to the report, The original weather condition of Ash Vacuum is cold and dry, just like the land on the right side.
scripts.translation: 报告显示，阿什真空原本气候寒冷干燥，和右侧的土地一样。

scripts.text: That means, somebody has artificially cultivated the leftward land.
scripts.translation: 这说明左侧的土地是人为培育出来的。

scripts.text: Do you remember seeing strange mushroom shaped buildings everywhere in the fields?
scripts.translation: 你还记得在田野里随处可见的那些奇怪的蘑菇状建筑吗？

scripts.text: I suspect it to be an environmental purifier that converts barren land into lush, green fields.
scripts.translation: 我怀疑那是一种环境净化器，能将贫瘠的土地转化为郁郁葱葱的绿色田野。

scripts.text: Please take this rotting plant stem,
scripts.translation: 请拿着这根腐烂的植物茎。

scripts.text: I'll meet you at the environmental purifier standing right next to the leftward bridge on the other side.
scripts.translation: 我们在另一边、紧挨着左侧桥梁的环境净化器旁碰面。

scripts.text: Cornuses are breaking my special environmental meters!
scripts.translation: 科尔努斯正在破坏我的特殊环境监测仪！

scripts.text: Please show them the power of Midgardians!
scripts.translation: 请让它们见识一下米德加尔特人的力量！

scripts.text: I'll meet you at the environmental purifier standing right next to the leftward bridge on the other side.
scripts.translation: 我们在另一边、紧挨着左侧桥梁的环境净化器旁碰面。

scripts.text: I submitted a report to upper management.
I haven't received any response, but I'm sure they'll be as excited as I am once they read the report. Woohoo!
scripts.translation: 虽然还没收到回复，但我相信他们读完后会和我一样兴奋。耶！

scripts.text: You're about to enter an area that has not been fully explored.
scripts.translation: 前方是尚未完全探索的区域。

scripts.text: Only personnel--researchers and explorers--authorized by United Midgard and the garrison are allowed to enter the danger zone.
scripts.translation: 只有获得联合米德加尔特和驻军授权的人员，也就是研究员和探险家，才能进入危险区域。

scripts.text: I want to enter the next area.
If you encounter any threats or strange phenomenon, then please don't hesitate to report to us at the garrison.
scripts.translation: 如果遇到任何威胁或异常现象，请立即向驻军报告。

scripts.text: No, you can't. Please return to the expedition camp.
scripts.translation: 不行，你不能进去。请返回探险营地。

scripts.text: You can tell the pileus is creating drops of light which drip to the ground.
scripts.translation: 你能看到菌盖产生了光滴，正滴落到地上。

scripts.text: Please try to plant the rotting stem in the ground.
scripts.translation: 试着把腐烂的茎种到地里。

scripts.text: Please try to plant the rotting stem in the ground.
scripts.translation: 试着把腐烂的茎种到地里。

scripts.text: Please try to plant the rotting stem in the ground.
scripts.translation: 试着把腐烂的茎种到地里。

scripts.text: It's sprouted! That shoot looks healthy!
scripts.translation: 发芽了！那株嫩芽看起来很健康！

scripts.text: This giant mushroom, otherwise known as an Environmental Purifier, not only brings dying plants back to life, but also stimulates their growth.
scripts.translation: 这种巨大的蘑菇又叫环境净化器，不仅能让枯萎的植物恢复生机，还能促进它们生长。

scripts.text: This finding will surely stir up the academic world.
scripts.translation: 这一发现肯定会轰动学术界。

scripts.text: Now, I should get back to work. I need to write a report based on my study results.
scripts.translation: 好了，我该回去工作了。我得根据研究结果写一份报告。

scripts.text: I can't wait to see how the expedition management will react to my report. Hahaha~
scripts.translation: 真想知道探险队管理层读完后会有什么反应。哈哈哈～

scripts.text: Can you please tell him that I've received his Nepenthes specimen safely?
scripts.translation: 能请你告诉他，我已经平安收到他的猪笼草标本了吗？

scripts.text: And don't forget to tell him that I've produced great research results. That'll make him cry like a baby. Hahahaha!
scripts.translation: 别忘了告诉他，我的研究成果很出色。这会让他哭得像个小孩子。哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text: - You dug a hole into the ground, planted the rotting stem, and then watered it. -
scripts.translation: - 你在地上挖了个洞，种下腐烂的植物茎，然后浇了水。 -

scripts.text: - Something is growing out of the dirt. -
scripts.translation: - 有什么东西从土里长出来了。 -

scripts.text: This is it! Come to the small tree in the southeast direction!
scripts.translation: 就是这里！来东南方向的那棵小树旁！

scripts.text: - Something is making loud noise near the top of the tree. -
scripts.translation: - 树顶附近传来一阵巨响。 -

scripts.text: Monsters were looking at me, so I climbed up this tree without even thinking!
scripts.translation: 魔物盯着我看，所以我想都没想就爬上了这棵树！

scripts.text: How can I get down now?
Oh wait, I can see everything so clearly from here.
scripts.translation: 啊，等等，从这里看得真清楚。

scripts.text: I guess staying here will be much safer and easier for studying monsters.
scripts.translation: 我想待在这里观察魔物会安全又方便得多。

scripts.text: ...I'm looking at Hillsrion, the creature that people are talking about.
scripts.translation: ......我正在观察大家谈论的那种生物——希尔里昂。

scripts.text: It's covered with soft fur that reminds me of soft ice flakes floating in the air.
scripts.translation: 它身上覆盖着柔软的毛，让我想起飘在空中的柔软雪花。

scripts.text: ...Oh, sorry.. I was just talking to myself.
scripts.translation: ......啊，抱歉......我刚才只是在自言自语。

scripts.text: I'll be watching the Hillsrions from this tree. {0}, can you please go collect ^3131FFHillsrion Horns^000000 for me?
scripts.translation: 我会在这棵树上观察希尔里昂。{0}，能麻烦你帮我收^3131FF集一些希尔里昂^000000的角吗？

scripts.text: Their horns might possess a special power. And I want to have them for further research.
scripts.translation: 它们的角可能有特殊力量，我想收集一些作进一步研究。

scripts.text: I'd like to study Hillsrion's Horns. Please bring 5 of them for me, okay.
scripts.translation: 我想研究希尔里昂的角。请帮我带5个过来，好吗？

scripts.text: Are you okay? Their fangs look so sharp and shiny...
scripts.translation: 你没事吧？它们的尖牙看起来又尖又亮......

scripts.text: Oh right, you're an expert when it comes to this kind of job. Hahaha, I don't have to worry about you anymore.
scripts.translation: 对了，你可是这方面的专家。哈哈，我不用再担心你了。
你带回希尔里昂的角了吗？

scripts.text: Those are the horns in your hands?
scripts.translation: 就是你手里拿着的那些吗？

scripts.text: Well, they appear to be ordinary horns with a spiral pattern.
scripts.translation: 嗯，它们看起来像是带有螺旋纹路的普通角。

scripts.text: Monsters with such horns are a dime a dozen in Midgard.
scripts.translation: 在米德加尔特，长着这种角的魔物随处可见。

scripts.text: I, however, still have no idea how Hillsrions use their horns.
scripts.translation: 不过，我仍然不知道希尔里昂是如何使用它们的角的。

scripts.text: If they have bad vision, they could use the horns as feelers, or... I know you don't want to hear me ramble on with my conjecture. Sorry.
scripts.translation: 如果它们视力不好，或许会把角当作触角，或者......我知道你不想听我继续猜测。抱歉。

scripts.text: We can call it a day for today. Thanks to you, I now feel confident enough to at least come to this tree by myself next time.
scripts.translation: 今天就到这里吧。多亏了你，我现在有信心下次至少能独自走到这棵树旁。

scripts.text: Let's go back to the camp. Shall we? I have something to discuss with you.
scripts.translation: 我们回营地吧？我有件事想和你商量。

scripts.text: You find a little creature flying in the bushes.
scripts.translation: 你在灌木丛中发现了一只飞舞的小生物。

scripts.text: It has tiny wings on the back...
scripts.translation: 它的背上长着小小的翅膀......

scripts.text: The fairy notices you, and looks very surprised.
scripts.translation: 小妖精注意到了你，看起来非常惊讶。

scripts.text: It is saying something, but you don't understand.
scripts.translation: 它正在说着什么，但你听不懂。

scripts.text: You should report this to the united expedition quickly.
scripts.translation: 你应该尽快把这件事报告给联合远征队。

scripts.text: Perhaps the guard captain of the expedition is the right person to report to.
scripts.translation: 远征队的卫兵队长或许是合适的汇报对象。

scripts.text: The surprised fairy is saying something to you, but you cannot understand fairy language.
scripts.translation: 受惊的小妖精正对你说着什么，但你听不懂妖精语。

scripts.text: Who are you?! Are you looking for the Sapha!?
You have found something moving between dry branches.
scripts.translation: 你在枯枝间发现了一个正在移动的东西。

scripts.text: It appears to be a tree at first glance, but it turns out to be a giant that is half tree and half man.
scripts.translation: 乍看像棵树，仔细一看却是个半树半人的巨人。

scripts.text: The giant notices you, and looks very surprised.
scripts.translation: 巨人注意到了你，看起来非常惊讶。

scripts.text: It is saying something, but you don't understand.
scripts.translation: 它似乎在说什么，但你听不懂。

scripts.text: You should report this to the united expedition quickly.
scripts.translation: 你应该尽快把这件事报告给联合远征队。

scripts.text: Perhaps the guard captain of the expedition is the right person to report to.
scripts.translation: 远征队的卫兵队长或许是合适的汇报对象。

scripts.text: The surprised giant is saying something to you, but you cannot understand.
scripts.translation: 受惊的巨人正对你说着什么，但你听不懂。

scripts.text: Where are the Laphine reinforcements? I might have a problem.
scripts.translation: 拉斐族的增援部队在哪里？我好像遇到麻烦了。

scripts.text: Good day. I'm here to protect the

scripts.translation: 我负责保护联合米德加尔特远征队探险者的安全。

scripts.text: - You report your encounter with a small fairy in the Splandid area to the guard captain. -
scripts.translation: - 你向卫兵队长报告了在辉煌领域遇到小妖精的事。 -

scripts.text: It's too early to say this, but we might have to dispatch an investigation group to the area.
scripts.translation: 现在下结论还为时尚早，不过我们可能得派一支调查队去那里。

scripts.text: I'll discuss this more with the expedition management.
scripts.translation: 我会和远征队管理层进一步讨论此事。

scripts.text: Thank you for your valuable information.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你提供的重要情报。

scripts.text: - You report your encounter with a tree giant in the Manuk area to the guard captain. -
scripts.translation: - 你向卫兵队长报告了在马努克地区遇到树巨人的事。 -

scripts.text: It's too early to say this, but we might have to dispatch an investigation group to the area.
scripts.translation: 现在下结论还为时尚早，不过我们可能得派一支调查队去那里。

scripts.text: I'll discuss this more with the expedition management.
scripts.translation: 我会和远征队管理层进一步讨论此事。

scripts.text: Thank you for your valuable information.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你提供的重要情报。

scripts.text: How come you've got so much to carry?
scripts.translation: 你怎么带了这么多东西？

scripts.text: Are you perhaps on training or something?
scripts.translation: 是在进行训练之类的吗？

scripts.text: You must be the adventurer from Midgard.
scripts.translation: 你一定是来自米德加尔特的那位冒险者吧。

scripts.text: We've come all the way here to keep track of Satan Morocc, but... Now it seems that's not our priority anymore... Tsk,tsk...
scripts.translation: 我们千里迢迢来到这里追踪魔王梦罗克，可...现在看来那已经不是首要任务了...啧啧...

scripts.text: Well, since our research group has been gathered in such haste, many of our members collide too often.
scripts.translation: 我们的研究小组是匆忙组建的，成员之间经常发生冲突。

scripts.text: I think it's just the process of trial and error, but this really slows things down.
scripts.translation: 我想这只是磨合过程的一部分，但确实拖慢了进度。

scripts.text: Alas, the head office keeps pushing me to submit a report... As if I could perform miracles!
scripts.translation: 唉，总部一直催我交报告......我又不是能创造奇迹的人！

scripts.text: I can't go around and meet those people myself, mediate among troubled people... This is impossible!! Unless...Unless someone helps me with that ! I need... someone...
scripts.translation: 我没法亲自去见那些人、调解他们之间的矛盾......这根本不可能！！除非......除非有人肯帮我！我需要......有人......

scripts.text: Eh?! Oh, my... You really shouldn't. You must be extremely busy tracking down Satan Morocc!
scripts.translation: 诶？！哎呀......你可别这么做。你肯定正忙着追踪魔王梦罗克呢！

scripts.text: But... if you say so, could I really use your help? Hahaha.
scripts.translation: 不过......既然你这么说，我真的可以请你帮忙吗？哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Those researchers complain a lot these days. They're terribly stressed out and I think somebody should really listen to their problems.
scripts.translation: 最近那些研究员抱怨得很多。他们压力很大，我觉得真的该有人听听他们的烦恼。

scripts.text: Especially those dealing with document files that argue with each other so many times! You might wanna start by talking to them.
scripts.translation: 尤其是负责档案的那些研究员，他们总是争吵不休！你可以先去和他们聊聊。

scripts.text: Sounds good, huh? Please, you should go now.
scripts.translation: 听起来不错吧？拜托你现在就出发吧。

scripts.text: Those researchers complain a lot these days. They're terribly stressed out and I think somebody should really listen to their problems.
scripts.translation: 最近那些研究员抱怨得很多。他们压力很大，我觉得真的该有人听听他们的烦恼。

scripts.text: Especially those dealing with document files that argue with each other so many times! You might wanna start by talking to them.
scripts.translation: 尤其是负责档案的那些研究员，他们总是争吵不休！你可以先去和他们聊聊。

scripts.text: And, don't worry! I'm even willing to share my snacks with you if things go well. I'm not asking this for free, you got that~?
scripts.translation: 还有，别担心！事情顺利的话，我甚至愿意把零食分给你。我可不是白请你帮忙的，懂吗～？

scripts.text: Isn't that an invitation to the meeting?
And...and I really get to sign this thing and approve it...? Hahaha!
scripts.translation: 而且......我真的可以在这份文件上签字批准吗？哈哈哈！

scripts.text: This, this means I need to get prepared for the meeting! Finally!
scripts.translation: 这、这意味着我得为会议做准备了！终于等到了！

scripts.text: Oh, by the way, did you get a rough idea of the atmosphere of this expedition?
scripts.translation: 对了，你大概了解这次远征队里的氛围了吗？

scripts.text: Normally, researchers just take their own instruments and find their own tracks of Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation: 通常研究员只带上自己的仪器，各自去追踪魔王梦罗克。

scripts.text: They don't really need to cooperate with other members.
scripts.translation: 他们其实不需要和其他成员合作。

scripts.text: Howerver, things get different when it comes to document files.
scripts.translation: 然而，档案工作就不同了。

scripts.text: Those researchers in charge of document files must contact eachother for information, and this just makes for endless work.
scripts.translation: 负责档案的研究员必须互相沟通、交换信息，工作自然没完没了。

scripts.text: People can't always be perfect, so they stress out and get to arguing...
scripts.translation: 人不可能事事完美，所以他们压力很大，最后就吵了起来......

scripts.text: So... Could you do me a favor?
As you've heard, about the 3 researchers, they don't agree with eachother too often. It's just too obvious that their meeting will turn out a disaster, and the whole research group could break down!
scripts.translation: 正如你听到的，那三位研究员经常意见不合。他们的会议显然会变成灾难，整个研究小组都可能因此散伙！

scripts.text: Oh, just thinking about it scares the crap out of me.
scripts.translation: 光是想想就吓得我魂飞魄散。

scripts.text: What I'm asking is that you participate in the meeting with them and help them negotiate.
scripts.translation: 我想请你参加他们的会议，帮忙协调。

scripts.text: So, first! Can you go meet those 3 researchers and check on them to prepare for the meeting?
scripts.translation: 首先，你能去见见那三位研究员，了解一下情况，为会议做准备吗？

scripts.text: Did you talk to those researchers in charge of document files?
scripts.translation: 你和负责档案工作的那些研究员谈过了吗？

scripts.text: Please, you should participate in the meeting and mediate them if anything goes wrong!
scripts.translation: 拜托了，请参加会议；要是出了什么问题，就帮忙调解！

scripts.text: First, you should go meet those 3 researchers and check on them to prepare for the meeting. Hope they're not preparing any weapons though...
scripts.translation: 首先，你去见见那三位研究员，了解一下情况，为会议做准备。希望他们没在准备武器......

scripts.text: Ohhh, you came! How generous of you!
scripts.translation: 哦，你来了！真是太感谢了！

scripts.text: Whew... I think I'm too tense... My chest hurts... Aaaah.
scripts.translation: 呼......我太紧张了......胸口好痛......啊啊啊。

scripts.text: First, I need to hear the report on the process of tracking Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation: 首先，我想听听追踪魔王梦罗克的进展报告。

scripts.text: Alright. I'm Ryosen from Rune-Midgarts. We're certain that Satan Morocc came to this place through the crack of dimension, however, we failed to find any traces within the area we inspected.
scripts.translation: 好的。我是来自卢恩·米德加兹的良泉。我们确定魔王梦罗克是通过次元裂缝来到这里的，但在已调查的区域里没能找到任何踪迹。

scripts.text: The Tripartite Union is doing whatever it takes to track down Satan Morocc's whereabouts, but the research in Ash-Vacuum is very limited.
scripts.translation: 三方联盟正在竭尽全力追踪魔王梦罗克的下落，但对阿什真空的研究仍受到很大限制。

scripts.text: Supplies, reinforcements as wel as demanded goods are all insufficient, so we can't really go on.
scripts.translation: 物资、增援和其他所需物品都不足，我们实在难以继续行动。

scripts.text: I've heard the assassins took action in order to find the traces of Satan Morocc, but nothing's been reported so far.
scripts.translation: 我听说刺客们为了寻找魔王梦罗克的踪迹采取了行动，但目前还没有任何消息。

scripts.text: I'm Hue from the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation: 我是来自修瓦尔兹巴鲁德共和国的休。

scripts.text: We're still researching on the crack of dimension that Satan Morocc has come through, and the false data research on the noise created when moving through the crack is currently being corrected.
scripts.translation: 我们仍在研究魔王梦罗克穿越的次元裂缝，也正在修正有关穿越裂缝时产生噪音的错误数据。

scripts.text: The real cause of this problem has yet to be found, which makes it hard for us to provide any reinforcements or other supplies.
scripts.translation: 问题的真正原因尚未找到，所以我们很难提供增援或其他物资。

scripts.text: Ok. I see. How's it going with the research on Ash-Vacuum?
scripts.translation: 好的，我明白了。阿什真空的研究进展如何？

scripts.text: Hi, I'm Hansenne from Arunafeltz. We have conclused that his world of Ash-Vacuum is nothing related to the continent of Midgard, as it is placed in a totally indipendent world dimension.
scripts.translation: 你好，我是来自阿鲁纳菲兹的汉森娜。我们已经得出结论：阿什真空与米德加尔特大陆毫无关联，它位于一个完全独立的维度。

scripts.text: The environment of the fields on the East and West where we can work on the research has nothing in common with the environment within the boundrary of the Tripartite Union's army post.
scripts.translation: 我们能开展研究的东西两侧区域，其环境与三方联盟军营边界内的环境截然不同。

scripts.text: I also have been reported that the ecosystem in the researched are is different.
scripts.translation: 我还收到报告称，研究区域的生态系统也有所不同。

scripts.text: We could not go further with the research on the ecosystem due to some violent living creatures which have never been found on the Midgard continent.
scripts.translation: 一些在米德加尔特大陆从未发现过的凶猛生物，让我们无法继续研究当地的生态系统。

scripts.text: So... All in all, nothing has been clearly found. Any problems among the members of the United Research Group?
scripts.translation: 所以......总而言之，目前还没有明确的发现。联合研究组成员之间有什么问题吗？

scripts.text: - The room is in awkward silence for a short while... -
scripts.translation: - 房间里短暂地陷入尴尬的沉默...... -

scripts.text: ... Then, anything you need to request, or suggest, perhaps? Anything you want to complain about?
scripts.translation: ......那么，还有什么需要申请或建议的吗？或者有什么想抱怨的？
-- 突然停下来打量其他人。

scripts.text: - studies the others. Then, he takes -
- out something from the bottom of -
- the chair and puts it on the table. -
scripts.translation: - 拿出一样东西放到桌上。 -
- 休被突如其来的尖叫吓得慌忙站起，
- 不小心撞到良泉拿出来的东西，

scripts.text: object which Ryosen had taken out. -
- As the Official screamed, all the
researchers of the union started to
scripts.translation: 联盟的研究员们也跟着 -

scripts.text: scream as well, and rushed out of
I really don't know what to say.
I mean... I'm totally OK with other monsters, mutants or whatever, but that black evil thing... Oh, I can't stand that one...
scripts.translation: 我是说......别的魔物、变异体之类我都不怕，但那个黑乎乎的邪恶东西......哦，我实在受不了......

scripts.text: - The researchers come back into the room. -
- Except for Ryosen, the rest spring out of their seats and run hurriedly for the door. -
scripts.translation: - 除了良泉，其他人都从座位上跳起来，慌忙冲向门口。 -

scripts.text: - Ryosen picks up his strawberry cake, all squashed with some fingerprints. -
scripts.translation: - 良泉捡起了草莓蛋糕。它被压得稀烂，上面还留着几枚指纹。 -

scripts.text: Move one more time and you'll be considered guilty!!
scripts.translation: 再动一下，我就当你们是罪魁祸首！！

scripts.text: This cake was just fine before that evil thing appeared, and there were only 4 of us here!
scripts.translation: 那个邪恶的东西出现之前，蛋糕明明还好好的，而且房间里只有我们四个人！

scripts.text: One of you must be guilty of ruining my Rune-Midgarts' Strawberry Cake!!!
scripts.translation: 你们当中肯定有人毁了我的卢恩·米德加尔特草莓蛋糕！！！

scripts.text: I can't help checking your hands! This must be a fingerprint! It's loud and clear!! Hmm, I bet this is the mark of an index finger!
scripts.translation: 我得检查你们的手！这一定是指纹！清清楚楚！！嗯，我敢说这是食指留下的印记！

scripts.text: Wait a minute! Wait! Stop treating us like criminals! What is wrong with you, it's only a cake!? Don't you think you're going a little too far?
scripts.translation: 等一下！停下！别把我们当罪犯！你怎么回事，明明只是一块蛋糕！你不觉得你太过分了吗？

scripts.text: Aha, yeah, I just remembered. You people from Schwarzwald don't ever appreciate food at all, right?
scripts.translation: 啊哈，对了。我想起来了。你们修瓦尔兹巴鲁德人根本不懂得珍惜食物，对吧？

scripts.text: Especially when the food is NOT yours, huh? That's why you people sneak a taste of other people's food like my strawberry cake!!!
scripts.translation: 尤其是别人的食物，对吧？所以你们才会偷偷尝别人的东西，比如我的草莓蛋糕！！！

scripts.text: Hmm, are you talking about Dusty?
He was expelled right after the incident and his job was taken away! I told you several times already!
scripts.translation: 那件事之后他马上就被开除了，连工作也丢了！我已经跟你说过好几次了！

scripts.text: Ugh... You guys, I think you should calm down... This is ridiculous.
scripts.translation: 唉......你们还是冷静一下吧......这太荒唐了。

scripts.text: Ughhhhh! It was I who did that!!!
Sorry, I was just too shocked by that thief bug and accidentally touched your cake with my finger!
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我被那只盗虫吓到了，不小心用手指碰到了你的蛋糕！

scripts.text: I can't belive how careless you are all the time, like with the requested data and all!!
scripts.translation: 我真不敢相信你一直这么粗心，连别人要的数据都能弄错！！

scripts.text: Ah, I forgot to say thank you.
Hue, thank you so much for restoring my documents!!!
scripts.translation: 休，非常感谢你帮我找回档案！！！
哈哈哈哈哈。哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Ahhhhhh! I guess we should call it a day now! Thanks for comingm all of you. Ok, let's go. Dismissed!
scripts.translation: 啊......我想今天就到此为止吧！谢谢大家前来。好了，散会！

scripts.text: -The three researchers say nothing. They just stare at each other, standing still... Then they finally leave the room. -
scripts.translation: - 三位研究员一言不发，只是站着互相凝视...... -- 最后，他们终于离开了房间。 -

scripts.text: Ugh, I've got nothing to say.
scripts.translation: 唉，我真不知道该说什么。

scripts.text: All I wanted was to let those people be closter to each other, become more friendly. But, problems come up every single time.
scripts.translation: 我只是想让他们彼此更亲近、关系更友好。可每次都会出状况。

scripts.text: Can you think of any idea how to get those people to get along??
scripts.translation: 你能想到什么办法让他们和睦相处吗？

scripts.text: ... Actually... Hansenne is not the one who ruined that cake.
scripts.translation: ......其实......弄坏蛋糕的不是汉森娜。

scripts.text: But... I don't understand why Hansenne would take the blame...
scripts.translation: 可是......我不明白汉森娜为什么要替别人背黑锅......

scripts.text: ... Actually... Hansenne is not the one who ruined that cake.
scripts.translation: ...其实...弄坏蛋糕的不是汉森娜。

scripts.text: But... I don't understand why Hansenne would take the blame...
scripts.translation: 可是......我不明白汉森娜为什么要替别人背黑锅......

scripts.text: - You tell the Official about the conversation that the 3 researchers had, in detail. -
scripts.translation: - 你向官员详细讲述了三位研究员之间的对话。 -

scripts.text: Maybe I've been a little too worried.
How often they collide, it must be a natural thing for people from different countries with different personalities and customs.
scripts.translation: 他们之间经常起冲突......不过来自不同国家的人个性、习俗各异，这或许很正常。

scripts.text: Here, I'll offer you a cup of tea.
This is a really special drink I preserved. Please, drink it while it's nice and hot.
scripts.translation: 这是我珍藏的特制饮品。趁热喝吧。

scripts.text: - You feel so refreshed and light, as you drink the tea that the Official offered. -
scripts.translation: - 喝了官员递来的茶，你顿觉神清气爽、浑身轻松。 -

scripts.text: Now, I should get to work on the report I need to submit to the head office. Ah, and this is nothing big, but still... This might come in handy when you travel.
scripts.translation: 现在我得去写一份要交给总部的报告了。啊，这不是什么贵重东西，不过......你旅行时也许用得上。

scripts.text: Please, stop by and say hellp to us from time to time.
scripts.translation: 请偶尔来看看我们，打声招呼。

scripts.text: Please, stop by and say hellp to us from time to time.
scripts.translation: 请偶尔来看看我们，打声招呼。

scripts.text: Oh, I'm not asking you to keep your eye on those 3 researchers. Don't get me wrong, hahaha.~
scripts.translation: 哦，我不是让你去盯着那三位研究员。别误会，哈哈哈～

scripts.text: I wouldn't be roaming around this place like that, if I were you.
scripts.translation: 如果我是你，就不会在这里到处乱逛。

scripts.text: It's very dangerous here, and people dwelling is this place are not that nice.
scripts.translation: 这里非常危险，住在这里的人也不怎么友善。

scripts.text: Hmm? What did you just say?
I can't really hear you. Could you speak louder?
scripts.translation: 我听不清你说什么。能大声点吗？

scripts.text: How come you've got so much to carry?
scripts.translation: 你怎么带了这么多东西？

scripts.text: Are you perhaps on training or something?
Please, keep your hands off my stuff!
Please, keep your hands off my stuff!
Ugh! My, my... What am I gonna do with this!? Files, files, files!!!
scripts.translation: 啊！天哪......我该怎么办！？文件，全是文件！！！

scripts.text: What time is it now? Ugh... This is such a mess!!
scripts.translation: 现在几点了？唉......简直乱成一团！！

scripts.text: What are they thinking!!? I don't get it. How come I have to work, while those guys from other countries are just praying for a breakthrough, every single day!
scripts.translation: 他们在想什么？！我真不明白。为什么只有我在这里干活，而其他国家的人每天都在祈祷能有突破！

scripts.text: This is so unfair!! My stress is growing geometrically every hour!
scripts.translation: 太不公平了！！我的压力每小时都在成倍增长！

scripts.text: What a waste of time! Why do they have to pray! Why?! Why?! Why don't they work instead of pray!!
scripts.translation: 真是浪费时间！他们为什么祈祷？为什么？！为什么？！为什么不去工作，光祈祷有什么用！！
没人感激我！一个都没有！

scripts.text: Anyway, who are you? This place is restricted.
scripts.translation: 总之，你是谁？这里是限制区域。

scripts.text: Ah! You must be the one who came to help us track down that Satan Morocc, the bastard who made the giant hole and then was gone like the wind.
scripts.translation: 啊！你一定是来帮我们追踪魔王梦罗克的冒险者吧？就是那个挖出一个大洞，然后转眼就消失的混蛋。

scripts.text: Ugh. I should watch my mouth.
Sorry. You're on our side. I should just be polite, but it's just... I'm so stressed out.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，你是我们这边的人。我应该客气些，只是......我压力太大了。

scripts.text: How about having some tea here?
It's Rafflesia tea from Schwarzwald. Don't even expect taste, it's awful... But what can I do? It's the only thing I've got...
scripts.translation: 这是修瓦尔兹巴鲁德的大王花茶。别指望味道有多好，难喝得很......可我也没办法，这是我手头唯一的茶......

scripts.text: You must have heard about this, but this is the place where Satan Morocc landed through the crack of dimension.
scripts.translation: 你应该听说过，这里就是魔王梦罗克通过次元裂缝降落的地方。

scripts.text: As you see, this seems like a totally different world. It's nothing like the continent of Midgard, though we haven't found any concrete evidence. We decided to call this place Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation: 如你所见，这里简直像另一个世界。它与米德加尔特大陆截然不同，虽然我们还没有找到确凿证据。我们把这里称为阿什真空。

scripts.text: We're doing everything we can, to track down Satan Morocc, but all those researchers from different countries couldn't help but wonder what this place really is.
scripts.translation: 我们正在竭尽全力追踪魔王梦罗克，但来自各国的研究员也忍不住想知道这里究竟是什么地方。

scripts.text: Well, so we're all interested in one thing. However, the real problem lies on our structure of the group.
scripts.translation: 嗯，大家都对同一件事感兴趣。但真正的问题在于团队的组织架构。

scripts.text: Three different countries united to take down the comon enemy, Satan Morocc, byt they eventually started to gather and keep the information to themselves.
scripts.translation: 三个国家联合起来对付共同的敌人魔王梦罗克，但后来大家各自收集、保管情报，不愿共享。

scripts.text: Tracking Satan Morocc is not or major concern anymore. Our expedition was formed in such hase that so may things can cause problems in this group.
scripts.translation: 追踪魔王梦罗克已经不再是我们的首要任务了。远征队组建得太仓促，团队里有太多可能引发问题的事。

scripts.text: People don't believe other members of the group except for the ones from their own countries. They're all so sensitive that every little thing hits a nerve.
scripts.translation: 人们只信任本国的成员，不信任团队里的其他人。他们都很敏感，一点小事就能惹恼他们。

scripts.text: But what can we do? After all, we were gathered to achieve the same goal, and we researchers don't want to cause any trouble among countries. It's really hard for us to live with our complaints.
scripts.translation: 可我们又能怎么办？大家毕竟是为了同一个目标聚在一起的，我们研究员也不想引发国家之间的矛盾。每天憋着这些怨气实在不好受。

scripts.text: I mean... the situation here is... just like the taste of this tea.
scripts.translation: 我是说......这里的情况......就像这茶的味道一样。

scripts.text: Oh, I spent too much time talking.
Look at this pile of document files... We're supposed to share all the information within these documents...
scripts.translation: 看看这堆档案......我们本来应该共享其中的所有信息......

scripts.text: Oh, well... Maybe the same thing's happening at other offices. People from other countries might have hidden some important information behind my back.
scripts.translation: 算了......其他办公室可能也一样。别国的人或许背着我隐瞒了重要信息。

scripts.text: Whatever... Could you deliver this document to the Schwarzwald and Arunafeltz researchers?
scripts.translation: 不管怎样......你能把这份文件送给修瓦尔兹巴鲁德和阿鲁纳菲兹的研究员吗？

scripts.text: ... Eh? Didn't you come to help us?
No one in our research group wants to visit the offices of the other countries!
scripts.translation: 我们研究组没人想去其他国家的办公室！

scripts.text: Ok, now, please deliver the file to Hue and Hansenne. Hue's in charge of Schwarzwald's documents and Hansenne's in chare of Arunafeltz's.
scripts.translation: 好，现在请把文件交给休和汉森娜。休负责修瓦尔兹巴鲁德的档案，汉森娜负责阿鲁纳菲兹的档案。

scripts.text: The file contains the brief introduction and the schedule of the meesting.
scripts.translation: 文件里有简要介绍和会议日程。

scripts.text: For your information, you should go see Hue at the Schwarzwald's office first. Otherwise, he'll be whining about it.
scripts.translation: 顺便告诉你，应该先去修瓦尔兹巴鲁德的办公室找休。不然他又要抱怨了。

scripts.text: You must check if they read and understand correctly after delivering it. Don't forget to get them to sign at the bottom of the page, just in case.
scripts.translation: 送交文件后，确认他们是否读懂了内容。别忘了让他们在页面底部签名，以防万一。

scripts.text: Just so you know, today's Desert Day. Midgard is sending some desserts through the crack of dimension, regularly.
scripts.translation: 顺便说一下，今天是甜点日。米德加尔特会定期通过次元裂缝送来甜点。

scripts.text: Midgard's desserts are definitely the world's best.
scripts.translation: 米德加尔特的甜点绝对是世界上最好的。

scripts.text: The only thing we enjoy here is that dessert we receive, once a week.
scripts.translation: 我们在这里唯一能享受的，就是每周收到的那份甜点。

scripts.text: Schwarzwald's Pineapple Jubilee is just awful. It tastes something like rusty steel.
scripts.translation: 修瓦尔兹巴鲁德的菠萝庆典难吃透顶，吃起来像生锈的钢铁。

scripts.text: Arunafeltz's Desert Sandwich is nothing better than that. I think that sandwich's made of some old meat, otherwise, we wouldn't have been food poisoned so often!
scripts.translation: 阿鲁纳菲兹的沙漠三明治也好不到哪里去。我怀疑那是用变质的肉做的，不然我们怎么会经常食物中毒！

scripts.text: But, Rune-Midgarts' Strawberry Cake! It's the best.
scripts.translation: 不过，卢恩·米德加尔特的草莓蛋糕才是最棒的。

scripts.text: Nice and soft spongecake covered with sweet-tasting whipped cream, lots of fresh strawberries on top!
scripts.translation: 松软的海绵蛋糕上涂着甜美的鲜奶油，还铺满新鲜草莓！

scripts.text: Rune-Midgarts' top chef, Charles Orleans makes it himself!!!
scripts.translation: 卢恩·米德加尔特的首席厨师查尔斯·奥尔良亲自制作！！

scripts.text: Hurry, you must hurry up, or you won't be able to taste this wonderful cake!
scripts.translation: 快点！再不快点，你就尝不到这块美味的蛋糕了！
- 收到了一份会议邀请函，
- 整场会议的议程和日程！ -

scripts.text: Hurry up and deliver the document to Hue and Hansenne!
scripts.translation: 快把文件送给休和汉森娜！

scripts.text: Don't forget! Schwarzwald's Hue must get it first, otherwise, he'll nag us like crazy.
scripts.translation: 别忘了！必须先交给修瓦尔兹巴鲁德的休，不然他会没完没了地抱怨。

scripts.text: And you must get the document signed at the bottom before you bring it back.
scripts.translation: 带回文件之前，别忘了让他们在下面签字。

scripts.text: Hurry, you must hurry up or you won't be able to taste this wonderfull cake!
scripts.translation: 快点！再不快点，你就尝不到这块美味的蛋糕了！

scripts.text: Must've been hard to get them all signed. Well done!
scripts.translation: 让他们都签字一定很不容易吧。做得好！

scripts.text: Hue's so egotistic and stubborn. He thinks he's some kind of royale... and Hansenne... Whew~nobody ever gets what he's just talking about.
scripts.translation: 休太自负又固执了。他觉得自己像个皇室成员......至于汉森娜......唉，没人听得懂她在说什么。

scripts.text: Thank you for dealing with those guys. I've got to go through the file now. Please give me the Invitation.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你和那些家伙周旋。我现在得看看这份文件。把邀请函给我。

scripts.text: Please get Hue and Hansenne to sign the Inviation, then come back.
scripts.translation: 请让休和汉森娜在邀请函上签字，再回来找我。

scripts.text: Hurry, you must hurry up or you won't be able to taste this wonderfull cake!
scripts.translation: 快点！再不快点，你就尝不到这块美味的蛋糕了！

scripts.text: This autograph here looks like Hue's. See, the letters are all so strongly pressed down with his anger. This one here should be Hansenne's, scrawled without thinking.
scripts.translation: 这个签名看起来像是休的。瞧，笔迹压得很重，像是在发火。这个应该是汉森娜的，潦草得像是随手写的。

scripts.text: How was it? Did you have a chance t find out what the problem is among us researchers?
scripts.translation: 怎么样？你查出我们研究员之间的问题了吗？

scripts.text: This isn't all because of the different personalities. Lots of other members have similar problems. Howerver, the problem among us three: Hue, Hansenne and I... is just more visible than others.
scripts.translation: 这不仅仅是性格不同造成的。很多成员都有类似的问题，只是我们三人——休、汉森娜和我——之间的矛盾更明显。

scripts.text: So, here we are. We are finally ordered to have a meeting and supposed to find the way to solve our problem.
scripts.translation: 结果我们终于被要求开会，想办法解决彼此的问题。

scripts.text: But, do you know what really would be the best solution for us? It's to avoid meeting face to face.
scripts.translation: 不过，你知道对我们来说最好的解决办法是什么吗？就是别面对面开会。

scripts.text: It wasn't our will to have this meeting, and I never imagined they'd sign this thing... Well, I just feel like I've been punched in the head or something.
scripts.translation: 这次会议并非我们自愿参加的，我也没想到他们会签这份文件......唉，我觉得自己像是被人打了一闷棍。

scripts.text: Well, it's already spilled milk. I need to go to that meeting whether I like it or not. Could you please send this to the Official of the United Research?
scripts.translation: 算了，木已成舟。不管我愿不愿意，都得去参加会议。你能把这份文件交给联合研究官员吗？

scripts.text: In the meantime, I should prepare myself for the meeting.
scripts.translation: 这段时间我得为会议做些准备。

scripts.text: It wasn't our will to have this meeting, and I never imagined they'd sign this thing... Well, I just feel like I've been punched in the head or something.
scripts.translation: 这次会议并非我们自愿参加的，我也没想到他们会签这份文件......唉，我觉得自己像是被人打了一闷棍。

scripts.text: Well, it's already spilled milk. I need to go to that meeting whether I like it or not. Could you please send this to the Official of the United Research?
scripts.translation: 算了，木已成舟。不管我愿不愿意，都得去参加会议。你能把这份文件交给联合研究官员吗？

scripts.text: In the meantime, I should prepare myself for the meeting.
scripts.translation: 这段时间我得为会议做些准备。

scripts.text: Hi! Did you give that Invitation to the Official?
scripts.translation: 嗨！你把邀请函交给那位官员了吗？

scripts.text: Oh, goo to hear that it's delivered safely.
scripts.translation: 哦，很高兴听说你平安送到了。

scripts.text: Anyway, what brings you here again?
Would you like some tea? We haven't got any dessert yet. I only have some tea to offer.
scripts.translation: 想喝点茶吗？甜点还没送到，我只有茶可以招待你。

scripts.text: Can I help you with anything?
scripts.translation: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？

scripts.text: Well, there are tons of things waiting for help!
scripts.translation: 等着帮忙的事可多着呢！

scripts.text: I've requested something from the Arunafeltz office but haven't gotten anything yet. Could you get it from Hansenne?
scripts.translation: 我向阿鲁纳菲兹办公室申请了些东西，但还没收到。你能去找汉森娜拿一下吗？

scripts.text: I need that for the meeting, but he never sends it to me. He must've forgotten about it, again! You'll help me with this, right!?
scripts.translation: 我开会需要那份文件，可她一直没送来。她肯定又忘了！你会帮我拿来吧！？

scripts.text: I've requested something from the Arunafeltz office but haven't gotten anything yet. Could you get it from Hansenne?
scripts.translation: 我向阿鲁纳菲兹办公室申请了些东西，但还没收到。你能去找汉森娜拿一下吗？

scripts.text: I need that for the meeting, but he never sends it to me. He must've forgotten about it, again! You'll help me with this, right!?
scripts.translation: 我开会需要那份文件，可她一直没送来。她肯定又忘了！你会帮我拿来吧！？

scripts.text: Huh? Are you serious???? Dropped it on a bridge while playing treasure hunting???
scripts.translation: 什么？你是认真的吗？？？玩寻宝游戏时把它掉在桥上了？？？

scripts.text: Hansenne! What and itiot! I knew it! His brain must've been melted with hot air!
scripts.translation: 汉森娜！你这个白痴！我就知道！她脑子肯定被热气蒸坏了！

scripts.text: What the heck should I do??? The meesting's soon!!!
scripts.translation: 我该怎么办？？？会议马上就要开始了！！！

scripts.text: Oh my! I really, prefer to work alone. Oh, I hate those guys!
scripts.translation: 天哪！我还是更喜欢独自工作。我讨厌那些人！

scripts.text: .....Whew... completely soaked, so loosely binded...torn here and there... I can't even read this thing!
scripts.translation: ......呼......文件全湿透了，装订松松垮垮......到处都破了......我根本看不清上面的内容！

scripts.text: What is he expecting from me with this!!!!
scripts.translation: 他到底想让我拿这东西做什么！！！
啊啊啊啊！！！简直是场噩梦！

scripts.text: Huh? Are you serious???? Dropped it on a bridge while playing treasure hunting???
scripts.translation: 什么？你是认真的吗？？？玩寻宝游戏时把它掉在桥上了？？？

scripts.text: Hansenne! What and idiot! I knew it! His brain must've been melted with hot air!
scripts.translation: 汉森娜！你这个白痴！我就知道！她脑子肯定被热气蒸坏了！

scripts.text: What the heck should I do??? The meesting's soon!!!
scripts.translation: 我该怎么办？？？会议马上就要开始了！！！

scripts.text: Oh my! I really, prefer to work alone. Oh, I hate those guys!
scripts.translation: 天哪！我还是更喜欢独自工作。我讨厌那些人！

scripts.text: This is the document I requested.
I thought the document was lost at some bridge and ruined completely, but then...
scripts.translation: 我还以为它掉在某座桥上，彻底毁了......没想到......

scripts.text: Wow... this document is amazingly neat. Looks like Hue's the one who made this... He's really picky, if you know what I mean... Anyway, it's pretty impressive...
scripts.translation: 哇......这份文件整理得真整齐。看来是休整理的......他做事真是一丝不苟，你懂的......总之，真令人佩服......

scripts.text: I'm so relieved I got this before the meeting. I've got to go now.
scripts.translation: 能在会议前拿到这份文件，真是松了口气。我得走了。

scripts.text: But first, I have to find another document for the meeting. Could you please ask the Official to wait for me a bit?
scripts.translation: 不过，我还得找另一份会议文件。能麻烦你请那位官员稍等一会儿吗？

scripts.text: Please, the meeting's gonna begin soon.
scripts.translation: 拜托，会议马上就要开始了。

scripts.text: How could I go to the meeting without the research report??!
scripts.translation: 没有研究报告，我怎么去开会？！

scripts.text: Oh my! I really, prefer to work alone. Oh, I hate those guys!
scripts.translation: 天哪！我还是更喜欢独自工作。我讨厌那些人！

scripts.text: Could you please ask the Official to wait for me a bit?
scripts.translation: 能麻烦你请那位官员稍等一会儿吗？

scripts.text: I have to find another document for the meeting. Please, hurry.
scripts.translation: 我还得找另一份会议文件。拜托，快一点。

scripts.text: Ah..... That... in that meeting room... Is.. everything alright now?
Oh, I need to be left alone for a while.
scripts.translation: 哦，我想一个人静一会儿。

scripts.text: I know, I know! I went too far!
scripts.translation: 我知道，我知道！我做得太过分了！

scripts.text: I was just so shocked and disappointed at the same time.
scripts.translation: 我当时只是又震惊又失望。

scripts.text: After all, it was just a cake...
scripts.translation: 说到底，那不过是一块蛋糕......

scripts.text: Wait! Hue wanted me to bring this to you.
scripts.translation: 等等！休让我把这个交给你。

scripts.text: Ahhh... the one I left in the meeting room...
scripts.translation: 啊......是我落在会议室里的那份......

scripts.text: - at the memo stuck on it. -
Oh. What are you talking about?
Oh, I didn't expect to get an apology. This is such a shame.
scripts.translation: 哦，没想到他会来道歉。我真惭愧。

scripts.text: Now that I think of it. I didn't even say 'thank you' to him for restoring my documents...
scripts.translation: 说起来，我甚至没对他道谢，感谢他帮我修复了档案......

scripts.text: Ok. I should setup another meeting ASAP. That way, we'd have a chance to get to know each other.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我应该尽快再安排一次会议。这样大家就有机会互相了解了。

scripts.text: So... Could you do me another favor?
Could you go see the Official in my stead and set up a meeting?
scripts.translation: 你能替我去见那位官员，安排一次会议吗？

scripts.text: Oh! And... Here's Rune-Midgarts' fresh strawberry cake. This is for you. I'm so sorry I haven't even offered you a piece. I was so distracted with stress, I think.
scripts.translation: 哦！还有......这块卢恩·米德加尔特的新鲜草莓蛋糕送给你。很抱歉之前压力太大、心烦意乱，连一块都没分给你。

scripts.text: Thank you so much for everything you've done. And... pleade don't forget to do me this last favor, going to the Official and setting up a meeting.
scripts.translation: 非常感谢你为我做的一切。还有......别忘了帮我最后一个忙，去找那位官员安排会议。

scripts.text: I... think I should prepare for the meeting again.
scripts.translation: 我......觉得我得重新为会议做些准备。

scripts.text: Ok. I should setup another meeting ASAP. That way, we'd have a chance to get to know each other.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我应该尽快再安排一次会议。这样我们就有机会互相了解了。

scripts.text: Could you go see the Official in my stead and set up a meeting?
scripts.translation: 你能替我去见那位官员，安排一次会议吗？

scripts.text: I... think I should prepare for the meeting again.
scripts.translation: 我...觉得我得重新为会议做些准备。

scripts.text: I don't know how to thank you.
scripts.translation: 我真不知道该怎么感谢你。

scripts.text: You can't imagine how greatful I feel!
scripts.translation: 你无法想象我有多感激！

scripts.text: Oh, but then... Have you ever seen a ^0000ffMystic Horn^000000? I'd love to get one.
scripts.translation: 哦，对了......你^0000ff见过魔力之角^000000吗？我很想要一个。

scripts.text: I heard you can get this thing from a monster named, 'Cornus' found in the fields.
scripts.translation: 听说野外有种叫作“科尔努斯”的魔物会掉落。

scripts.text: Or... do you have any ^0000ffMystic Horns^000000 with you? Of course, I'm not saying that I want it for free. If you'd give me ^0000ff2 Mystic Horns^000000, I'd give you my Rune-Midgarts' Strawberry Cake.
scripts.translation: 或者....^0000ff..你身上^000000有魔力之角吗？我不是白要。你要是给我2个魔力之^0000ff角，我就把^000000卢恩·米德加尔特草莓蛋糕给你。

scripts.text: I haven't seen such a thing.
If by any chance you find one, please come back to me.
scripts.translation: 如果你碰巧找到一个，记得回来找我。
你居然有卢恩·米德加尔特草莓蛋糕？

scripts.text: How come you haven't had it yet?
You should quickly finish that cake or else, somebody would steal it from you.
scripts.translation: 快点把蛋糕吃掉，不然会被别人偷走的。

scripts.text: Are you really, honestly, positively sure you want to exchange them for my cake?
scripts.translation: 你真的确定要用它们换我的蛋糕吗？

scripts.text: Come back any time if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 改变主意的话，随时回来找我。

scripts.text: I heard you could extract some magical energy form Mystic Horns and use it. Anyway, thank you!
scripts.translation: 我听说能从魔力之角中提取魔力并加以利用。总之，谢谢你！

scripts.text: You lie! You don't even have any!!
Please, if you find any Mystic Horns, come back to me!
scripts.translation: 拜托了，找到魔力之角的话就回来找我！

scripts.text: You know somethig... Something comes out from this thing...
scripts.translation: 你知道吗......这东西里好像有什么东西出来了......

scripts.text: If anyone tried to talk to you in the middle of the night, you should just walk away... Don't ever look back!!
scripts.translation: 如果半夜有人试图和你说话，直接走开......千万别回头！！

scripts.text: And don't stare at the crack of dimension... or you'd be dragged to somewhere mysterious and never be able to come back...huhuhuhu...
scripts.translation: 也别盯着次元裂缝看......否则你会被拖到某个神秘的地方，再也回不来......呵呵呵......

scripts.text: How come you've got so much to carry?
scripts.translation: 你怎么带了这么多东西？

scripts.text: Are you perhaps on training or something?
Don't walk around this place without thinking.
scripts.translation: 别不假思索地四处乱逛。

scripts.text: After all, it'll be you who'd be in trouble.
scripts.translation: 到时候惹上麻烦的可是你自己。

scripts.text: You can't just come and go around as you please here. This is a restricted area.
scripts.translation: 你不能在这里随意进出。这是限制区域。

scripts.text: I came to show you this.
Haha. You expect me to accept this?
scripts.translation: 哈哈。你真以为我会接受这个？

scripts.text: As always, scheduling things as they want, report to us to accept it...
scripts.translation: 他们总是自作主张安排好一切，再把通知送来要我们接受......

scripts.text: I can't think of any other words to describe them, except for this word: RUDE!
scripts.translation: 除了“无礼”这个词，我找不到其他词来形容他们了。

scripts.text: Never ever asking for our opinion and always delivering things through some strangers... By the way, no offense...
scripts.translation: 从来不征求我们的意见，总是派陌生人来传达......顺便说一句，我不是针对你......

scripts.text: THey don't ever take the official route! Rune-Midgartish way of reporting! Very unprofessional!
scripts.translation: 他们从来不走正规渠道！这就是卢恩·米德加尔特式的办事方式！太不专业了！

scripts.text: Anyway, what is this meeting about?
scripts.translation: 总之，这次会议是关于什么的？

scripts.text: Give it to me. I should read it at least.
scripts.translation: 给我看看。至少我得读一读。

scripts.text: You should have some Sand chips while I'm reading this. Don't expect any taste, it's from Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation: 我读的时候，你可以吃点沙粒。别指望好吃，这是阿鲁纳菲兹来的。

scripts.text: You can't go around this place as you want. This is a restricted area.
scripts.translation: 你不能在这里随意走动。这是限制区域。

scripts.text: ...Meeting Schedule, on the Xth day, from hh:mm to hh:mm...

scripts.translation: 地点......卢恩·米德加尔特营地......

scripts.text: Ha! I knew it. Rune-Midgarts' camp again!
scripts.translation: 哈！我就知道，又是在卢恩·米德加尔特营地！

scripts.text: Objectives... to report on the researching progress of tracking Satan Morocc and the Ash-Vacuum!
scripts.translation: 目标......汇报追踪魔王梦罗克和研究阿什真空的进展！

scripts.text: Having some time to get to know each other??? Haaaaa!
scripts.translation: 还安排了时间让大家互相了解？？？哈！

scripts.text: Well, thank you for entertaining me. You should tell Ryosen that.
scripts.translation: 好吧，你可真会逗我。替我告诉良泉吧。

scripts.text: Well, you should also tell him that I think he's very talented in settin up comedy. Hahaha.
scripts.translation: 嗯，也告诉他，我觉得他很有喜剧天赋。哈哈哈。

scripts.text: You mean this meeting's for real???
scripts.translation: 你是说这会议是认真的？？？

scripts.text: I have never seen an official invitation to be this stupid-looking!
scripts.translation: 我从没见过这么寒酸的正式邀请函！

scripts.text: - Hue got so furious and pressed the pen so hard that the ball point got pushed in. Then he threw the document after signing it. -
scripts.translation: - 休气得用力按笔，笔尖都戳进去了。签完字后，他把文件扔了出去。 -

scripts.text: Well, at least I respect that Ryosen hasn't forgotten the reporting order. So, you're off to Arunafeltz now?
scripts.translation: 好吧，至少我尊重良泉没有忘记报告顺序。那么，你现在要去阿鲁纳菲兹了？

scripts.text: You'll experience some hard time talking to Hansenne... It'll be like testing your patience.
scripts.translation: 和汉森娜打交道会很辛苦......简直是在考验你的耐心。

scripts.text: Wait a few more minutes, I didn't finish reading it!
scripts.translation: 再等几分钟，我还没读完呢！

scripts.text: You should have some Sand chips while I'm reading this. Don't expect any taste, it's from Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation: 在我读这个的时候，你可以吃点沙粒。别指望有什么味道，这是从阿鲁纳菲兹来的。

scripts.text: I'm not sure if everyone from Arunafeltz is like him, but, it'll be like testing your patience to get Hansenne to read this thing.
scripts.translation: 我不知道阿鲁纳菲兹的人是不是都像她那样，但让汉森娜读完这份文件肯定会考验你的耐心。

scripts.text: You can trust me on that one. Good luck.
scripts.translation: 这点你尽管信我。祝你好运。

scripts.text: What is this stupid looking pile of documents?
scripts.translation: 这堆乱七八糟的文件是什么？

scripts.text: Is this the file Ryosen requested from Hansenne??? The one which is all ruined...?
scripts.translation: 这是良泉向汉森娜要的那份文件？？？就是被弄得一团糟的那份......？

scripts.text: Ha! Tsk,tsk! Is this some kind of joke?! Who'd manage the files like this? I'd never know!
scripts.translation: 哈！啧啧！这是在开玩笑吗？！谁会这样整理档案？真叫人想不通！

scripts.text: Whew... I can't even stand looking at it! Oh just, give it to me!
scripts.translation: 呼......我都不忍心看！算了，拿给我吧！

scripts.text: Too bad I'm not in Schwarzwald. I could use our document restoring machine back at home... Ugh! Now I gotta do everything manually.
scripts.translation: 真可惜我不在修瓦尔兹巴鲁德。要是在家，我还能用文件修复机......唉！现在只能手动处理了。

scripts.text: Hmmm. It's completely soaked. I Should dry this thing first and iron these crumples. Then, I should restore the texts.
scripts.translation: 嗯，文件完全湿透了。我得先把它晾干、熨平褶皱，然后修复上面的文字。

scripts.text: I need some materials. You gotta help me on this. I need ^0000ff1 Fan, 1 Old Frying Pan, 1 Flame Stone, 1 Chinese Ink^000000.
scripts.translation: 我需要些材料，你得帮我。我要扇子1把^0000ff、破旧平底锅1个、火灵原石1个、墨汁1^000000份。

scripts.text: Hey, hey... don't look at me like that. I know you're not delighted to do these things but think about it, what about me? Why should I restore this garbage?
scripts.translation: 嘿，别那样看着我。我知道你不乐意做这些事，可想想我呢？我为什么要修这堆垃圾？

scripts.text: Listen, sometimes, we've got to do things we don't like in order to get things accomplished.
scripts.translation: 听着，有时为了把事情办成，我们不得不做些自己不喜欢的事。

scripts.text: Just don't gorget that the file will be restored as fast as you prepare those things for me.
scripts.translation: 别忘了，材料准备得越快，我就能越快修好这份文件。

scripts.text: I wonder if the preparation for the meeting's going ok.
scripts.translation: 不知道会议准备得怎么样了。

scripts.text: I heard Ryosen say that the file he requested from Hansenne is all ruined. I hope I dont get involved in that trouble.
scripts.translation: 我听说良泉向汉森娜要的文件全毁了。希望我不会被卷进这场麻烦。

scripts.text: I have no time to waste.
Could you please sit there and wait for me while I restore this file?
scripts.translation: 请坐在那里等我修复这份文件。

scripts.text: Hmmm. It's completely soaked. I Should dry this thing first and iron these crumples. Then, I should restore the texts.
scripts.translation: 嗯，文件完全湿透了。我得先把它晾干、熨平褶皱，然后修复上面的文字。

scripts.text: I need some materials. You gotta help me on this. I need ^0000ff1 Fan, 1 Old Frying Pan, 1 Flame Stone, 1 Chinese Ink^000000.
scripts.translation: 我需要些材料，你得帮我。我要扇子1把^0000ff、破旧平底锅1个、火灵原石1个、墨汁1^000000份。

scripts.text: Just don't gorget that the file will be restored as fast as you prepare those things for me.
scripts.translation: 别忘了，材料准备得越快，我就能越快修好这份文件。

scripts.text: The binding was too loose, so I re-arranged and bound the file all over again. This is how the true official document should look like. I really think they should learn how to arrange files.
scripts.translation: 装订太松了，所以我重新整理并装订了这份档案。这才像正式文件的样子。我真觉得他们该学学怎么整理档案。

scripts.text: Please, deliver this file before it's too late. The meeting's gonna begin soon.
scripts.translation: 趁会议还没开始，赶紧把这份文件送过去。

scripts.text: I have to be extra careful with this kind of work, ok? Can't you sit quietly over there? Take a nap or something.
scripts.translation: 这种工作我得格外小心，明白吗？你不能在那边安静坐会儿吗？打个盹什么的。

scripts.text: The binding was too loose, so I re-arranged and bound the file all over again. This is how the true official document should look like. I really think they should learn how to arrange files.
scripts.translation: 装订太松了，所以我重新整理并装订了这份档案。这才像正式文件的样子。我真觉得他们该学学怎么整理档案。

scripts.text: Please, deliver this file before it's too late. The meeting's gonna begin soon.
scripts.translation: 趁会议还没开始，赶紧把这份文件送过去。

scripts.text: Well, finally... It's time for the meeting.
Like it or not... I should go in.
scripts.translation: 不管愿不愿意......我都得进去。

scripts.text: - Looks like he's thinking about something... very seriously. -
scripts.translation: - 看起来他正在非常认真地思考...... -

scripts.text: I just decided I can't stay like this.
scripts.translation: 我刚下定决心，不能再这样下去了。

scripts.text: I couldn't confess the truth when Hansenne said he ruined the cake instead of me.
scripts.translation: 汉森娜替我承认是她弄坏了蛋糕，可我当时没能说出真相。

scripts.text: I was so bewildered that I lost the chance to say anything... but... I was such a coward to admit that I was the one who caused the trouble.
scripts.translation: 我当时太慌乱，错过了开口的机会......可是......我实在太懦弱，不敢承认是我惹的祸。

scripts.text: Oh, I'm so embarrassed to see him face to face. Or.. how about...
scripts.translation: 啊，和他面对面太尴尬了。要不......这样如何......

scripts.text: Here, this is the Rune-Midgarts' report I took with me when everything went messy in the meeting room. Could you please give this to Ryosen?
scripts.translation: 这个，是会议室一片混乱时我带走的卢恩·米德加尔特报告。能请你把它交给良泉吗？

scripts.text: I'm sorry to ask you this but...
Could you? For this, I'll give you some Schwarzwald's Pineapple Jubilee.
scripts.translation: 能帮我这个忙吗？作为回报，我给你一些修瓦尔兹巴鲁德的菠萝庆典。

scripts.text: Please give this report to Ryosen.
scripts.translation: 请把这份报告交给良泉。

scripts.text: Oh, I'm so embarrassed to see him face to face. Or.. how about...
scripts.translation: 啊，和他面对面太尴尬了。要不...这样如何...

scripts.text: Here, this is the Rune-Midgarts' report I took with me when everything went messy in the meeting room. Could you please give this to Ryosen?
scripts.translation: 这个，是会议室一片混乱时我带走的卢恩·米德加尔特报告。能请你把它交给良泉吗？

scripts.text: I'm sorry to ask you this but...
If it weren't for you, we wouldn't be able to get along at all.
scripts.translation: 要不是你，我们根本没法和好。

scripts.text: I don't know how to thank you!
scripts.translation: 真不知道该怎么感谢你！

scripts.text: Have you ever seen something called, ^0000ffFur^000000 ?
I hear you can get it from the monsters called 'Tatacho' and 'Hillsrion' in the fields.
scripts.translation: 听说野外的塔塔乔和希尔里昂会掉落这种东西。

scripts.text: Could you bring ^0000ffFur^000000 if you get some? I'm not asking it for free.
scripts.translation: 如果你找^0000ff到毛皮^000000，能带些给我吗？我不会白拿。

scripts.text: I'll give you my Pineapple Jubilee from Schwarzwald, if you bring me ^0000ff2 Furs^000000.
scripts.translation: 你给我2片毛皮的话，我就把修瓦尔兹巴鲁德的^0000ff菠萝庆典给^000000你。

scripts.text: I don't have any, right now.
Please give me some when you get some.
scripts.translation: 等你弄到了请给我一些。

scripts.text: You already have the Pineapple Jubilee from Schwarzwald!
scripts.translation: 你已经拥有修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德的菠萝庆典了！

scripts.text: I think you should drin that thing fast. Otherwise, all the ice will melt and it'll taste like some kinda medicine!
scripts.translation: 我觉得你应该趁冰还没化，赶紧把它喝掉。否则味道会变得像药一样！

scripts.text: Ah, are you sure you want to exchange?
Oh, so it's the thing called, Fur??
scripts.translation: 哦，就是那个叫毛皮的东西吗？

scripts.text: Are you sure you want to exchange this for my Pineapple Jubilee?
scripts.translation: 你确定要用这个换我的菠萝庆典吗？

scripts.text: Come back any time if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 如果你改变主意，随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text: I always needed this because the weather here is colder then I expected. I'm sure this will keep me warm.
scripts.translation: 这里比我预想的冷多了。我正好需要这个，穿上它肯定会暖和些。

scripts.text: Well, I don't think you have any Fur.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我想你应该没有毛皮。

scripts.text: Please come back if you find any Fur.
scripts.translation: 如果你找到毛皮，请回来找我。

scripts.text: Don't walk around this area. It's restricted.
scripts.translation: 不要在这个区域走动。这里是禁区。

scripts.text: Don't walk around this place without thinking.
scripts.translation: 不要不假思索地四处走动。

scripts.text: After all, it'll be you who'd be in trouble.
scripts.translation: 毕竟，惹上麻烦的会是你自己。

scripts.text: How come you've got so much to carry?
scripts.translation: 你怎么带了这么多东西？

scripts.text: Are you perhaps on training or something?
scripts.translation: 难道是在进行什么训练吗？
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。
嗯？什么事把你带到这里来了？

scripts.text: Of course, your feet brought you here!?!
scripts.translation: 当然是你的脚把你带来的咯！
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Hmm, Ryosen from Rune-Midgarts made it and... Hue from Schwarzwald agreed to sign it too?
scripts.translation: 嗯，卢恩·米德加尔特的良泉拟了这份邀请......而且修瓦尔兹巴鲁德的休也同意签字了？

scripts.text: Hmmm, that's not funny at all.
They're so boring. They always report to me after making all the decisions. No sense of humor... so stubborn and strict... They're totally not my style.
scripts.translation: 他们真无聊。总是先把所有事情决定好，再来通知我。一点幽默感都没有......既固执又严肃......完全不是我的风格。

scripts.text: I should have a look at least.
You should take a rest, while I'm reading this. Oh, have some Poring Candy from Rune-Midgarts. It's terribly sour and sometimes salty. Funny taste, huh?
scripts.translation: 我读的时候，你休息一下吧。哦，吃点卢恩·米德加尔特的波利糖。酸得要命，有时还带点咸味。味道很有趣，对吧？
嗯？你是卢恩·米德加尔特的人？

scripts.text: Then where's the person from Rude Midgard? Hahahahah, do you get my joke?
scripts.translation: 那“无礼·米德加尔特”的人呢？哈哈哈哈，懂我的笑话吗？
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: - Hansenne drops some kind of liquid on the file document, and carefully looks at it. -
scripts.translation: - 汉森娜往文件上滴了些液体，仔细查看。 -

scripts.text: Meeting Schedule... on the Umpth day, from then-o'clock to later-o'clock
scripts.translation: 会议日程......某某日，从某某点到某某点。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Meeting Schedule, shmeating schedule... Beating Schedule!!
scripts.translation: 会议日程，什么会议日程......打人日程！！
地点......卢恩·米德加尔特营地！

scripts.text: Are they camping in that place??
scripts.translation: 他们居然在那种地方扎营？？
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Objectives... to report on the researching progress of tracking Satan Morocc and of the Ash-Vacuum!
scripts.translation: 目标......汇报追踪魔王梦罗克和研究阿什真空的进展！

scripts.text: Ash-Vacuum... what is that, a homemaker's device???
scripts.translation: .....那是什么，家用吸尘器吗？？？哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: ...and a very useless one which vacuums only ash!
scripts.translation: ......而且还是只能吸灰烬的废物吸尘器！
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Ehhhhh? And what's this? Having some time to get to know each other??? ...Pffthahahahaha...
scripts.translation: 诶？这是什么？还有时间互相认识一下？？？......噗哈哈哈......
嘿，就在这上面签个字吧。
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: I can't help it! I can't stand this! What the heck!!! What do we have to know about each other???
scripts.translation: 我忍不住了！实在受不了！搞什么啊！！！我们有什么好互相了解的？？？
噗哈哈，这太不可思议了。

scripts.text: Ryosen's avery funny guy. Well, he wouldn't know how funny he is...
scripts.translation: 良泉真是个有趣的人。不过，他自己大概不知道自己有多有趣......

scripts.text: Haha, you should tell him that.

scripts.translation: 哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Ahhh, wait. I didn't finish reading it.

scripts.translation: 哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Hush! Please don't talk! We must pray now!
scripts.translation: 嘘！别说话！我们现在要祈祷！

scripts.text: I got it, I got it. I should go to the meeting. Ryosen's really a funny guy, if you know what I mean.
scripts.translation: 知道了，知道了。我该去开会了。良泉真是个有趣的人，你懂我的意思吧。

scripts.text: Please, thank him for entertaining me. Haha, hahaha,
scripts.translation: 请替我谢谢他逗我开心。哈哈，哈哈哈，

scripts.text: I came to pick up the requested document.
You missed me? Don't expect a kiss!
scripts.translation: 你想我了？别指望我会亲你哦！
哈哈，哈哈哈，哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈。

scripts.text: A requested document? Did Ryosen send you?
scripts.translation: 要领取一份文件？是良泉派你来的吗？

scripts.text: Wait for me here. Now, where did I put it...?
scripts.translation: 你在这里等我。我把它放哪儿了......？
