scripts.translation: *呼噜* 哦，我们提供的服务和卡普拉公司的位置保存、仓库、传送等服务差不多。

scripts.text: The only difference is that, our services are limited depending on the customer's credit.
scripts.translation: 唯一的区别是，我们提供的服务会根据顾客的信用点数而有所限制。

scripts.text: As you might know already, we're a considerably small company struggling to make ends meet in this niche market.
scripts.translation: 你可能已经知道了，我们是一家规模不大的公司，在这个小众市场里勉强维持经营。

scripts.text: We desperately need your support to grow.
scripts.translation: 我们迫切需要你的支持，才能发展壮大。

scripts.text: You can increase your credit by helping us secure our food or by collecting minerals.
scripts.translation: 你可以通过帮我们获取食物或收集矿石来增加信用点数。

scripts.text: The more credits you earn, the more services you can use. You can also apply for special events.
scripts.translation: 信用点数越多，能使用的服务就越多。你还可以申请参加特别活动。

scripts.text: Say, how'd you like to make a membership contract with us?
scripts.translation: 那么，你愿意和我们签订会员契约吗？

scripts.text: I need to think it over.
Excellent! Thank you for joining the Cat Trading membership service.
scripts.translation: 太好了！感谢你加入猫爪贸易会员服务。

scripts.text: We hope you'll support our exploration of this unknown land.
scripts.translation: 希望你能支持我们探索这片未知的土地。

scripts.text: Please go speak to the Cat Paw Agent over there to use a basic service.
scripts.translation: 请去那边和猫爪特工对话，以使用基础服务。

scripts.text: Oh, and please come back afterwards.
We offer one service to new customers.
scripts.translation: 我们为新客户提供一项服务。

scripts.text: If you want to use more services, you must do some things for us.
scripts.translation: 如果你想使用更多服务，就得为我们做些事。

scripts.text: Please catch the main dish of the Cat Trading employees, fish, and collect minerals once every day.
scripts.translation: 请每天帮猫爪贸易员工捕捉主食——鱼，并收集一次矿石。

scripts.text: Your credit will increase each day if you do those things.
scripts.translation: 完成这些事，每天都能增加信用点数。

scripts.text: Of course, we'll reward you with a reasonable amount of EXP for the services.
scripts.translation: 当然，我们会为你提供相应的经验值作为报酬。

scripts.text: This is a good opportunity to increase your credit and EXP ate the same time.
scripts.translation: 这是个同时赚取信用点数和经验值的好机会。

scripts.text: Doesn't that sound like a win-win situation?
Would you like to start now?
I need to go prepare first.
For more information about fishing and mining, please speak to the two Cat Agents standing at the river over there.
scripts.translation: 如需了解钓鱼和采矿的更多信息，请去那边河边找两位猫爪特工对话。

scripts.text: For more information about fishing and mining, please speak to the two Cat Agents standing at the river over there.
scripts.translation: 如需了解钓鱼和采矿的更多信息，请去那边河边找两位猫爪特工对话。

scripts.text: Your current credit points with us are ^0000FF{0}^000000.
scripts.translation: 你目前在我们这里的信用点数为^0000FF{0}^000000。

scripts.text: How can I increase my points?
You can increase them daily by fishing and mining, you need to submit caught Pieces of Fish to Gorurung and minerals to the Mining Agent.
scripts.translation: 每天钓鱼和采矿都能增加积分。请把钓到的鱼块交给戈鲁鲁格，把矿石交给采矿特工。

scripts.text: A cat purring like a lion
Oh, you are here to fish? *Purr*
You need to catch fish. There are schools of fish in the waters.
It's hard to see them but if you use your cursor to click around, you should be able to catch them.
scripts.translation: 虽然不太容易看见，但用光标在附近点击，就能抓到鱼。

scripts.text: It's easier to fish in the water outside the town.
scripts.translation: 在城镇外的水域钓鱼更容易。

scripts.text: If you're not afraid of monsters, you can go fishing over there.
scripts.translation: 如果你不怕魔物，可以去那边钓鱼。

scripts.text: Now, let me teach you how to fish.
It's simple: bring your cursor to a school of fish, and then click it to grab them.
scripts.translation: 很简单：把光标移到鱼群上，再点击抓鱼。

scripts.text: You'll have a hard time to catch them at first, but you'll get better.
scripts.translation: 一开始你可能很难抓到，但熟练之后就会容易些。

scripts.text: It gets easier with a bit of practice.
Bring your cursor to a school of fish, then click it to grab them.
scripts.translation: 把光标移到鱼群上，再点击抓鱼。

scripts.text: Do you want to fish again?
Pieces of Fish if you catch them.
Hey, I've been waiting for you!
Gorurug looks happy to see you.
scripts.translation: 戈鲁鲁格看到你很高兴。

scripts.text: What do you want to catch today? *Purr*
Gorurung welcomes you with a happy purr.
scripts.translation: 戈鲁鲁格欢快地呼噜着迎接你。

scripts.text: You're here to give me fishes, aren't you?
scripts.translation: 你是来给我送鱼的，对吧？
凶猛的戈鲁鲁格正在睡觉。

scripts.text: I can't accept any fish right now.
scripts.translation: 我现在下班了，暂时不能收鱼。

scripts.text: Another day has started, back to work!
scripts.translation: 新的一天开始了，继续工作！

scripts.text: You can now bring me fish if you catch them.
scripts.translation: 如果你抓到了鱼，现在可以带给我了。

scripts.text: Fish are swimming in the water.
Congratulations, you've caught a precious Marlin.
scripts.translation: 恭喜，你抓到了一条珍贵的旗鱼。

scripts.text: I'll give you 2 Cat Trading Points in exchange for your Marlin.
scripts.translation: 作为交换，我将给你2点猫爪贸易积分。

scripts.text: I got them from a black marketer,
scripts.translation: 这些积分是我从黑市商人那里弄来的，

scripts.text: but I guarantee the authenticity of these points.
scripts.translation: 但我保证积分货真价实。

scripts.text: I've given you the points in return.
You may go check your points through the Cat Paw Agent.
scripts.translation: 你可以向猫爪特工查询积分。

scripts.text: But feel free to come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 如果改变主意，随时欢迎回来。
这条河里有很多稀有鱼类。

scripts.text: this river is full of rare fish.

scripts.translation: 我跟着这些猫来到这里，

scripts.text: to see if the rumor is true.

scripts.translation: 传说中的银色鱼类——旗鱼，

scripts.text: fish is the best prey of all.

scripts.translation: 你还可以钓到漂浮在河里的珍贵宝物。

scripts.text: If you happen to catch a Marlin,
Thank you for collecting minerals for me.

scripts.translation: 我快冻僵了！快把它们拿走。

scripts.text: Yes, yes~ I've received the mineral samples.
scripts.translation: 是的，是的～我已经收到矿石样本了。

scripts.text: I'll go ahead and add points to your credit.
scripts.translation: 我会把积分记入你的账户。

scripts.text: we have to go to the

scripts.translation: 可我这样的短毛猫实在
看起来对你来说也很冷，

scripts.text: I hope you'll bring me minerals again tomorrow...
scripts.translation: 希望你明天还能给我带矿石来......

scripts.text: If you can. It's much better to wait for you to do it than go there on my own.
scripts.translation: 如果方便的话。比起自己去，等你帮忙轻松多了。

scripts.text: Umm... It's time to collect minerals.
How'd you like to collect minerals for me?
scripts.translation: 你愿意帮我收集一些吗？
这块岩石含有尚未鉴定的矿石。

scripts.text: It's not possible to mine more than the limit.
scripts.translation: 无法开采超过上限的数量。

scripts.text: You can enter the number between 1~3000.
*Sigh* Look at me, I used to command the desert of Morocc, but I've been deployed to a world that only God knows where...
scripts.translation: *叹气* 看看我，以前我还指挥着梦罗克沙漠，如今却被派到这片连神明都不知道在哪儿的异世界......

scripts.text: Come on'that's not ture. In fact, you used to be an official of a small town, and have been promoted to the commander of the expedition.
scripts.translation: 别这么说，这可不是真的。你以前只是小镇的一名官员，后来升任远征队指挥官。

scripts.text: Your success is almost too good to be true.
scripts.translation: 你的晋升顺利得简直令人难以置信。

scripts.text: Hey, boss. Can we just go through the motions until we get out of here? This so-called Ash-Vacuum is boring. It's heaven for the kingdom's scholars, but it's not for me.
scripts.translation: 嘿，老板。我们能不能敷衍一下，赶紧离开这里？这个所谓的“阿什真空”太无聊了。对王国的学者来说是天堂，对我可不是。

scripts.text: Geez, do you have to keep calling me boss? It's Commander, alright?
scripts.translation: 天哪，你非得一直叫我老板吗？要叫指挥官，懂吗？

scripts.text: Who are you? What business do you have with Commander Agip?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？找阿吉普指挥官有什么事？

scripts.text: Err? Hey, aren't you that famous adventurer,{0}? I've heard many good things about you.
scripts.translation: 咦？嘿，你难道就是那位著名的冒{0}险者？我听说过很多关于你的事。

scripts.text: I don't know what you're talking about. Boss, do you know this adventurer?
scripts.translation: 我不知道你在说什么。老板，你认识这位冒险者吗？

scripts.text: Stop calling me boss! Call me Commander, alright? Hey Abidal, is this adventurer really famous?
scripts.translation: 别叫我老板！叫我指挥官，懂吗？嘿，阿比达尔，这位冒险者真的很有名吗？

scripts.text: Commander, haven't you read the report? The adventurer who helped the expedition solve the XX case was{0}.
scripts.translation: 指挥官，你没看报告吗？帮助远征队解决XX事件的冒险者就是{0}。

scripts.text: *Ahem Ahem* I see. I've been too busy to read all the reports. So what brings you here? A reward?
scripts.translation: *咳咳* 原来如此。我最近太忙，没空看完所有报告。你来这里做什么？想要报酬吗？

scripts.text: This is perfect. I was going to send a messenger to you for an important discussion.
scripts.translation: 真是巧了。我正准备派信使去找你，有一件重要的事要商量。

scripts.text: Hey Abidal, he's here to see me, not you. Remember?
scripts.translation: 嘿，阿比达尔，他是来见我的，不是见你的。记住了吗？

scripts.text: Commander, please let me talk. {0}I'd like to talk to you privately. Can you come back later?
scripts.translation: 指挥官，请让我说完{0}。我想和你私下谈谈。你能稍后再来吗？

scripts.text: Why do you want to talk privately?
Is it because of me? Grrr... I'll be watching you, Abidal.
scripts.translation: 是因为我吗？哼......阿比达尔，我会盯着你的。

scripts.text: What are you still doing here? Go, go speak to Abidal.
scripts.translation: 你还在这里干什么？去吧，去和阿比达尔对话。

scripts.text: I'm not the one who has business with you. You should go speak to Staff Officer Abidal.
scripts.translation: 有事找你的人不是我。你应该去和参谋阿比达尔谈谈。

scripts.text: Oh yes, right... You're{0}, right? Abidal has told me good things about you.
scripts.translation: 哦，对了......{0}你是，对吧？阿比达尔跟我说过不少关于你的好话。

scripts.text: We're lucky to have you, my friend... I hope you're as good as the stories play you up to be.
scripts.translation: 有你这样的人帮忙真是太好了，朋友......希望你确实名副其实。

scripts.text: Alright, alright. gosh will you stop yelling at me?
scripts.translation: 好了好了，天哪，你能不能别对我大吼大叫？

scripts.text: You're not going to live long if you get angry at all the little things.
scripts.translation: 什么小事都生气的话，你可活不长。

scripts.text: Anyways, I took some time to check your background and reports of your accomplishments.
scripts.translation: 总之，我花了些时间查阅你的背景和功绩报告。

scripts.text: I must say that I'm quite impressed.
scripts.translation: 不得不说，我相当欣赏你。

scripts.text: As you know by now, I have to send out an expedition report to the national leaders of the Midgard continent, and I need someone that I can trust.
scripts.translation: 想必你也知道，我必须向米德加尔特大陆各国的领导人提交远征报告，而我需要一个值得信任的人。

scripts.text: I'd go if I could, but my duty is to command, and my instructor over there is too dense. He'll embarrass me by acting stupid in front of the national leaders.
scripts.translation: 要是能去，我当然想亲自去，但我的职责是指挥。那边的指导员又太迟钝，在各国领导人面前做蠢事会让我丢脸。
拜托了，老板......啊不，指挥官！

scripts.text: Hmm... Anyways, this is not a difficult mission. All you have to do is deliver this expedition report to officials of three countries of Midgard. Simple right?
scripts.translation: 嗯......总之，这任务不难。你只要把远征报告送给米德加尔特三国的官员就行了。很简单吧？

scripts.text: The officials are ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts' Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz, and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwatzvalt Republic.
scripts.translation: 这些官员分别^0000FF是：卢恩·米^000000德加尔特王国的劳尔大臣、^0000FF阿鲁纳菲兹^000000的努莉亚祭司，以及^0000FF修瓦尔兹^000000巴鲁德共和国的格哈特。

scripts.text: A messenger, who will inform the official of your arrival, is waiting for you at the time-space gap to Midgard. You'd better find him before you leave.
scripts.translation: 在通往米德加尔特的次元裂缝处，有一位信使在等你，他会通知官员你的到来。你最好在出发前找到他。

scripts.text: Since the officials are busy attending to national matters, they won't meet you unless they're informed of your arrival beforehand. I doubt those pretentious guys would even want to see me.
scripts.translation: 官员们正忙于处理国家事务，必须提前通知他们，他们才会见你。我怀疑那些自命不凡的家伙甚至都不愿意见我。

scripts.text: Travel safely, adventurer, and come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation: 旅途平安，冒险者，记得要平安回来，好吗？

scripts.text: Haven't you left yet? It's hard to make ends meet, isn't it?
scripts.translation: 你还没出发吗？生活不容易，对吧？

scripts.text: I mean, if you want to be paid, you'll have to work. Do you still not understand? I'm saying that you better proceed with your mission.
scripts.translation: 我是说，想拿报酬就得干活。你还没明白吗？赶紧去执行任务吧。

scripts.text: Alright, alright. I know why you've come to see me.
scripts.translation: 好了好了。我知道你为什么来见我了。

scripts.text: They haven't gotten the report yet. We should send out soldiers...
scripts.translation: 他们还没收到报告。我们应该派些士兵去......

scripts.text: That's not why I'm concerned. The problem is that the assignee failed to complete the mission and lost the report.
scripts.translation: 我担心的不是这个。问题是，负责的人没能完成任务，还把报告弄丢了。

scripts.text: Anyways... It's alright. You don't have to feel bad. I understand you didn't mean it this way.
scripts.translation: 总之......没关系。你不用难过，我知道你不是故意的。

scripts.text: Commander, who might have done this? I will destroy him myself.
scripts.translation: 指挥官，是谁干的？我要亲手收拾他。

scripts.text: Don't impose. Our troops aren't just from one nation, they are from thre different countries, and are here to pursue their country's own interest.
scripts.translation: 别冲动。我们的部队来自三个不同的国家，他们各自代表本国的利益。

scripts.text: Hard to say... who is behind this. If I had to guess, either side could be behind this...
scripts.translation: 很难说......幕后黑手是谁。如果非要猜，任何一方都有可能......

scripts.text: *Spit* This is why I don't trust politicians. Abidal, resolving this incident is your top priority.
scripts.translation: *啐* 这就是我不信任政客的原因。阿比达尔，解决这次事件是你的首要任务。

scripts.text: Igrid, evaluate the security of this camp and discipline among the soldiers.
scripts.translation: 伊格丽德，评估一下营地的安全状况和士兵纪律。

scripts.text: Now it's your turn... Abidal disposed reports from various departments after he used them to compile the expedition report.
scripts.translation: 现在轮到你了......阿比达尔编写远征报告书后，就处理掉了各部门提交的报告。

scripts.text: We take the security of our documents seriously. So... There are no extra copies of the expedition report.
scripts.translation: 我们非常重视文件安全。所以......远征报告书没有副本。

scripts.text: I still remember at least 30% of the document. I might be able to rewrite another...
scripts.translation: 我至少还记得那份文件30%的内容。也许我能重新写一份......

scripts.text: I need it to be perfect. What can we do with only 30%?
scripts.translation: 我需要一份完整的报告。只有30%的内容有什么用？

scripts.text: Hey, you must find the report. If you bring as may pages of the report as you can, then Abidal will use them to fill missing parts.
scripts.translation: 嘿，你一定要找到那份报告。尽可能多地找回报告页，阿比达尔会用它们补上缺失部分。

scripts.text: Some of them might have be consumed by monsters, or have found their way to the sea, but I don't care. You'll find them at all costs, and that's my order.
scripts.translation: 有些页可能被魔物吃了，也可能掉进海里，但我不管。你必须不惜一切代价找回来，这是命令。

scripts.text: I hope you'll do your best. You need to finish what you've started. We'll do our best to help you. Am I right, guys? Abidal? Igrid?
scripts.translation: 我希望你尽力而为。既然开始了，就要做完。我们会尽力协助你。对吧，大家？阿比达尔？伊格丽德？

scripts.text: Now, search everywhere for the pages of that report. Staff Officer Abidal will bind them into the full report for you.
scripts.translation: 好了，到处去找那份报告书的页面吧。参谋阿比达尔会把它们装订成完整的报告书。

scripts.text: Ah, and... I've received a report that you tried to hand out the report to our enemy when the situation happened.
scripts.translation: 啊，还有......我收到报告说，事发时你曾试图把报告书交给敌人。

scripts.text: Hahaha! You're smart, my friend. Of course, I don't like smart soldiers.
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈！你很聪明，我的朋友。不过我可不喜欢太聪明的士兵。

scripts.text: Let me tell you this: I can care less about justice or righteousness, but loyalty and faithfulness are very important. Keep that in mind for your own good, alright?
scripts.translation: 告诉你吧，我不在乎什么正义公道，但忠诚和守信非常重要。记住这点，对你有好处，明白吗？

scripts.text: I wish you good luck in finding the pages. Try to clean any smudges off them when you find them, alright?
scripts.translation: 祝你顺利找到报告页。找到后，记得把上面的污渍擦掉，好吗？

scripts.text: Alright, alright. I know why you've come to see me.
scripts.translation: 好了好了。我知道你为什么来见我了。

scripts.text: They haven't gotten the report yet. We should send out soldiers...
scripts.translation: 他们还没收到报告。我们应该派士兵去......

scripts.text: That's not why I'm concerned. The problem is that the assignee failed to complete the mission and lost the report.
scripts.translation: 我担心的不是这个。问题是，负责的人没能完成任务，并且丢失了报告书。

scripts.text: Anyways... It's alright. You don't have to feel bad. I understand you didn't mean it this way.
scripts.translation: 总之......没关系。你不用感到难过，我知道你不是故意的。

scripts.text: Commander, I'll go find those evil scoundrels...
scripts.translation: 指挥官，我去找那些卑鄙小人......

scripts.text: Don't impose. Our troops aren't just from one nation, they are from thre different countries, and are here to pursue their country's own interest.
scripts.translation: 别冲动。我们的部队来自三个不同的国家，他们各自代表本国的利益。

scripts.text: I wonder who's behind this. Frankly, I must say that every country is a suspect.
scripts.translation: 不知道幕后黑手是谁。老实说，每个国家都有嫌疑。

scripts.text: *Spit* This is why I don't trust politicians. Abidal, resolving this incident is your top priority.
scripts.translation: *啐* 这就是我不信任政客的原因。阿比达尔，解决这次事件是你的首要任务。

scripts.text: Igrid, evaluate the security of this camp and discipline among the soldiers.
scripts.translation: 伊格丽德，评估一下这个营地的安全状况以及士兵们的纪律。

scripts.text: Now it's your turn... Abidal disposed reports from various departments after he used them to compile the expedition report.
scripts.translation: 现在轮到你了......阿比达尔编写远征报告时，用完各部门的报告就把它们处理掉了。

scripts.text: We take the security of our documents seriously. So... There are no extra copies of the expedition report.
scripts.translation: 我们非常重视文件安全。所以......远征队报告书没有副本。

scripts.text: I still remember at least 30% of the document. I might be able to rewrite another...
scripts.translation: 我至少还记得那份文件30%的内容。也许我能重新写一份......

scripts.text: I need it to be perfect. What can we do with only 30%?
scripts.translation: 我需要它完美无缺。只有30%的内容有什么用？

scripts.text: Hey, you must find the report. If you bring as may pages of the report as you can, then Abidal will use them to fill missing parts.
scripts.translation: 嘿，你必须找到那份报告。尽可能多地找回报告页，阿比达尔会用它们补上缺失的部分。

scripts.text: Some of them might have be consumed by monsters, or have found their way to the sea, but I don't care. You'll find them at all costs, and that's my order.
scripts.translation: 有些页可能被魔物吃了，也可能掉进海里，但我不管。你必须不惜一切代价找回来，这是命令。

scripts.text: I hope you'll do your best. You need to finish what you've started. We'll do our best to help you. Am I right, guys? Abidal? Igrid?
scripts.translation: 我希望你尽力而为。既然开始了，就要做完。我们会尽力协助你。对吧，大家？阿比达尔？伊格丽德？

scripts.text: Now, search everywhere for the pages of that report. Staff Officer Abidal will bind them into the full report for you.
scripts.translation: 好了，到处去找那份报告书的页面吧。参谋阿比达尔会把它们装订成完整的报告书。

scripts.text: Ah, and... I've received a report that you fought hard against the enemy to protect the report from them.
scripts.translation: 啊，还有......我收到报告说，你为了保护报告书不落入敌人手中而奋力战斗。

scripts.text: Hahaha, you're fearless and I can make good use of a soldier like you at any time of the day.
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈，你真是无所畏惧。像你这样的士兵，随时都能派上用场。

scripts.text: Let me tell you this, loyalty and faithfulness are very, very important. They may cause you hardship sometimes, but those qualities will guarantee you the last laugh.
scripts.translation: 让我告诉你，忠诚和守信非常、非常重要。它们有时会让你吃苦，但最终会让你笑到最后。

scripts.text: I wish you good luck in finding the pages. Try to clean any smudges off them when you find them, alright?
scripts.translation: 祝你顺利找到报告页。找到后，记得把上面的污渍擦掉，好吗？

scripts.text: Talk to my staff officer until you're finisehd finding the pages of the lost report. Right now, I'm swarmed with work.
scripts.translation: 找到遗失报告的所有页面之前，先去找参谋阿比达尔。我现在忙得不可开交。

scripts.text: I'm sure you'll easily find those if you keep your eyes open. I must warn you about the monsters around this area though. Who knows? They might love the taste of paper.
scripts.translation: 只要你留心观察，应该很容易找到。不过我要提醒你，这一带有很多魔物。谁知道呢？它们可能很喜欢纸张的味道。

scripts.text: How have you been doing? I've heard Igrid has personally send out his soldiers to support you guys.
scripts.translation: 最近怎么样？听说伊格丽德亲自派了士兵来支援你们。

scripts.text: While searching for the report, look around and meet our soldiers.
scripts.translation: 寻找报告时，四处看看，认识一下我们的士兵吧。

scripts.text: They've been sent to help you and Abidal. Ask their help if you think you need it.
scripts.translation: 他们是来协助你和阿比达尔的。如果你觉得需要帮助，尽管找他们。

scripts.text: So, the report has been restored successfully?
scripts.translation: 那么，报告已经成功复原了吗？

scripts.text: This was finished more quickly than I thought. Let me see...
scripts.translation: 这比我预想的快。让我看看......

scripts.text: It looks alright. I don't have to read this thoroughly because I trust Abidal.
scripts.translation: 看起来没问题。我相信阿比达尔，不必逐字逐句地检查。

scripts.text: Now, let's go back to your original mission. I'd like you to deliver this to the national leaders of the three countries of Midgard.
scripts.translation: 好了，回到你最初的任务。我希望你把这份报告送给米德加尔特三国的领导人。

scripts.text: Dont worry too much, my friend.
I've arranged troops in the time-space gap to protect the report.
scripts.translation: 我已经在次元裂缝安排了部队保护报告。

scripts.text: Of course, you can't see them because they're undercover soldiers under my direct command. Hahaha!
scripts.translation: 当然，你看不见他们，因为他们是直接听命于我的秘密部队。哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Let me remind you again. The officials are these three people: ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation: 再提醒你一次，收件官员是这三位：卢恩^0000FF·米德加尔^000000特王国的劳尔大臣、阿鲁^0000FF纳菲兹的努莉^000000亚祭司，以及修^0000FF瓦尔兹巴^000000鲁德共和国的格哈特。

scripts.text: Make sure to deliver the report to them without fail. Come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation: 务必把报告送到他们手中。平安归来，好吗？

scripts.text: Let me remind you again. The officials are these three people: ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation: 再提醒你一次，官员是这三位：卢恩·^0000FF米德加兹王^000000国的劳尔大臣、阿鲁纳^0000FF菲兹的努莉亚^000000祭司，以及修瓦^0000FF鲁兹巴^000000鲁德共和国的格哈特。

scripts.text: Make sure to deliver the report to them without fail. Come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation: 务必确保将报告送达他们手中。平安归来，好吗？

scripts.text: Is something wrong? Alright, we'll write another report for you.
scripts.translation: 出什么事了吗？好吧，我们会再给你写一份报告。

scripts.text: Let me remind you again. The officials are these three people: ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation: 再提醒你一次，官员是这三位：卢恩·^0000FF米德加兹王^000000国的劳尔大臣、阿鲁纳^0000FF菲兹的努莉亚^000000祭司，以及修瓦^0000FF鲁兹巴^000000鲁德共和国的格哈特。

scripts.text: Make sure to deliver the report to them without fail. Come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation: 务必确保将报告送达他们手中。平安归来，好吗？

scripts.text: Let me remind you again. The officials are these three people: ^0000FFMinister Laur^000000 of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, ^0000FFPriest Nuria^000000 of Arunafeltz and ^0000FFGerhart^000000 of the Schwarzwald Republic.
scripts.translation: 再提醒你一次，官员是这三位：卢恩·^0000FF米德加兹王^000000国的劳尔大臣、阿鲁纳^0000FF菲兹的努莉亚^000000祭司，以及修瓦^0000FF鲁兹巴^000000鲁德共和国的格哈特。

scripts.text: Make sure to deliver the report to them without fail. Come back in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation: 务必确保将报告送达他们手中。平安归来，好吗？

scripts.text: Oh, how was your trip? Hey, you look better than you did when you left. Did you drop by your hometown and enjoy great food or something?
scripts.translation: 哦，旅途如何？嘿，你看起来比出发时气色好多了。难道你顺路回了趟家乡，吃了顿好饭？

scripts.text: So tell me, did you bring the report to all three national leaders? Good job.
scripts.translation: 那么告诉我，你把报告交给三位国家领导人了吗？干得好。

scripts.text: I understand there were some unforeseen obstacles we didn't anticipate since we thought this mission was pretty trivial, but you still did your best.
scripts.translation: 我听说途中遇到了一些我们没预料到的阻碍。我们原以为任务很简单，但你还是尽力完成了。

scripts.text: I must warn you, however, this is not the end of these strange events. You're involved in this situation so deeply that you can't get out of it. Hahaha!
scripts.translation: 不过我得提醒你，这些怪事还没结束。你已经深陷其中，无法脱身。哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Don't worry. I'm not here to fool around. Isn't that right?
scripts.translation: 别担心，我不是在开玩笑。对吧？

scripts.text: Yes, sir. We can't let the same thing happen again.
scripts.translation: 是的，长官。我们不能让同样的事情再次发生。

scripts.text: I shall find out who's behind this, and destroy him.
scripts.translation: 我会查明幕后黑手，并将他消灭。

scripts.text: So... I was hoping that you'll come back and help us once we figure out who's behind this. Will you?
scripts.translation: 那么......等我们查明幕后黑手后，希望你能回来帮忙。你愿意吗？

scripts.text: And please take this small reward.
scripts.translation: 请收下这份小小的谢礼。

scripts.text: Thank you for your help so far.
scripts.translation: 感谢你一直以来的帮助。

scripts.text: Then I'll see you next time. Keep yourself in one piece, alright?
scripts.translation: 那我们下次再见。保重，别受伤了，好吗？

scripts.text: Hey, how have you been? It's too early to say that we've figured out who's the mastermind.
scripts.translation: 嘿，最近怎么样？现在就说我们已经查明幕后黑手还为时过早。

scripts.text: Please be patient, I'll contact you when the time is right.
scripts.translation: 请耐心等待，时机成熟时我会联系你。

scripts.text: Wait, have you explored this area yet? I mean the wide tundra and fields around the camp.
scripts.translation: 等等，你探索过这片区域了吗？我是说营地周围广阔的苔原和原野。

scripts.text: There are many fun things outside. If you are an adventurer, go explore for yourself. Come back after you've explored the areas around the camp.
scripts.translation: 外面有很多有趣的东西。既然你是冒险者，就自己去探索一下吧。探索完营地周围的区域后再回来。

scripts.text: Ah, it's you again. So, are you accustomed to this area now?
scripts.translation: 啊，又是你。你现在习惯这片区域了吗？

scripts.text: What brings you here again? You seem to have something to say to me.
scripts.translation: 你这次来有什么事？看起来你似乎有话想对我说。

scripts.text: I just want to say hello.
I found a weird portal below the mine cave.
scripts.translation: 我在矿洞下方发现了一个奇怪的入口。

scripts.text: Please be patient. I'll contact you when the time is right.
scripts.translation: 请耐心等待，时机成熟时我会联系你。

scripts.text: What portal? I've never heard about it.
scripts.translation: 什么入口？我从没听说过。

scripts.text: That place must be where both races fight against each other. It might be dangerous there.
scripts.translation: 那里应该是两个种族交战的地方，可能很危险。

scripts.text: I have no idea of what it is like. It is not in my field of expertise.
scripts.translation: 我不了解那里的情况，那不在我的专业范围内。

scripts.text: There is someone here who can help you. He is a historian from Rune-Midgarts. He may be aware of some relics or something that could help.
scripts.translation: 这里有个人能帮你。他是来自卢恩·米德加尔特的历史学家，可能了解一些遗迹或其他有用的信息。

scripts.text: Find the historian and see if he has any useful information for you.
scripts.translation: 去找那位历史学家，看看他有没有什么有用的信息。

scripts.text: He's at his post, you can't find him?
scripts.translation: 他就在自己的岗位上，你找不到他吗？

scripts.text: His name is Magniffer... look for him.. he's somewhere around here...
scripts.translation: 他叫马格尼弗......去找找看......应该就在附近......

scripts.text: Did you talk with the scholar? Thesedays, I haven't seen him for a while.
scripts.translation: 你和那位学者谈过了吗？最近这段时间，我没怎么见到他。

scripts.text: That's because you don't like talking to him.
scripts.translation: 那是因为你不喜欢跟他说话。

scripts.text: Hey, don't judge me like that...the problem is only that I can't see him often.
scripts.translation: 嘿，别那样说我......我只是没怎么见到他而已。

scripts.text: Whatever. Did something happen because he showed up to me? Tell me more.
scripts.translation: 算了。他来找我之后发生了什么？详细说说。

scripts.text: So, that's why that happened like that... It's so complicated...
scripts.translation: 原来事情是这样发生的......真复杂......

scripts.text: And you guys...you just take a task that you start up at first.
scripts.translation: 还有你们......你们只是继续处理一开始接下的任务。

scripts.text: You sent him to Doctor Magnifer first....
scripts.translation: 你一开始让他去找马格尼弗博士......

scripts.text: I just thought that he needed someone to talk to.
scripts.translation: 我只是觉得他需要有人倾诉。

scripts.text: Hmm... for example, you want to investigate a cave that you found, but you got on the Laphine and Sapha's nerves. right?
scripts.translation: 嗯......比如，你想调查发现的洞穴，却惹恼了拉斐族和萨法族，对吧？

scripts.text: And that two guys pay attention and stay quiet, but they are doing it for themselves..
scripts.translation: 那两个人虽然留意着情况，却保持沉默，不过他们各有自己的打算......

scripts.text: The most important thing is that this place is the ground that the Yggdrasilberry takes root acording to Magnifer.
scripts.translation: 最重要的是，根据马格尼弗的说法，这里是天地树果实扎根之地。

scripts.text: Abidal, do you have anything to say about this?
scripts.translation: 阿比达尔，你对此有什么看法？

scripts.text: Our object is to make contact with one tribe and investgate this world and how adaptable it can be.
scripts.translation: 我们的目标是与一个部落建立联系，并调查这个世界以及它是否适合我们。

scripts.text: Actually, we don't have to make this situation bigger than it already is.
scripts.translation: 实际上，我们没必要让局势变得更加复杂。

scripts.text: Yeah right. I don't want to extend this thing anymore...
scripts.translation: 没错。我也不想把事情闹得更大......

scripts.text: But the two tribes have remained neutral towards us up until now.
scripts.translation: 不过到目前为止，这两个部落对我们一直持中立态度。

scripts.text: We don't really know what attitude they have towards us.
scripts.translation: 我们并不清楚他们对我们到底持什么态度。

scripts.text: Yeah.. that makes sense... If they made a general attack, we would probably fail.
scripts.translation: 嗯......有道理......如果他们发动全面进攻，我们恐怕会撑不住。

scripts.text: We should map out a strategy. There is a method that uses Laphine and Sapha's together.
scripts.translation: 我们应该制定一个策略，可以同时利用拉斐族和萨法族。

scripts.text: We send this guy to one of the tribes and ask for cooperation in our investigation.
scripts.translation: 我们派这个人去其中一个部落，请求他们协助调查。

scripts.text: Will they help us? They have already said threatening words...
scripts.translation: 他们会帮我们吗？他们之前已经说过威胁的话了......

scripts.text: Of course they will help us. if they reject our demand, we just say that we'll ask for help from the other tribe.
scripts.translation: 当然会。如果他们拒绝我们的请求，我们就说会向另一个部落求助。

scripts.text: Right, if we do that, they will have no other choice.
scripts.translation: 没错，这样一来，他们就别无选择了。

scripts.text: In this situation, they want to avoid showing that place to the other tribe.
scripts.translation: 这种情况下，他们不想让另一个部落知道那个地方。

scripts.text: So, they have to cooperate with us.
scripts.translation: 所以他们必须与我们合作。

scripts.text: Oh, you have a malicious idea.
That's called that Kuhotanrangjigea from east. I didn't make that by myself.
scripts.translation: 这叫“以夷制夷”。这可不是我自己想出来的。

scripts.text: Whatever.. Hey, you there... your name is {0} right? Do you know what to do?
scripts.translation: 算了……嘿，你……你叫{0}，对吧？你知道该怎么做吗？

scripts.text: Go to one of the tribes and ask for help officially. I'll send someone to the other tribe.
scripts.translation: 去其中一个部落，正式请求他们的帮助。我会派人去另一个部落。

scripts.text: I'm going to give you a choice. Which tribe do you want to go to?
scripts.translation: 我让你选一个部落。你想去哪个？

scripts.text: Okay, then I place responsibility on you. from now on you focus on acquiring a good reputation with the Laphine.
scripts.translation: 好吧，这件事就交给你负责。从现在开始，你要专注于改善我们和拉斐族的关系。

scripts.text: It won't be easy to get a good impression from the Sapha again.
scripts.translation: 要重新赢得萨法族的好感可不容易。

scripts.text: So you must earn us a good reputation from the Laphine.
scripts.translation: 所以你得帮我们赢得拉斐族的好感。

scripts.text: Good. You are now responsible with building our relationship with the Laphine tribe.
scripts.translation: 很好。现在由你负责与拉斐族建立关系。

scripts.text: Go to the chief of the Laphine and if he doesn't accept our request, just say that you are going to ask for help from the Sapha.
scripts.translation: 去找拉斐族的首领。如果他不接受我们的请求，就告诉他你们打算向萨法族寻求帮助。

scripts.text: You have your orders! Now I'm going to look for an adventurer who is willing to be sent to the Sapha.
scripts.translation: 任务已下达！现在我要去找一个愿意被派往萨法族的冒险者。

scripts.text: Yeah? Then think again and decide.
scripts.translation: 是吗？那就再考虑一下，做出决定吧。

scripts.text: Okay, then I place responsibility on you. from now on you focus on acquiring a good reputation with the Sapha.
scripts.translation: 好吧，这件事就交给你负责。从现在开始，你要专注于改善我们和萨法族的关系。

scripts.text: It won't be easy to get a good impression from the Laphine again.
scripts.translation: 要重新赢得拉斐族的好感可不容易。

scripts.text: So you must earn us a good reputation from the Sapha.
scripts.translation: 所以你得帮我们赢得萨法族的好感。

scripts.text: Good. You are now responsible with building our relationship with the Sapha tribe.
scripts.translation: 很好。现在由你负责与萨法族建立关系。

scripts.text: Go to the chief of the Sapha and if he doesn't accept our request, just say that you are going to ask for help from the Laphine.
scripts.translation: 去找萨法族的首领。如果他不接受我们的请求，就告诉他你们打算向拉斐族寻求帮助。

scripts.text: You have your orders! Now I'm going to look for an adventurer who is willing to be sent to the Laphine.
scripts.translation: 任务已下达！现在我要去找一个愿意被派往拉斐族的冒险者。

scripts.text: Yeah? then think again and decide.
scripts.translation: 是吗？那就再考虑一下，做出决定吧。

scripts.text: Good. You are now responsible with building our relationship with the Laphine tribe.
scripts.translation: 很好。现在由你负责与拉斐族建立关系。

scripts.text: Go to the chief of the Laphine and if he doesn't accept our request, just say that you are going to ask for help from the Sapha.
scripts.translation: 去找拉斐族的首领。如果他不接受我们的请求，就告诉他你们打算向萨法族寻求帮助。

scripts.text: I'm going to look for an adventurer who is willing to be sent to the Sapha.
scripts.translation: 我要去找一个愿意被派往萨法族的冒险者。

scripts.text: Good. You are now responsible with building our relationship with the Sapha tribe.
scripts.translation: 很好。现在由你负责与萨法族建立关系。

scripts.text: Go to the chief of the Sapha and if he doesn't accept our request, just say that you are going to ask for help from the Laphine.
scripts.translation: 去找萨法族的首领。如果他不接受我们的请求，就告诉他你们打算向拉斐族寻求帮助。

scripts.text: You have your orders! Now I'm going to look for an adventurer who is willing to be sent to the Laphine.
scripts.translation: 任务已下达！现在我要去找一个愿意被派往拉斐族的冒险者。

scripts.text: How's the activity in Laphine? They have a stern character.
scripts.translation: 拉斐族那边情况如何？他们性子很严厉。

scripts.text: I'm not cut out for matching with them...ew...
scripts.translation: 我不擅长和他们打交道......呕......

scripts.text: I'm going to send a few able men to the Sapha, you don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation: 我会派几个得力的人去萨法族，你不用担心。

scripts.text: How's the activity in Sapha? They have a stern character.
scripts.translation: 萨法族那边情况如何？他们性子很严厉。

scripts.text: I'm not cut out for matching with them...ew...
scripts.translation: 我不擅长和他们打交道......呕......

scripts.text: I'm going to send a few able men to the Laphine, you don't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation: 我会派几个得力的人去拉斐族，你不用担心。

scripts.text: You've come back alive? Let us celebrate your immunity!
scripts.translation: 你居然活着回来了？来庆祝你大难不死吧！

scripts.text: Who would have thought that that outsiders would be treated so vulgar by the leaders of the other tribes?
scripts.translation: 谁能想到，其他部落的首领竟然会如此粗暴地对待外来者？

scripts.text: I have said before this thing is not the last, and certainly there is something waiting for us.
scripts.translation: 我之前就说过，这件事还没完，肯定还有麻烦等着我们。

scripts.text: It is time for us to head out, is it not, instructor?
scripts.translation: 是时候出发了，不是吗，指导员？

scripts.text: I am looking forward to what will happen... Whew...
scripts.translation: 我很期待接下来会发生什么......呼......

scripts.text: *Sigh* Look at me, I used to command the desert of Morocc, but I've been deployed to a world that only God knows where...
scripts.translation: *叹气* 看看我，以前我还指挥着梦罗克沙漠，如今却被派到这片连神明都不知道在哪儿的异世界......

scripts.text: Come on, that's not true. In fact, you used to be an official of a small town, and have been promoted to the commander of the expedition. Your success is almost too good to be true.
scripts.translation: 别这么说，这可不是真的。你以前只是小镇的一名官员，后来升任远征队指挥官。你的晋升顺利得简直令人难以置信。

scripts.text: Hey, boss. Can we just go through the motions until we get out of here? This so-called Ash-Vacuum is boring. It's heaven for the kingdom scholars, but it's not for me.
scripts.translation: 嘿，老板。我们能不能敷衍一下，赶紧离开这里？这个所谓的“阿什真空”太无聊了。对王国的学者来说是天堂，对我可不是。

scripts.text: Geez, do you have to keep calling me boss? I'm the Commander, alright? So disrespectful.
scripts.translation: 天哪，你非得一直叫我老板吗？要叫指挥官，懂吗？真没礼貌。

scripts.text: Can you guys stop complaining? God...
scripts.translation: 你们能不能别抱怨了？真是的......

scripts.text: Who are you? What business do you have with Commander Agip?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？找阿吉普指挥官有什么事？

scripts.text: What is it? If you have too much time on your hands, you'd better go outside and find something productive to do.
scripts.translation: 怎么了？要是闲得发慌，就出去找点正事做。

scripts.text: Phew, I'm glad the mission is over. Thank you so much for your help.
scripts.translation: 呼，很高兴任务结束了。非常感谢你的帮助。

scripts.text: We'll contact you again when we have another mission for you. I hope we can count on your help again when the time comes.
scripts.translation: 有新任务时我们会再联系你。希望到时候还能得到你的帮助。

scripts.text: I'm Staff Officer Abidal of the Midgard Expedition. How may I help you?
scripts.translation: 我是米德加尔特远征队的参谋阿比达尔。有什么事吗？
米德加尔特远征队简介
米德加尔特远征队的成就

scripts.text: The Midgard Expedition is conducted by a group of explorers from the three countries of Midgard and the Mercenary Association. We're here to explore the Ash-Vacuum.
scripts.translation: 米德加尔特远征队由来自米德加尔特三国的探险家和佣兵协会成员组成。我们在这里探索阿什真空。

scripts.text: Command Hibba Agip behind me is our commander. He may appear unreliable, but he has extensive knowledge and experience in exploration.
scripts.translation: 站在我身后的希巴·阿吉普是我们的指挥官。他看起来可能不太靠谱，但在探险方面拥有广博的知识和丰富的经验。

scripts.text: We have many aides and scholars to support our expedition.
scripts.translation: 有许多助手和学者支持这次远征。

scripts.text: Oh, you may know this already, but Commander Agip isn't from any of the three countries. Neither am I or Instructor Igrid.
scripts.translation: 你可能知道，阿吉普指挥官并不属于三国中的任何一国。我和指导员伊格丽德也一样。

scripts.text: There's an obvious power struggle among the three countries to assign their officers to the commander position.
scripts.translation: 三国之间在指派军官担任指挥官一职上存在明显的权力斗争。

scripts.text: As a last resort, they had to select Commander Agip since he's unaffiliated with any of those countries, but is talented enough to lead the expedition.
scripts.translation: 万般无奈之下，他们只好选阿吉普指挥官，因为他不属于任何一国，却有能力领导远征队。

scripts.text: We, the commanders, Igrid, and I aren't used to the leadership role. We're having trouble taking care of everything that's happening. *Sigh*
scripts.translation: 指挥官、伊格丽德和我都不习惯担任领导职务。我们很难处理眼前发生的各种事情。*叹气*

scripts.text: The members of the Midgard Expedition are conducting various kinds of research about the Ash-Vacuum searching for possible living creatures and studying what might be beneficial for the development of the mainland.
scripts.translation: 米德加尔特远征队成员正在阿什真空开展各种研究，寻找可能存在的生物，并研究这里是否有助于大陆的发展。

scripts.text: If you look around, you'll find many people in need of your help. Enjoy your stay in the otherworld, and feel free to ask me if you have questions.
scripts.translation: 在营地四处看看，你会发现很多人需要帮助。祝你在异世界过得愉快，有问题尽管来问我。

scripts.text: We're still at an early stage of the expedition, so we haven't made any major achievements. That's why we need help from adventurers like you.
scripts.translation: 我们的远征仍处于早期阶段，因此尚未取得重大成果。这就是我们需要像你这样的冒险者帮忙的原因。

scripts.text: If you look around this camp, you'll find many opportunities to help us. We always welcome every bit of help.
scripts.translation: 看看营地周围，你会发现很多能帮上忙的事。我们欢迎任何帮助。

scripts.text: So far, only a few truths about the Ash-Vacuum have been revealed.
scripts.translation: 到目前为止，我们只揭开了阿什真空的少数真相。

scripts.text: We now know there's a demihuman race in this otherworld, but we're too busy figuring out the true nature of the time-space gap, let alone study the demihuman race in depth.
scripts.translation: 我们已经知道这个异世界存在一个半人种族，但眼下忙着弄清次元裂缝的真正性质，更别说深入研究这个种族了。

scripts.text: My advice for you will be to be careful when you encounter members of that race. Who knows? They might be extremely hostile toward other races.
scripts.translation: 我的建议是，遇到这个种族的成员时要小心。谁知道呢？他们可能对其他种族极度敌视。

scripts.text: Oh, and take heed, unidentified creatures appear outside the camp during nighttime. Be careful of them, too.
scripts.translation: 还有，请注意，夜间营地外会出现不明生物。也要小心它们。

scripts.text: Oh, welcome back. I apologize for troubling you like this. I didn't feel to comfortable talking to you back there.
scripts.translation: 哦，欢迎回来。很抱歉这样打扰你。刚才在那里和你说话时，我有点不自在。

scripts.text: In fact, I have a favor to ask of you. From what I know of your accomplishments you're the right person for this.
scripts.translation: 事实上，我有一事相求。根据我对你功绩的了解，你是最合适的人选。

scripts.text: On behalf of the expedition, I'd like to give you a mission. Would you like to accept it?
scripts.translation: 我想代表远征队交给你一个任务。你愿意接受吗？

scripts.text: Thank you so much. I had a good feeling about you, and I was so sure that you'd be willing to help.
scripts.translation: 非常感谢。我一看就觉得你靠得住，也相信你愿意帮忙。

scripts.text: Let's cut to the chase. The mission is simple, deliver our expedition report to the three countries of Midgard.
scripts.translation: 我就直说吧。任务很简单：把远征报告送到米德加尔特三国。

scripts.text: But I have to tell you... We sent out three adventurers on this mission before you, and they all dissapeared. Please don't disclose this information to anyone.
scripts.translation: 但我必须告诉你......在你之前，我们曾派出三名冒险者执行这项任务，他们全都失踪了。请不要把这件事告诉任何人。

scripts.text: The commander or I cannot leave this camp, even though delivering the report is one of our most important duties. That's why I need someone reliable and trustworthy like you.
scripts.translation: 指挥官和我都无法离开营地，尽管递交报告是我们最重要的职责之一。所以我需要像你这样可靠、值得信赖的人。

scripts.text: Phew, I'm so glad that you've accepted this mission. Now, please go receive the report from the commander. He'll officially assign you to the mission.
scripts.translation: 呼，太好了，你接受了任务。现在请去指挥官那里领报告，他会正式指派你执行任务。
我会为你的出发做好准备。

scripts.text: Please go speak to the commander.
Oh, I see... Then can you help me whenever you have some time?
scripts.translation: 哦，我明白了......那你有空时能帮帮我吗？

scripts.text: This is urgent, please think it over and come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 这件事很紧急，请再考虑一下。如果你改变主意了，就回来找我。

scripts.text: I've reported to the commander about your decision to help us.
scripts.translation: 我已经向指挥官汇报了你决定帮助我们的事。

scripts.text: You've been assinged to the mission officially. Good luck, and I hope you'll come back safely.
scripts.translation: 你已被正式指派执行任务。祝你好运，希望你能平安归来。

scripts.text: I've heard the story. Why don't you go speak to the commander first?
scripts.translation: 我听说过这件事。你先去和指挥官谈谈吧。

scripts.text: It's as what the commander said. I still remember the contents of the report, even though it might not all be accurate without any references.
scripts.translation: 正如指挥官所说。尽管没有参考资料，内容可能不完全准确，但我仍记得报告里的内容。

scripts.text: If you bring me the pages of the lost report, I'll fill the missing parts and be able to complete the report again.
scripts.translation: 如果你能找回丢失的报告页，我会补上缺失部分，重新完成这份报告。

scripts.text: Why don't you go check the site of the accident? You might find some clues of their whereabouts. and...
scripts.translation: 你不妨去看看事故现场？或许能找到有关他们下落的线索。还有......

scripts.text: This is my opinion, but otherworldly creatures might have taken an interest in the pages.
scripts.translation: 这只是我的个人猜测，但异界生物可能对那些报告页感兴趣。

scripts.text: I'm thinking this because the report contains information about the ecology of the otherworldly creatures. It's also made of paper and ink, materials from the mainland that might seem interesting to those creatures.
scripts.translation: 我这么想是因为报告里有关于异界生物生态的信息。而且报告是用纸张和墨水制作的，这些来自大陆的材料可能会引起它们的兴趣。

scripts.text: Anyways, please bring the pages of the report in ^0000FFincrements of 10^000000 whenever you find them. I'll try to put them in order.
scripts.translation: 总之，请将找到的报告页凑^0000FF齐10页后^000000交给我。我会试着把它们整理好。

scripts.text: How have you been doing with finding the report's lost pages?
scripts.translation: 你寻找报告遗失页面的进展如何？

scripts.text: Feel free to tell me whenever you're ready.

scripts.translation: 哦，你已经收集到足够的页面了......

scripts.text: Why don't you check the report's restoration status again?
scripts.translation: 不妨再查看一下报告的修复进度。

scripts.text: Have you brought me pages of the lost report? Please bring them to me in increments of 10.
scripts.translation: 你带来了遗失报告的页面吗？请每次提交10页。

scripts.text: Thank you. Let me try to put them in order.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。让我试着把它们整理一下。

scripts.text: Umm... This page should go here and..
scripts.translation: 嗯......这一页应该放在这里，还有......

scripts.text: Thank you for your hard work. We were able to restore one volume of the report.
scripts.translation: 辛苦了。我们成功复原了一卷报告。

scripts.translation: 这是报告的第一卷。很高兴我们至少恢复了第一部分。

scripts.text: Keep up the good work on finding the rest of the volumes.
scripts.translation: 请继续努力寻找其余卷册。
