scripts.text: You have restored the first, second and third volume of the report. There is 1 volume left to restore.
scripts.translation: 我们来看看报告的修复进度。[参谋阿比达尔]你已复原第一、第二、第三卷报告，还剩1卷待复原。

scripts.text: You have restored the second, third and fourth volume of the report. There is 1 volume left to restore.
scripts.translation: 我们来看看报告的修复进度。[参谋阿比达尔]你已复原第二、第三、第四卷报告，还剩1卷待复原。

scripts.text: Phew, I'm glad we can resume the mission again.
scripts.translation: 呼，太好了，我们可以继续执行任务了。

scripts.text: ...Aren't you leaving? I think you should.
scripts.translation: ......你还不走吗？我想你该出发了。

scripts.text: I heard that you got a new duty from Commander Agip.
scripts.translation: 我听说你从阿吉普指挥官那里接到了新任务。

scripts.text: ...Aren't you leaving? I think you should.
scripts.translation: ......你还不走吗？我想你该出发了。

scripts.text: Hello, I'm Staff Officer Abidal. Safe travels, Adventurer.
scripts.translation: 你好，我是参谋阿比达尔。一路顺风，冒险者。

scripts.text: Hey, rookies. I guess you were lucky enough to complete the mission.
scripts.translation: 嘿，新人。看来你们运气不错，完成了任务。

scripts.text: This is not the end. Keep yourself in one piece until we need your services again.
scripts.translation: 这还没结束。等我们再次需要你们帮忙时，你们可得好好保重。

scripts.text: I'm Instructor Igrid of the Midgard Expedition. I'm in charge of training and commanding soldiers.
scripts.translation: 我是米德加尔特远征队的指导员伊格丽德，负责训练和指挥士兵。

scripts.text: You must want to become an official member of our expedition.
scripts.translation: 你一定想成为远征队的正式成员吧。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but you're too weak to endure my intensive training.
scripts.translation: 很抱歉，你太弱了，无法承受我的强化训练。

scripts.text: Give up before you get hurt.
If you have too much time on your hands, look around. There's plenty of chores available for so-called adventurers's like you.
scripts.translation: 闲着没事就四处看看。像你这样的所谓冒险者，有的是杂活可做。

scripts.text: If you do your best to do them, I might accept you as a trainee on this expedition.
scripts.translation: 好好干的话，我或许会收你做远征队的学员。

scripts.text: I don't trust you. Hm. Sorry. I don't really have the right to say that if the commander has assigned you to the mission.
scripts.translation: 我不信任你。嗯，抱歉。如果指挥官已经指派你执行任务，我其实没有资格这么说。

scripts.text: If you're going to give up, give up now. That'll be better for both of us.
scripts.translation: 如果你打算放弃，现在就放弃吧。这样对我们双方都好。

scripts.text: I knew you couldn't do it. Didn't I tell you to give up when you had the chance?!
scripts.translation: 我就知道你做不成。我不是告诉过你，有机会就放弃吗？！

scripts.text: Do you think I'm doing this for you? No, I'm just using this chance to discipline idle soldiers.
scripts.translation: 你以为我这么做是为了你吗？不，我只是借这个机会管教一下那些无所事事的士兵。

scripts.text: What are you looking at? Go mind your own business!
scripts.translation: 你在看什么？管好你自己的事！

scripts.text: I am Expedition Training Instructor Igrid, and the commander responsible for training soldiers.
scripts.translation: 我是远征队训练指导员伊格丽德，负责训练士兵。

scripts.text: Welcome, I've been waiting for you.
You must be {0}. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation: 你一定是吧{0}。很高兴见到你。

scripts.text: Let me check something quicly. You received the report directly from the commander, didn't you? May I see it?
scripts.translation: 让我快速确认一下。你是直接从指挥官那里收到报告的吧？可以给我看看吗？

scripts.text: Excellent. Thank you. Then we'll go back to the mainland and let the leaders know that you, {0}, have departed.
scripts.translation: 很好，谢谢。我们现在要回大陆，通知各国领导人：你，，已{0}经出发了。
你，去修瓦尔兹巴鲁德共和国。

scripts.text: And you, take Arunafeltz. I'll visit Prontera Palace.
scripts.translation: 你去阿鲁纳菲兹。我去普隆德拉王宫。

scripts.text: What's up? Why haven't you left...?
scripts.translation: 怎么了？你为什么还没出发......？

scripts.text: Argh... Why are you doing this?!
Wha... What are you doing? You can't give up the report...
scripts.translation: 什......你在做什么？你不能把报告交出去......

scripts.text: *Cough* Oh, thank god! {0}, please take the report and run!
scripts.translation: *咳咳* 谢天{0}谢地！，拿着报告快跑！

scripts.text: Argh... {0}, are you alright? The report... The report...
We lost the report. The pages are blowing away!
scripts.translation: 报告丢了。纸张都被风吹散了！

scripts.text: Haha, I may have failed to take the report, but it's better destroyed than in your hands!
scripts.translation: 哈哈，虽然我没能拿到报告，但让它被毁掉总比落在你们手里好！

scripts.text: Are you alright? What about the report... ?
scripts.translation: 你没事吧？报告怎么样了......？

scripts.text: *Cough* The report is out of our reach now...
scripts.translation: *咳咳* 报告现在已经超出我们的掌控了......

scripts.text: If we mobilize all our troops to search this entire area...
scripts.translation: 如果我们动员所有部队搜索这一整片区域......

scripts.text: We must report this to the commander before anything else.
scripts.translation: 现在最要紧的是向指挥官报告。

scripts.text: {0}, please report to the commander immidiatly. Let us take care of the rest.
scripts.translation: {0}，请立即向指挥官报告。剩下的交给我们。

scripts.text: Yes, please report to the commander...
Oh, yeah? Then I'll have to use force!
scripts.translation: 哦，是吗？那我就只能动武了！

scripts.text: *Cough* Oh, thank god! {0}, please take the report and run!
scripts.translation: *咳咳* 谢天{0}谢地！，拿着报告快跑！

scripts.text: Argh... {0}, are you alright? The report... The report...
We lost the report. The pages are blowing away!
scripts.translation: 报告丢了。纸张都被风吹散了！

scripts.text: Haha, I may have failed to take the report, but it's better destroyed than in your hands!
scripts.translation: 哈哈，虽然我没能拿到报告，但让它被毁掉总比落在你们手里好！

scripts.text: Are you alright? What about the report... ?
scripts.translation: 你没事吧？报告怎么样了......？

scripts.text: *Cough* The report is out of our reach now...
scripts.translation: *咳咳* 报告现在已经超出我们的掌控了......

scripts.text: If we mobilize all our troops to search this entire area...
scripts.translation: 如果我们动员所有部队搜索这一整片区域......

scripts.text: We must report this to the commander before anything else.
scripts.translation: 现在最要紧的是向指挥官报告。

scripts.text: {0}, please report to the commander immidiatly. Let us take care of the rest.
scripts.translation: {0}，请立即向指挥官报告。剩下的交给我们。

scripts.text: Yes, please report to the commander...
Were you assigned to deliver the expedition report?
scripts.translation: 你是受命运送远征队报告的吗？

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I don't see any report in your hands. Please bring me the report, so I can confirm your identification.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我没看到你手里拿着报告。请把报告带来，我要核实你的身份。

scripts.text: Please hurry up and report this incident to the commander.
scripts.translation: 请尽快向指挥官报告这起事故。

scripts.text: Good day! I'm here, just waiting for someone. Well, that's my duty.
scripts.translation: 你好！我在这里等人。嗯，这是我的职责。

scripts.text: - When you tried to talk to him, he disappeared into thin air. He looked like someone on a very important mission... -
scripts.translation: - 你试图和他交谈时，他却凭空消失了。他看起来像是在执行重要任务...... -

scripts.text: - When you tried to talk to him, he disappeared into thin air. He looked like someone on a very important mission... -
scripts.translation: - 你试图和他交谈时，他却凭空消失了。他看起来像是在执行重要任务... -

scripts.text: Good day. I'm from the Third Scout Party under direct command of the commander of the Midgard Expedition.
scripts.translation: 你好。我是米德加尔特远征队指挥官直属的第三侦察队成员。

scripts.text: I've been ordered by Instructor Igrid to conduct a search for something.
scripts.translation: 我受指导员伊格丽德之命，正在搜寻某样东西。

scripts.text: Oh, you must be{0}. I heard that you'll be delivering the report.
scripts.translation: 哦，你一{0}定是吧。我听说你负责运送报告。

scripts.text: Searching for lost pages was tougher then I expected. Please come back later when I'm finished making one round.
scripts.translation: 寻找遗失页面比我想的困难。等我完成这一轮搜寻后再来吧。

scripts.text: Good news! I've found {0} pieces of paper that appear to be part of the report.
scripts.translation: 好消息！我找{0}到了张看起来像是报告一部分的纸页。

scripts.text: I'm doing my best, but I haven't found any pages yet.
scripts.translation: 我正在尽力搜寻，但还没找到任何页面。

scripts.text: Well then, keep up the good work!
Who are you? Why do you want to know about our search results? Are you from the army?
scripts.translation: 你是谁？为什么想知道我们的搜寻结果？你是军队的人吗？

scripts.text: Man, don't you know that you can be arrested for interrupting a military operation?
scripts.translation: 喂，你不知道干扰军事行动会被逮捕吗？

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I'm on duty. Why don't we talk later when I'm off-duty?
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我正在执勤。等我下班后再聊吧。

scripts.text: I'm Laur, the aide of the Home Minister of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Do you have any business with me?
scripts.translation: 我是劳尔，卢恩·米德加尔特王国内务大臣的助手。你有什么事吗？

scripts.text: Oh, you brought me the report from the Midgard Expedition. What took you so long? I received a message about your departure a long time ago.
scripts.translation: 哦，你带来了米德加尔特远征队的报告。怎么花了这么久？我很久以前就收到你出发的消息了。

scripts.text: Well, tell the commander that I'm not happy with your tardiness. Now, give me the report.
scripts.translation: 好吧，告诉指挥官，我对你们迟到很不满。现在，把报告给我。

scripts.text: I knew it was the wrong idea to out a mercenary in the commander position. See, nothing is done on time. Gosh!
scripts.translation: 我就知道让佣兵担任指挥官是个错误的决定。看吧，什么事都没能准时完成。真是的！

scripts.text: *Ahem Ahem* Thank you for bringing me the report. I guess I was wrong about the commander. This report is actually very well done.
scripts.translation: *咳咳* 谢谢你把报告带给我。看来是我误会指挥官了。这份报告做得确实很好。

scripts.text: But don't forget to tell him that I need the expedition reports on time from now on. Alright? *Ahem*
scripts.translation: 但别忘了告诉他，从现在开始，远征队报告必须准时交上来。明白了吗？*咳*

scripts.text: Why are you back? You've delivered the report to me already. Are you suffering from amnesia or something?
scripts.translation: 你怎么又回来了？你不是已经把报告交给我了吗？你失忆了吗？

scripts.text: You should leave and go back to your work.
I'm Laur, the aide of the Home Minister of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom. Do you have any business with me?
scripts.translation: 我是劳尔，卢恩·米德加尔特王国内务大臣的助手。你有什么事吗？

scripts.text: Can you sense the great disorder occuring on the Midgard Continent and the Rune-Midgarts' Kingdom?
scripts.translation: 你能感受到米德加尔特大陆和卢恩·米德加尔特王国正发生的巨大动荡吗？

scripts.text: Still, there always a silver lining, no matter how dangerous this world may become.
scripts.translation: 不过，无论这个世界变得多么危险，总有一线希望。

scripts.text: There is hope and opportunity beyond the chaos, and I see the world beyond the time-space gap as a source of new hope.
scripts.translation: 混乱之中仍有希望和机遇。我认为次元裂缝另一边的世界正是新希望的源泉。

scripts.text: Welcome, stranger. How can I help you?
scripts.translation: 欢迎，旅人。有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: Oh, I see. You've brought me a report from the expedition beyond the time-space gap.
scripts.translation: 哦，我明白了。你带来的是来自次元裂缝另一边的远征报告。

scripts.text: I regret admitting that you've brought it much later than I expected, but... I'm glad it is here safely. Please give it to me.
scripts.translation: 很遗憾，你交得比我预期的晚了许多，不过......很高兴报告平安送到了。请交给我吧。

scripts.text: I'm happy to see that they've made good progress so far. Please tell the commander to keep up the good work.
scripts.translation: 很高兴看到他们目前进展顺利。请告诉指挥官继续努力。

scripts.text: Excuse me, but it's time to pray now. Please be safe on your travels.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，现在是祈祷的时间。祝你旅途平安。

scripts.text: Oh, right, I already received the report from you. Don't worry, you didn't forget.
scripts.translation: 哦，对了，我已经收到你的报告了。别担心，你没忘记。

scripts.text: Please be safe on your way back to the expedition camp.
Good day, stranger. May Freya bless you.
scripts.translation: 祝你今天愉快，旅人。愿芙蕾雅保佑你。

scripts.text: Welcome, {0}. What took you so long?
Oh, who am I? Let's say... That you can make ends meet because of me.
scripts.translation: 哦，我是谁？这么说吧......你能维持生计，多亏了我。

scripts.text: Do you know how long I waited for this report? *Sigh* ...Fine, just give it to me.
scripts.translation: 你知道我等这份报告等了多久吗？*叹气*......算了，给我吧。

scripts.text: Hmmm... This report is a clear demonstration of Commander Hibba Agip's competence... Well, that's great.
scripts.translation: 嗯......这份报告充分展现了希巴·阿吉普指挥官的能力......好吧，很不错。

scripts.text: Thank you for bringing the report.
Please tell the commander to keep up the good work.
scripts.translation: 请告诉指挥官继续努力。

scripts.text: Now excuse me, I must go back to work.
scripts.translation: 那么失陪了，我得回去工作。

scripts.text: What is it? Do you still have business with me?
Please go back to the commander, and tell him to keep up the good work.
scripts.translation: 请回去告诉指挥官继续努力。

scripts.text: What is it? I don't have time for chitchat.
If you have business with me. please talk to my secretary and schedule an appointment. My office is on the second floor.
scripts.translation: 如果有公事找我，请和我的秘书预约。我的办公室在二楼。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 携带物品过多时，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Oh adventurer, you've come at the perfect time.
scripts.translation: 哦，冒险者，你来得正是时候。

scripts.text: Since you and I both know that we can't waste time on idle chitchat,
scripts.translation: 既然你我都知道时间宝贵，不能浪费在闲聊上，

scripts.text: Most expeditions come to this area to explore the Ash Vacuum,
scripts.translation: 多数远征队来到这里是为了探索阿什真空，

scripts.text: but we've come here for a different reason.
You know about this space gap that was caused by Satan Morocc, don't you?
scripts.translation: 你知道魔王梦罗克造成的这道次元裂缝，对吧？

scripts.text: Our job is to pursue Satan Morocc and figure out how this all happened.
scripts.translation: 我们的任务是追踪魔王梦罗克，弄清楚这一切是如何发生的。

scripts.text: Your job is to assist us, and prove that you can be a good member of our expedition.
scripts.translation: 你的任务是协助我们，并证明自己能胜任远征队成员。

scripts.text: ... Umm... So, you'll have to.. Let me think which job would be perfect for you.
scripts.translation: ......嗯......那么，你得......让我想想什么工作最适合你。

scripts.text: Umm.. I remember someone said that he needed assistance...
scripts.translation: 嗯......我记得有人说过需要帮手......

scripts.text: Ah, I know what you can do!
scripts.translation: 啊，我知道你能做什么了！

scripts.text: There's a guy conducting an investigation near the space gap. You can go help him.
scripts.translation: 有个人正在次元裂缝附近调查。你去帮帮他。

scripts.text: Just do what he asks you to do, alright?
scripts.translation: 他说什么你就照做，好吗？

scripts.text: Well, {0}, I've just assigned you as Mr. Kidd's assistant.
scripts.translation: 好了，{0}，我刚任命你为基德先生的助手。

scripts.text: Good, everything's done on this end. I just needed to get your name on record.
scripts.translation: 很好，这边的手续都办完了。我只是要把你的名字登记下来。

scripts.text: What are you still doing here?
{0}, your job is to assist Mr. Kidd.
Please go help him, will you?
Only authorized personnel can enter this area.
scripts.translation: 只有获准的人员才能进入这个区域。

scripts.text: Go back to the mainland as quickly as possible.
Your job is to assist Mr. Kidd who's standing near the space gap, otherwise known as the gate.
scripts.translation: 你的工作是协助站在次元裂缝（也就是大门）附近的基德先生。

scripts.text: You're irresponsible. How could you abandon such an important duty?
scripts.translation: 真不负责任，怎么能丢下这么重要的职责？

scripts.text: If you don't want to work, why did you even come here to the Ash Vacuum in the first place?
scripts.translation: 如果你不想工作，当初为什么要来阿什真空？

scripts.text: Alas! There's no one I can trust!
scripts.translation: 唉！没有我可以信任的人！

scripts.text: You know, when I was working at the palace, I was.. *Blah Blah*...
scripts.translation: 你知道吗，我在宫殿工作时......*絮絮叨叨*......

scripts.text: - Her rant doesn't seem to be ending any time soon. You'd better go back and help Mr. Kidd, even if your heart's not in it. -
scripts.translation: - 她的抱怨似乎一时半会儿停不下来。你最好还是回去帮基德先生，哪怕心里并不情愿。 -

scripts.text: Hm? Where are you going? I'm not finished!
scripts.translation: 嗯？你要去哪里？我还没说完呢！

scripts.text: Mr. Kidd is such a great young man.
scripts.translation: 基德先生真是个优秀的年轻人。

scripts.text: You should be thankful that I've assigned you to help him. Don't be lazy by neglecting your duties.
scripts.translation: 你应该感激我派你去协助他。别偷懒，做好自己的工作。

scripts.text: I knew you would successfully complete your duties.
scripts.translation: 我就知道你能顺利完成任务。

scripts.text: So, tell me; how can I help you?
scripts.translation: 那么，有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text: A scholar who is familiar with magic?
What about that old man over there? If you couldn't tell, he comes from a distant country.
scripts.translation: 那边那位老人怎么样？看不出来吗，他来自遥远的国度。

scripts.text: Why are you looking for a scholar, anyway?
scripts.translation: 对了，你为什么要找学者？

scripts.text: Did Mr. Kidd ask you to find one?
scripts.translation: 是基德先生让你去找的吗？

scripts.text: I see. He's probably looking for a solution for the spell scroll.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。他大概是在寻找解决魔法卷轴问题的办法。

scripts.text: Then yes, that old man would be the perfect person to ask.
scripts.translation: 那么，那位老人正好能帮上忙。

scripts.text: He's from Arunafeltz, and has extensive knowledge in magic as well as sacred power.
scripts.translation: 他来自阿鲁纳菲兹，对魔法和神圣力量都很有研究。

scripts.text: I'm sure he'll be able to help you.
Do you see an old man over there? He's trying to make a fire with wet firewood to roast a sweet potato.
scripts.translation: 你看到那边那位老人了吗？他正试图用湿柴生火烤红薯。

scripts.text: Why don't you go show it to him? He might be able to help Mr. Kidd with what he is trying to do.
scripts.translation: 不妨拿给他看看？他也许能帮基德先生解决眼前的问题。

scripts.text: If you're seeking advice about the spell scroll, you should go talk to Mr. Defaria.
scripts.translation: 如果你想咨询魔法卷轴的问题，就去找德法里亚先生。

scripts.text: I don't practice magic, so I wouldn't know anything about it.
scripts.translation: 我不懂魔法，所以帮不上忙。

scripts.text: ...Basically it all comes down to Rayan.
scripts.translation: ......说到底，这一切都和拉扬有关。

scripts.text: He's been abducted by Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation: 他被魔王梦罗克绑架了。

scripts.text: If we find Rayan using this location-tracing spell.
scripts.translation: 如果我们用这个定位法术找到拉扬......
我们也能找到魔王梦罗克！

scripts.text: But it'll work only if Satan Morocc actually abducted Rayan.
scripts.translation: 但前提是魔王梦罗克确实绑架了拉扬。

scripts.text: Say, what's the tracing pattern number?
scripts.translation: 那么，追踪图案的编号是多少？

scripts.text: This location-tracing spell uses a pair of magic stones of the same wavelength...
scripts.translation: 这个定位法术需要一对波长相同的魔法石......

scripts.text: We can use the spell with one stone to find the other stone with the matching wavelength.
scripts.translation: 我们可以用一块石头施法，寻找另一块波长相同的石头。

scripts.text: We'll analyze this pattern number and detect the wavelength.
scripts.translation: 我们会解析这个编号并检测波长。

scripts.text: It'll take some time before we get the results.
scripts.translation: 得到结果还需要一些时间。

scripts.text: It's not working for some reason.
I can't find a magic stone that has the same wavelength as yours.
scripts.translation: 我找不到与你的波长相同的魔法石。

scripts.text: This location-tracing spell uses a pair of magic stones of the same wavelength..
scripts.translation: 这个定位法术需要一对波长相同的魔法石......

scripts.text: I can't find a magic stone that has the same wavelength as your pattern number.
scripts.translation: 我找不到与你的编号波长相同的魔法石。

scripts.text: I hope they've been able to trace the wavelength by now.
scripts.translation: 希望他们已经追踪到波长了。

scripts.text: How'd you like to go check the results?
To the south of this camp, you'll see a building with a mana detector attached to it.
scripts.translation: 在营地南边，你会看到一座装有玛娜探测器的建筑。

scripts.text: Go ask the building manager about the trace results.
scripts.translation: 去问问那里的管理员追踪结果。

scripts.text: Tracing magic wavelength is not easy as you think.
scripts.translation: 追踪魔法波长并不像你想象的那么容易。

scripts.text: Please be patient: the results will arrive soon enough.
scripts.translation: 请耐心等待，结果很快就会出来。

scripts.text: I'm in charge of tracing the wavelength from the Midgard Continent,
scripts.translation: 我负责追踪米德加尔特大陆的波长，

scripts.text: and the south camp is tracing it in this area.
scripts.translation: 南边的营地负责追踪这个区域的波长。

scripts.text: I asked them to assign top priority to this task, so with any luck, they've finished it by now.
scripts.translation: 我让他们把这项任务列为最高优先级，希望他们现在已经完成了。

scripts.text: ..What are you doing? I said, go ask the building manager about the trace results.
scripts.translation: ......你还在这里做什么？我说了，去问管理员追踪结果。

scripts.text: - You told her exactly what you were told by the soldier managing the building. -
scripts.translation: - 你把负责管理建筑的士兵告诉你的话原原本本转述给她。 -

scripts.text: Oh, is that the case? I see.
That means.. The man called Rayan isn't on the Midgard Continent or in this Ash Vacuum.
scripts.translation: 也就是说......那个叫拉扬的男子不在米德加尔特大陆，也不在阿什真空。

scripts.text: As I suspected, he must be with Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation: 正如我所料，他一定和魔王梦罗克在一起。

scripts.text: Pursuing Satan Morocc was supposed to be our last resort..
scripts.translation: 追踪魔王梦罗克原本是我们的最后手段......

scripts.text: ...I guess we have no choice now..
...I should log a report entry into this journal.
scripts.translation: ......我应该把报告记在这本日志里。

scripts.text: Our pursuit of Satan Morocc is at an end for now.
scripts.translation: 我们暂时停止追捕魔王梦罗克。

scripts.text: You did a great job helping us, and went above and beyond my expectations.
scripts.translation: 你帮了大忙，表现超出了我的预期。

scripts.text: Here, this is a reward for your help.
Keep up the good work assisting the explorers in this camp.
scripts.translation: 继续协助这个营地的探险家们。

scripts.text: Why do you keep giving me that dirty look?!
scripts.translation: 你为什么一直用那种眼神看我？！

scripts.text: Are you annoying me on purpose?
Go and find something else to do!
I'm stressed out and I've got a headache writing this report. I don't have the time to deal with you right now.
scripts.translation: 我压力很大，写这份报告让我头疼。我现在没空理你。

scripts.text: What is it that worries you?
Please, I've got enough worries already.
So, tell me, what is it?
{0}, you've done a great job helping us...
Oh, you must have questions about that last case, is that right?
scripts.translation: 哦，你一定是对上次的事件有疑问吧？

scripts.text: ...Wait, are you worried because of him?
scripts.translation: ......等等，你是因为他才担心的吗？

scripts.text: ...I see, you're worried about him being supported by the country.
scripts.translation: ......我明白了，你担心他会得到国家的支持。

scripts.text: This isn't a good time to disclose the truth. It'll cause more confusion.
scripts.translation: 现在不是揭露真相的好时机，只会引起更多混乱。

scripts.text: I believe the diplomats and presidents of both countries are responsible for those national matters.
scripts.translation: 我相信两国的外交官和领导人会负责处理这些国家事务。

scripts.text: This is out of your hands, adventurer.
scripts.translation: 这件事不是你能左右的，冒险者。

scripts.text: So stop worrying about it. Alright?
No country wants to start a war, especially when we have a greater common enemy.
scripts.translation: 没有哪个国家想挑起战争，尤其是我们还有一个更强大的共同敌人。

scripts.text: Just focus on what you can do to help us.
scripts.translation: 专心做你能做的事，帮助我们吧。

scripts.text: We've stopped pursuing Satan Morocc, so you may go help the other explorers now.
scripts.translation: 我们已经停止追捕魔王梦罗克了，你现在可以去帮助其他探险者。

scripts.text: I've already rewarded you for your services.
scripts.translation: 我已经为你的协助付过报酬了。

scripts.text: Remember; don't open your mouth about this to anyone.
scripts.translation: 记住，别向任何人透露这件事。

scripts.text: What is it? I thought you've been discharged from my service.
scripts.translation: 怎么了？我以为你已经不再替我办事了。

scripts.text: Did that old man send these?
Nothing good can come out of this if it's released to the public.
scripts.translation: 如果这件事公之于众，不会有任何好事发生。

scripts.text: Arunafeltz has replaced their leaders with the moderates just recently.
scripts.translation: 阿鲁纳菲兹最近刚由温和派取代了原来的领导层。

scripts.text: Shoving the remnants of the radicals in front of them is extremely dangerous.
scripts.translation: 把激进派的残余势力推到他们面前，极其危险。

scripts.text: We've finally made a truce with them.
scripts.translation: 我们终于和他们达成了停战协议。

scripts.text: Their sins will not be forgiven, but we won't make a stupid attempt to get revenge and end up shedding more blood!
scripts.translation: 他们的罪行不会被原谅，但我们不会愚蠢地复仇，害得更多人流血！

scripts.text: Let the politicians do their job.
scripts.translation: 让政治家们处理他们的事吧。

scripts.text: I assure you they won't lead us to the worst case scenario. That's what you're worried about, right?
scripts.translation: 我保证他们不会让局势发展到最糟。这正是你担心的，对吧？

scripts.text: Do you want us to wage war against Arunafeltz over this?!
scripts.translation: 你想因为这件事对阿鲁纳菲兹开战吗？！

scripts.text: Let me ask you to forget the past and focus on the present.
scripts.translation: 请你忘记过去，专注于现在。

scripts.text: For everyone's sake, please just look toward the future and move forward.
scripts.translation: 为了大家，请放眼未来，继续向前。

scripts.text: We won't do anything that you'd morally oppose.
scripts.translation: 我们不会做任何违背你道义的事。

scripts.text: You believe in peace, don't you?
Tell him that I'm grateful for these sweet potatoes, anyway..
scripts.translation: 总之，替我谢谢他送来的红薯......

scripts.text: Err? I don't have two Nice Sweet Potatoes..
scripts.translation: 咦？我没有两个美味红薯......

scripts.text: Let us take care of the rest.
I'm not suggesting that we should pretend as if the past never happened. All I'm saying is that we should work towards achieving a greater cause.
scripts.translation: 我不是说要假装过去从未发生过，而是说我们应该为更大的目标而努力。

scripts.text: I suppose I have an eye for people after all.
scripts.translation: 看来我确实有识人的眼光。

scripts.text: Keep up the good work, will you?

scripts.translation: 是紫锥菊船长派你来的吗？

scripts.text: I have something to report to you.
The magic wavelength of the requested pattern number has not been detected in this area.
scripts.translation: 在这个区域没有探测到指定编号对应的魔法波长。

scripts.text: It's not possible to trace the number around this area, but..
scripts.translation: 无法在这里追踪该编号，不过......

scripts.text: I can tell this magic pattern is supposed to be used to trace a human being.
scripts.translation: 我看得出，这个魔法图案是用来追踪某个人的。

scripts.text: You know tracing magic stones always come in pairs, don't you?
scripts.translation: 追踪用的魔法石总是成对出现，你知道吧？

scripts.text: Now, magic stones specifically used to trace humans have a special feature.
scripts.translation: 专门用于追踪人类的魔法石有个特殊性质。

scripts.text: When the target of the trace dies, the pair of stones are automatically destroyed.
scripts.translation: 追踪目标死亡时，成对的魔法石会自动销毁。

scripts.text: Since this patterned magic stone is still intact..
scripts.translation: 既然这块带有图案的魔法石还完好无损......

scripts.text: Well, this magic stone serves as proof that the target of the trace is still alive somewhere in the world.
scripts.translation: 也就是说，这块魔法石可以证明，追踪目标仍然活在世界某处。

scripts.text: Hopefully, we'll detect the same wavelength.
scripts.translation: 希望能探测到相同的波长。

scripts.text: Please report this to Captain Echinacea;
scripts.translation: 请把结果报告给紫锥菊船长：

scripts.text: We've failed to trace the location of the target,
scripts.translation: 我们没能追踪到目标的位置，

scripts.text: This device detects mana and magic wavelengths around this area. identifying what enemies we're dealing with.
scripts.translation: 这个装置能探测周围玛娜和魔法波长的变化，帮助我们识别正在面对的敌人。

scripts.text: It can be used to trace the wavelengths of location-tracing spells.
scripts.translation: 也能用来追踪定位法术的波长。

scripts.text: It's a fantastic product made from a combination of magic and science.
scripts.translation: 这是魔法与科学结合的杰作。

scripts.text: The Ash Vacuum hasn't been fully explored, and we don't know what kind of dangers to expect in this area.
scripts.translation: 阿什真空尚未被完全探索，我们不知道在这里会遇到什么危险。

scripts.text: By using this device, we can check the change and flow of mana around this area,
scripts.translation: 使用这个装置，我们可以检测这片区域玛娜的变化和流动，

scripts.text: and prepare for any possible threats.
scripts.translation: 并为可能出现的威胁做好准备。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 携带物品过多时，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Don't get too close to anything except the gate.
scripts.translation: 除了大门，别靠近任何东西。

scripts.text: An assistant? I don't think I need one, but...
scripts.translation: 助手？我觉得自己不需要助手，不过......

scripts.text: I guess I should give you something to do.
scripts.translation: 还是给你安排点事做吧。

scripts.text: Do you mind if I entrust you with a chore?
scripts.translation: 你愿意帮我做点杂事吗？

scripts.text: No, I don't mind at all.
Then why did you come all this way?
scripts.translation: 那你大老远跑来这里做什么？

scripts.text: I didn't really need any help to begin with. If you don't want to work, then stop bothering me.
scripts.translation: 我本来就不需要任何帮助。如果你不想工作，就别来烦我。

scripts.text: If you don't want to help us out then go back to Echinacea and let her know yourself!
scripts.translation: 如果你不想帮忙，就回去亲自告诉紫锥菊！

scripts.text: I don't know if Echinacea told you this already, but we are here
scripts.translation: ....不知道紫锥菊有没有告诉你，

scripts.text: to follow the traces of Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation: 我们在这里是为了追踪魔王梦罗克的踪迹。

scripts.text: Some of us are here in the Ash Vacuum, and the rest are on the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation: 我们一部分人在阿什真空，另一部分人在米德加尔特大陆。

scripts.text: We exchange information with our colleagues in Morocc on a regular basis, but we haven't heard from them for a while.
scripts.translation: 我们定期和梦罗克的同事交换情报，但有段时间没收到他们的消息了。

scripts.text: How'd you like to go gather some information for me?
scripts.translation: 你愿意替我去打听些消息吗？

scripts.text: It should be simple, so you I hope you'll be able to handle this.
scripts.translation: 这事应该很简单，希望你能胜任。

scripts.text: At Southwest Morocc, you'll find an underground tavern.
scripts.translation: 梦罗克西南边有一家地下酒馆。

scripts.text: Tell her I've sent you, and she'll take care of you.
scripts.translation: 告诉她是我派你去的，她会招待你。

scripts.text: If you don't have any business here, then step aside. It's too dangerous.
scripts.translation: 如果你在这里没有正事，就让开。这里太危险了。

scripts.text: You might not be able to return to this world if you enter a route that hasn't been properly identified.
scripts.translation: 如果你进入一条尚未确认的路线，可能就无法回到这个世界。

scripts.text: I guess she forced you to do this, huh? Don't worry; you're not the first victim of her bossiness.
scripts.translation: 看来她是逼你来做这个的，对吧？别担心，你不是第一个被她强势作风逼来的。

scripts.text: You should tell her if you really don't want to work for me.
scripts.translation: 如果你真的不想替我工作，就告诉她。

scripts.text: I can tell you aren't so happy with this, huh?
scripts.translation: 我看出来你对此并不太高兴。

scripts.text: While you're here, why don't you help us out and see where it goes?
scripts.translation: 既然你已经来了，何不帮个忙，看看接下来会怎样？

scripts.text: Don't worry, I won't give you a hard time...
scripts.translation: 别担心，我不会让你太辛苦......

scripts.text: I don't know if Echinacea told you this already, but we are here to follow the traces of Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation: ....不知道紫锥菊有没有告诉你，我们在这里是为了追踪魔王梦罗克的踪迹。

scripts.text: Some of us are here in the Ash Vacuum, and the rest are on the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation: 我们一部分人在阿什真空，另一部分人在米德加尔特大陆。

scripts.text: We exchange information with our colleagues in Morocc on a regular basis, but we haven't heard from them for a while.
scripts.translation: 我们定期与梦罗克那边的同事交换情报，但已经有一段时间没收到他们的消息了。

scripts.text: How'd you like to go gather some information for me?
scripts.translation: 你愿意替我去打听些消息吗？

scripts.text: It should be simple, so you I hope you'll be able to handle this.
scripts.translation: 这事应该很简单，希望你能胜任。

scripts.text: At Southwest Morocc, you'll find an underground tavern.
scripts.translation: 梦罗克西南边有一家地下酒馆。

scripts.text: Tell her I've sent you, and she'll take care of you.
scripts.translation: 告诉她是我派你来的，她会照顾你。

scripts.text: Let me explain one more time.
Go speak to Rin in an underground tavern at Southwest Morocc.
scripts.translation: 去梦罗克西南边的地下酒馆找琳恩。

scripts.text: You won't miss the tavern if you look for a boy named Jack standing out the front.
scripts.translation: 门口站着一个叫杰克的男孩，很容易认出来。

scripts.text: I heard Rin is wounded and bedridden...
scripts.translation: 我听说琳恩受伤了，卧床不起......

scripts.text: - Instead of an answer, you gave him Rin's journal and the bloody crystal.-
scripts.translation: - 你没有回答，而是把琳恩的日记和沾血的结晶递给了他。 -

scripts.text: ...A journal? I see. Hopefully this'll help me understand the situation..
scripts.translation: ......一本日记？我明白了。希望这能帮我了解情况......

scripts.text: So Rayan has finally been located, huh?
scripts.translation: 看来拉扬终于被找到了。

scripts.text: There was a skirmish at the mountain, and.. a raid...
scripts.translation: 山上发生了小规模冲突......还有一次突袭......

scripts.text: I mean Rin. How is she?
scripts.translation: 我是说琳恩。她怎么样了？

scripts.text: She needs to spend some time in bed,
scripts.translation: 她需要卧床休息一段时间，

scripts.text: but she's conscious and still in one piece.
scripts.translation: 但意识清醒，身体也没有大碍。

scripts.text: She seems to have no problem taking care of herself,
scripts.translation: 她看起来还能自理，但我有点担心，

scripts.text: but I'm worried because sometimes she looks extremely exhausted. She mentioned that her vision blurs when she's very tired..
scripts.translation: 因为她有时显得极度疲惫。她说自己累坏时视线会变得模糊......

scripts.text: Don't worry; I don't think it's serious because she still had the strength to yell while writing that journal.
scripts.translation: 别担心，我觉得不严重。她写那篇日记的时候还有力气大喊大叫呢。

scripts.text: I asked about her because I don't want her injury to interfere with our schedule.
scripts.translation: 我问她是因为不希望她的伤势影响我们的日程。

scripts.text: As for you, I want you to come back later.
I need you to substitute for Rin until she recovers..
scripts.translation: 我需要你代替琳恩，直到她康复......

scripts.text: Hm, thanks for all your help.
Now, would you leave me alone for a while? I need to write a report based on the findings in this journal.
scripts.translation: 现在，能让我一个人待一会儿吗？我得根据这本日记里的发现写一份报告。

scripts.text: (I was supposed to give him the 'Morocc Pursuit Journal' and a 'Bloody Crystal of the Darkness'...
scripts.translation: （我本该把《梦罗克追踪日志》和《黑暗的血色结晶体》交给他......

scripts.text: Err? Where have they gone? I need to find them.)
scripts.translation: 咦？它们去哪儿了？我得找找。）

scripts.text: Kidd is standing at the side of the space gap, leafing through the journal's pages and taking notes.
scripts.translation: 基德站在次元裂缝旁，翻阅日记并做着笔记。

scripts.text: The 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness' is sitting aside, and remains untouched.
scripts.translation: “黑暗的血色结晶体”放在一旁，没人碰过。

scripts.text: I feel the crystal resonating with the space gap.
scripts.translation: 我感觉结晶体在与次元裂缝产生共鸣。

scripts.text: I suddenly have the urge to touch the crystal...
scripts.translation: 我突然有一种想要触碰它的冲动......

scripts.text: Err? What are you trying to do?
I'm sorry if I bothered you while you were writing your report.
- Kidd stopped you from touching the crystal, but somehow, it still captivates you. -
scripts.translation: - 基德阻止了你触碰结晶体，但不知为何，它依然吸引着你。 -

scripts.text: Rin! Where's Rin? What about Rayan?
scripts.translation: 琳恩！琳恩在哪儿？拉扬呢？

scripts.text: Where the hell have you been?
..Oh yeah, I saw Rin fighting Rayan.
scripts.translation: ......哦对，我看到琳恩在和拉扬战斗。

scripts.text: She was defeated by magic, and then disappeared...
scripts.translation: 她被魔法击败，然后消失了......

scripts.text: I heard your voice once I found a strange scroll.
scripts.translation: 我找到一张奇怪卷轴时，听到了你的声音。

scripts.text: - Ignoring the confused look on Mr. Kidd's face, you searched your pockets, and found the mysterious scroll. -
scripts.translation: - 无视基德先生困惑的表情，你摸了摸口袋，找到了那张神秘的卷轴。 -

scripts.text: - It wasn't a dream after all... What you saw actually happened. -
scripts.translation: - 原来不是梦......你看到的确实发生了。 -

scripts.text: - You show Kidd the scroll and tell him what happened. -
scripts.translation: - 你向基德展示卷轴，并告诉他发生了什么。 -

scripts.text: you found this from a member of Rayan's gang?
scripts.translation: 你是在拉扬团伙的成员身上找到这张卷轴的？

scripts.text: it's a scroll containing a magic spell that can be used by anyone, even if they aren't trained as mages.
scripts.translation: 这是一张魔法卷轴，任何人都可以使用，即使没有受过魔法训练。

scripts.text: Hmm, this scroll is sealed and needs some kind of pass code to use it.
scripts.translation: 嗯，这张卷轴被封印了，需要某种密码才能使用。

scripts.text: I'll consult with the camp scholars about this scroll later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后会请营地的学者研究这张卷轴。

scripts.text: By the way, I saw you touch this 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness.'
scripts.translation: 顺便说一下，我看到你触碰了这块“黑暗的血色结晶体”。

scripts.text: There was a bright flash of light around you, and then you were suddenly drawn into the space gap.
scripts.translation: 你周围闪过一道亮光，然后突然被吸入次元裂缝。

scripts.text: I thought I was just seeing things, but it's obvious now that it really happened.
scripts.translation: 我以为自己看花了眼，但现在很明显，那确实发生了。

scripts.text: You were actually in the past for a little while there.
scripts.translation: 你刚才真的在过去待了一会儿。

scripts.text: I'm afraid this space gap hides bigger secrets than we thought.
scripts.translation: 恐怕这个次元裂缝隐藏着比我们想象中更多的秘密。

scripts.text: ..It not only warps space, but also time ...
scripts.translation: ......它不只扭曲空间，也会扭曲时间......

scripts.text: Forget it. I was just thinking out loud.
From now on, we should be extra careful about letting anything into this space gap. I need to report this incident to upper management.
scripts.translation: 从现在开始，我们得格外小心，别让任何东西进入次元裂缝。我需要向高层汇报这件事。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but can you ask a scholar about this spell scroll?
scripts.translation: 抱歉，你能去问问学者这张魔法卷轴的事吗？

scripts.text: If you don't know which scholar you should consult, then you'd better ^4d4dffask Echinacea^000000
scripts.translation: 如果不知道该问谁，最好去请^4d4dff教紫锥菊^000000。

scripts.text: Did you find a scholar to ask about the scroll?
scripts.translation: 你找到学者询问卷轴的事了吗？

scripts.text: If you don't know which scholar to consult, then you'd better ask Echinacea.
scripts.translation: 如果你不知道该咨询哪位学者，最好去问问紫锥菊。

scripts.text: So this scroll is from Arunafeltz, huh?
scripts.translation: 所以这张卷轴来自阿鲁纳菲兹，是吗？

scripts.text: Is that why you're gathering items to unseal the scroll?
scripts.translation: 这就是你在收集解除卷轴封印所需物品的原因？

scripts.text: - Let's bring Defaria the items to unseal the spell scroll. -
scripts.translation: - 我们把解除魔法卷轴封印的物品带给德法里亚吧。 -

scripts.text: Keep up the good work, adventurer.
This must be the spell scroll, huh?
scripts.translation: 这一定就是那张魔法卷轴吧？
里面有一种瞬间移动法术，

scripts.text: that will send the user to a specific location.. Hmm...
scripts.translation: 会把使用者传送到特定地点......嗯......

scripts.text: You said you've heard Rayan ordering others to come to a certain place.
scripts.translation: 你说听到拉扬命令同伙去某个地方。

scripts.text: If the spell of this scroll leads to that place..
scripts.translation: 如果这张卷轴会把人传到那里......

scripts.text: Then again.. Somebody will have to go there eventually..
scripts.translation: 不过......迟早会有人得去那里......

scripts.text: Why are you looking at me?!
.Alright, then. Would you rather capture reincarnations of Morocc and collect their remnants?
scripts.translation: 好吧。那么，你愿意改去捕捉魔王梦罗克的转世体，

scripts.text: Scholars suspect the recent space-time phenomenon has been caused by the 'Bloody Crystals of the Darkness,'
scripts.translation: 并收集他们的残骸吗？学者们怀疑近期的时空现象是“黑暗的血色结晶体”造成的。

scripts.text: so they want to study the crystals, which they believe are remnants of the of Morocc's reincarnations.
scripts.translation: 他们认为这些结晶体是魔王梦罗克转世体留下的，想要研究。

scripts.text: That sounds way more dangerous, doesn't it? Go check that place out instead.
scripts.translation: 听起来那个更危险，不是吗？还是去调查那个地方吧。

scripts.text: Both those missions are dangerous, but I think you'll be risking your life less by checking out that place.
scripts.translation: 这两个任务都很危险，但我认为去调查那个地方风险会小一些。

scripts.text: Now, listen. Use the spell scroll to teleport there, and then investigate the area. Find some clues.
scripts.translation: 听好了。用魔法卷轴传送过去，然后调查那片区域，寻找线索。

scripts.text: Don't put yourself in danger, and retreat when things get too dangerous.
scripts.translation: 别让自己身陷险境，情况危险就撤退。

scripts.text: By the time you come back,
we should have figured out the cause of the strange phenomenon near this space gap.
scripts.translation: 我们应该已经查明次元裂缝附近奇怪现象的原因。

scripts.text: We'll think about everything else after you come back, alright?
scripts.translation: 其他事情等你回来再商量，好吗？

scripts.text: Where's the scroll? Did you use it?
That scroll contains a teleportation spell.
scripts.translation: 那张卷轴包含瞬间移动法术。

scripts.text: Using it will lead you to a place that has something to do with them.
scripts.translation: 使用它会把你带到一个与他们有关的地方。

scripts.text: You're supposed to gather some clues once you're there.
scripts.translation: 你到了那里应该收集一些线索。

scripts.text: ..I guess you haven't found any clues.
Do you remember the location of that place?
scripts.translation: 还记得那个地方在哪儿吗？

scripts.text: Why don't you go it check out again?
Yes, there must be some sort of clue there.
That scroll contains a teleportation spell.
scripts.translation: 那张卷轴包含瞬间移动法术。

scripts.text: Using it will lead you to a place that has something to do with them.
scripts.translation: 使用它会把你带到一个与他们有关的地方。

scripts.text: You're supposed to gather some clues once you're there.
scripts.translation: 到了那里记得收集线索。

scripts.text: If you lost the scroll, I expect you to find that place at any cost.
scripts.translation: 如果你弄丢了卷轴，就无论如何也要找到那个地方。

scripts.text: What did you find over there?
- You interrupted Mr. Kidd, and told him what you heard from the basement in the empty house near the national border. -
scripts.translation: - 你打断基德先生，把在国境附近那间空屋地下室听到的话告诉了他。 -

scripts.text: And the location is.. Okay, I got it.
Can you go back and spy on them a bit more?
scripts.translation: 你能回去再监视他们一会儿吗？

scripts.text: I'll follow you as soon as I report these findings to the higher-ups.
scripts.translation: 我向高层汇报这些发现后就去找你。

scripts.text: They must be having a serious internal dispute,
scripts.translation: 他们内部一定发生了严重争执，

scripts.text: meaning it's the perfect time for us to raid them.
scripts.translation: 这正是我们突袭的好时机。

scripts.text: Keep monitoring them for me, alright?
scripts.translation: 继续替我监视他们，好吗？

scripts.text: He's locked up in the basement, and Rin is interrogating him.
scripts.translation: 他被关在地下室，琳恩正在审问他。

scripts.text: You know, she's the best interrogator we've got. There'll be no escape for that guy ..
scripts.translation: 她是我们最好的审讯官。那个家伙别想逃......

scripts.text: ..Wait, what if the same thing happens..?
The crystal no longer resonates with the space gap.
scripts.translation: 这块结晶体不再与次元裂缝共鸣了。

scripts.text: Now it's exactly the same as a regular Crystal of Darkness.
scripts.translation: 现在它和普通的黑暗结晶体完全一样。

scripts.text: That means, the phenomenon that you've experienced with the 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness' can't be..
scripts.translation: 也就是说，你遇到的“黑暗的血色结晶体”现象无法......

scripts.text: ..I guess not. It might have resonated to your mana or wavelength.
scripts.translation: ......我想也是。它可能与你的玛娜或波长产生了共鸣。

scripts.text: Why don't you carry it with you? Let me know if you experience any strange phenomenon again.
scripts.translation: 你不妨把它带在身上。如果再遇到什么奇怪的现象，告诉我一声。

scripts.text: Oh, and please bring ^4d4dffthis journal to Rin^000000.
scripts.translation: 哦，还有，请^4d4dff把这本日志带给琳^000000恩。

scripts.text: This will be your last assignment from me.
scripts.translation: 这是我交给你的最后一个任务。

scripts.text: Why should I carry the crystal?
scripts.translation: 为什么我要带着结晶体？
这个最后的任务是什么？

scripts.text: We're just using one journal to record each other's work.
scripts.translation: 我们只是用同一本日志来记录彼此的工作。

scripts.text: Why can't you use separate journals and then combine them later?
scripts.translation: 为什么不能各用各的日志，之后再合并呢？

scripts.text: Ask Echinacea. I'm just doing what the boss tells me to do.
scripts.translation: 去问紫锥菊吧。我只是照老板的吩咐办事。

scripts.text: Using one set journal is a good way to keep in contact and accumulate a history of work in chronological order.
scripts.translation: 共用一本日志，能让我们保持联系，并按时间顺序记录工作进展。

scripts.text: We came up with the idea to share our experiences
scripts.translation: 我们的想法是共享彼此的经历，

scripts.text: and understand any relation between incidents
scripts.translation: 尽可能快速、轻松地弄清各个事件之间是否有关联.

scripts.text: as quickly and easily as possible..
I know it's a little bit counterproductive, but I'm satisfied with the quality of information shared between us.
scripts.translation: 我知道这样有点适得其反，不过我对彼此共享的信息质量很满意。

scripts.text: The notes that Rin has absent-mindedly written down can turn out to be great clues for me..
scripts.translation: 琳恩随手记下的笔记，有时会成为很重要的线索......

scripts.text: Yeah, I agree that the journal looks pretty disorganized.
scripts.translation: 是的，我也觉得这本日志看起来挺杂乱的。

scripts.text: Rayan has already been caught, so the task to locate him and Rin is already done.
scripts.translation: 拉扬已经被抓住，寻找他和琳恩的任务也结束了。

scripts.text: You were just an assistant to start with.
Anyways, please deliver the journal to her safely.
scripts.translation: 总之，请把日志安全地交给她。

scripts.text: I'm still not done yet; Echinacea already has another task for me..
scripts.translation: 我还没忙完呢，紫锥菊已经给我安排了另一个任务......

scripts.text: I asked you to deliver the journal to Rin.
scripts.translation: 我让你把日志交给琳恩。

scripts.text: You didn't forget it, did you?
By the way, I'm still not convinced that we've captured the real Rayan.
scripts.translation: 顺便说一句，我仍不确定我们抓到的是真正的拉扬。

scripts.text: Will you tell Rin to write down the results of her interrogation in the journal?
scripts.translation: 你能让琳恩把审讯结果记在日志里吗？

scripts.text: Of course, I'm pretty sure she'll do it without me reminding her.
scripts.translation: 当然，我相信她不用我提醒也会记下来的。

scripts.text: You don't have to report everything to me.
I can check the journal later.
Why don't you go assist Rin for now?
..Things didn't turn out exactly as we hoped, but there's nothing we can do for now.
scripts.translation: ...事情并没有完全按照我们的预期发展，但现在也无能为力了。

scripts.text: you've been of great help to us.
I told you that I won't have any more work available for you. Well, for a good while, anyway..
scripts.translation: 我告诉过你，暂时不会再给你安排工作了。至少这阵子不会......
德法里亚先生派我来的

scripts.text: ..I guess he's finally made a fire, huh?
Tell him thanks for these sweet potatoes.
scripts.translation: 替我谢谢他送来的红薯。
询问关于阿鲁纳菲兹的事

scripts.text: I'm indebted to them, but they all died before I had a chance to pay them back.
scripts.translation: 我欠他们人情，可他们都在我来得及报答之前去世了。

scripts.text: If you're asking about my political opinion, I'm not going to answer.
scripts.translation: 如果你是在问我的政治立场，我不会回答。

scripts.text: This isn't something with which I can interfere.
Let me tell you that, from their point of view; their one last chance was destroyed.
scripts.translation: 从他们的角度看，最后的机会被毁掉了。

scripts.text: They're probably too ashamed to even talk about it.
scripts.translation: 他们大概羞愧得连提都不敢提。

scripts.text: Let our diplomats use that fact to their advantage, alright?
scripts.translation: 让我们的外交官利用这一点，好吗？

scripts.text: No conflicts have arisen recently, either.
scripts.translation: 最近也没有发生任何冲突。

scripts.text: Besides, nationality isn't important to us.
scripts.translation: 而且，国籍对我们来说并不重要。

scripts.text: What's important is whether or not they're our enemies, and whether or not they're the target of our missions.
scripts.translation: 重要的是他们是不是敌人，以及是不是我们的任务目标。

scripts.text: Err? I don't have two Nice Sweet Potatoes..
scripts.translation: 咦？我没有两个美味红薯......

scripts.text: A mission is just a mission.
Don't get too emotional or curious about it.
scripts.translation: 别太感情用事，也别太好奇。

scripts.text: ...You'd better not approach the space gap off the official route.
scripts.translation: ......你最好别擅自离开正式路线，靠近次元裂缝。

scripts.text: If you're not authorized, then turn away. This thing is too dangerous for capricious exploration.
scripts.translation: 没有得到许可就离开那里。这东西太危险，不适合随意探索。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 携带物品过多时，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: I'm experiencing a turning point in my life right now.
scripts.translation: 我现在正处于人生的转折点。

scripts.text: - The fire sparked, but then it immediatly blew out. -
scripts.translation: - 火苗刚刚点燃，随即就熄灭了。 -

scripts.text: You know, that was my ninety-third attempt to make a fire with wet firewood.
scripts.translation: 你知道吗，这是我第九十三次尝试用湿柴生火。

scripts.text: Wait, was that the ninty fourth ot ninety fifth?
scripts.translation: 等等，是第九十四次还是第九十五次？

scripts.text: I'm experiencing a turning point in my life right now.
scripts.translation: 我现在正处于人生的转折点。

scripts.text: - The fire sparked, but then it immediately blew out.-
scripts.translation: - 火苗刚刚点燃，随即就熄灭了。 -

scripts.text: to make fun of my stupid attempt to roast these sweet potatoes with wet firewood?
scripts.translation: 嘲笑我用湿柴烤红薯的愚蠢尝试吗？

scripts.text: A spell scroll? May I see?
scripts.translation: 法术卷轴？能让我看看吗？

scripts.text: Eek... So Echinacea referred you to me, huh?
scripts.translation: 哎呀......所以是紫锥菊让你来找我的？

scripts.text: As you can see, this scroll is sealed.
scripts.translation: 正如你所见，这张卷轴被封印了。

scripts.text: It can only be unsealed by a secret method.
scripts.translation: 必须用一种秘密方法才能解除封印。

scripts.text: The way it's sealed is the same method used by the temple...
scripts.translation: 它的封印方式和神殿使用的方法相同......

scripts.text: I don't know how you've gotten this scroll,
scripts.translation: 我不知道你是怎么得到这张卷轴的，

scripts.text: ...but I'll try to help you on behalf of the respectable scholars of Arunafeltz.
scripts.translation: ......但我会代表阿鲁纳菲兹的学者尽力帮助你。

scripts.text: But remember; I'm not doing this officially. Please don't make me disgrace my country by helping you. Do you understand what I'm saying?
scripts.translation: 但请记住，我不是在履行官方职责。别让我因为帮你而辱没国家。明白我的意思吗？

scripts.text: Good. Then I expect you to help me by gathering the items I need to unseal the scroll:
scripts.translation: 很好。那就请你帮我收集解除卷轴封印所需的物品：

scripts.text: ^4d4dff30 Holy Waters, Runes of Darkness, and Bloody Runes^000000.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff圣水30份、黑暗符文和血色符^000000文。

scripts.text: I'll be waiting for your return.
At first, you looked like someone who is reliable and understands the difference between official and private matters.
scripts.translation: 起初，你看起来可靠，也懂得区分公事与私事。

scripts.text: Your answer just proved me wrong.
scripts.translation: 你的回答证明我看错了。

scripts.text: Echinacea must be getting desperate if she's asking people like you for help.
scripts.translation: 紫锥菊一定是走投无路了，才会找你这样的人帮忙。

scripts.text: Good, it wasn't hard, was it?
Okay, can you come back in a little bit?

scripts.translation: 解除卷轴封印需要圣水30份、

scripts.text: I need ^4d4dff30 Holy Waters, Runes of the Darkness, and Bloody Runes^000000.
Don't forget to bring the spell scroll along with them.
scripts.translation: 别忘了把魔法卷轴也带来。

scripts.text: While you're gathering the items, I'll be roasting my sweet potatoes.
scripts.translation: 你收集物品的时候，我会继续烤红薯。

scripts.text: If I could only make this fire work...
scripts.translation: 要是我能把这火生起来就好了......

scripts.text: Welcome back; you came at the perfect time.
scripts.translation: 欢迎回来，你来得正是时候。

scripts.text: First, this spell scroll contains a teleportation spell.
scripts.translation: 首先，这张魔法卷轴里包含一个瞬间移动法术。

scripts.text: You know what teleportation is, don't you?
scripts.translation: 你知道什么是瞬间移动吧？

scripts.text: it's a spell that instantly moves you to a different location.
scripts.translation: 种能瞬间将你移动到别处的法术。

scripts.text: That's the spell contained in this scroll.
scripts.translation: 这张卷轴里包含的就是这种法术。

scripts.text: This scroll will teleport you to a specific location.
scripts.translation: 这张卷轴会把你传送到特定地点。

scripts.text: Such scrolls are generally used by ^4d4dfforganizations to gather their members^000000.
scripts.translation: 这类卷轴通常^4d4dff由组织用来召集成员^000000。

scripts.text: I don't know where this scroll will lead you..
scripts.translation: 我不知道这张卷轴会把你传送到哪里......

scripts.text: You'll be the one using this scroll. Am I right?
scripts.translation: 毕竟要用卷轴的是你，对吧？
.对了！我记得拉扬提到过要在某个地方集合！

scripts.text: So this scroll will take me to that meeting?
scripts.translation: 所以这张卷轴会带我去那里吗？

scripts.text: Um, do you mind? Would you stop talking to yourself and just leave already?
scripts.translation: 呃，你介意吗？别再自言自语了，赶紧离开吧。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but this old man needs some rest, alright?
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我这把老骨头需要休息，好吗？

scripts.text: What are you so worried about?
You'll see how it works as soon as you use it.
scripts.translation: 一用就知道它怎么运作了。

scripts.text: ..I know they're involved in this case, but
Just tell me what you know.
Why should I go through all that trouble?
You can go and ask Echinaea.
This old man needs some rest, alright?
scripts.translation: 我这把老骨头得休息了，好吗？

scripts.text: What th--! How dare you fool an old man!
scripts.translation: 什么——！你竟敢戏弄一个老人！

scripts.text: but I'm a representative of great Arunafeltz's scholars!
scripts.translation: 但我可是阿鲁纳菲兹大学者的代表！

scripts.text: It's a mistake to trifle with me like that!
scripts.translation: 这样戏弄我可是大错特错！

scripts.text: Did you think I'm stupid just because I was trying to make a fire with wet firewood?!
scripts.translation: 你以为我用湿柴生火就是傻瓜吗？！

scripts.text: ..*Pant Pant*.. Phew, even yelling tires me out..
scripts.translation: ......*气喘吁吁*......呼，连吼几句都累坏我了......

scripts.text: ...Umm... Can you bring me some Logs?
...And some sweet potatoes too, if you don't mind.
I need sweet potatoes for me, Mr. Kidd, and Echi... Umm...
scripts.translation: 我要给自己、基德先生和紫锥菊准备红薯......嗯......

scripts.text: Please bring me ^4d4dff20 Sweet Potatoes and 30 Logs^000000.
I'll be waiting for your return.
You seem to give up really easily.
I don't blame you. Sometimes giving up is the best decision,
scripts.translation: 我不怪你。有时候放弃是最好的决定，

scripts.text: not to mention that it takes a certain kind of courage.
For example, Tarous that know when to abandon their hopes of getting cheese, you know, the bait in traps, are the hardest ones to catch. You know?
scripts.translation: 比如那些知道何时放弃奶酪的塔罗斯——你懂的，就是陷阱里的诱饵。它们反而最难抓。明白吗？
是的，我来自阿鲁纳菲兹......

scripts.text: Be more specific about your question,
scripts.translation: 把你的问题说得更具体一点，

scripts.text: Oh, you've really brought what I wanted!
scripts.translation: 哦，你真的把我要的东西带来了！

scripts.text: No, wait, can you pile them on the firewood over there?
scripts.translation: 不，等等，能把它们堆在那边的柴火上吗？

scripts.text: Make it a nice, neat pile, please.
Oh, you forgot to put the sweet potatoes on top.
scripts.translation: 哦，别忘了把红薯放在上面。

scripts.text: Hopefully I can make a fire with your nice logs....
scripts.translation: 希望我能用你带来的好木柴生起火......

scripts.text: Oh, this is as great as I'd hoped!
scripts.translation: 哦，这比我预想的还要好！

scripts.text: I guess my magic hasn't gotten that rusty after all..
scripts.translation: 看来我的魔法并没有那么生疏......

scripts.text: If you want me to do you a favor, then
you should bring me ^4d4dff20 Sweet Potatoes and 30 Logs^000000 in return.
scripts.translation: 就带红薯2^4d4dff0个、原木30根来^000000作为回报。

scripts.text: - Defaria is blowing on a roast sweet potato, peeling off it's skin. -
scripts.translation: - 德法里亚正对着烤红薯吹气，并剥去它的皮。 -

scripts.text: ... Dandelion? I wanted you to tell me what you knew.
scripts.translation: ......蒲公英？我想让你告诉我你知道的事。

scripts.text: I was hoping you'd remember something about Dandelion.
scripts.translation: 希望你还记得一些关于蒲公英的事。

scripts.text: do you want me to confirm
if Dandelion is really supported by Arunafeltz?
scripts.translation: 你想让我确认蒲公英是否真的得到阿鲁纳菲兹的支持吗？

scripts.text: Umm... I don't know what to say... I don't feel comfortable talking about politics.
scripts.translation: 呃......我不知道该说什么......我不太想谈政治。

scripts.text: ...Do you mind delivering these to Mr. Kidd?
scripts.translation: ......能请你把这些交给基德先生吗？

scripts.text: - Defaria has given you 2 Nice Sweet Potatoes. -
scripts.translation: - 德法里亚给了你2个美味红薯。 -

scripts.text: Um, I just told you to deliver those sweet potatoes to Mr. Kidd.
scripts.translation: 呃，我刚刚才让你把那些红薯交给基德先生。

scripts.text: There are many different types of people in this world.
scripts.translation: 这个世界上有各种各样的人。

scripts.text: Some people want war while others are against it.
scripts.translation: 有些人想要战争，有些人则反对。

scripts.text: The Dandelions were the former case.
Those right-ists believed in a distorted patriotism. They thought shedding blood was the only way to make peace.
scripts.translation: 那些右翼分子信奉扭曲的爱国主义，认为只有流血才能换来和平。

scripts.text: and they happened to ally themselves with the warmongers in the government.
scripts.translation: 并与政府中的战争狂热者结成了同盟。

scripts.text: That's how they grew so strong.
scripts.translation: 他们就是这样壮大起来的。

scripts.text: At first, their purpose was limited to gathering intel and spying on other countries.
scripts.translation: 起初，他们只负责搜集情报、监视他国。

scripts.text: This is just what I think, but the right information can cause chaos in a country.
scripts.translation: 这只是我的看法，不过，准确的情报也能让一国陷入混乱。

scripts.text: Can't you see it by now? Isn't it obvious?
Well, if you can't take care of your own problems,
scripts.translation: 这不是很明显吗？好吧，如果你连自己的问题都解决不了，

scripts.text: then you won't be able to handle your enemies.

scripts.translation: 所以是阿鲁纳菲兹策划了这一切！

scripts.text: No, it isn't that simple. The world isn't just black and white, you know?

scripts.text: Be safe, and look out for yourself, okay?
somewhere south of the second hill of a mountain west from Abyss Lake.
scripts.translation: 深渊湖以西的山脉中，第二座山丘的南侧。

scripts.text: How do I remember the location so clearly?
scripts.translation: 我怎么会记得这么清楚？

scripts.text: It's the last location where I searched for Rayan. How can I not remember?
scripts.translation: 那是我最后一次搜查拉扬的地方，我当然记得。

scripts.text: Don't underestimate me; I'm an elite member of my guild.
scripts.translation: 别小看我，我可是公会的精英成员。

scripts.text: - You told her you couldn't find anything regarding their whereabouts,
scripts.translation: - 你告诉她没找到他们行踪的线索，

scripts.text: but you found the ''Bloody Crystal of Darkness'' in the bushes.
scripts.translation: 但在灌木丛里发现了“黑暗的血色结晶体”。 -

scripts.text: You can feel the evil spirit just by looking at it.
scripts.translation: 光看一眼就能感受到它的邪恶气息。

scripts.text: This...there's no doubt. It's the same kind of crystal as the ones found on Satan Morocc and his minions.
scripts.translation: 毫无疑问，这和魔王梦罗克及其爪牙身上的结晶体是同一种。
可是......这块结晶体留在了那里......

scripts.text: So it seems Rayan and Satan Morocc...there really is something going on between those two.
scripts.translation: 看来拉扬和魔王梦罗克......他们之间确实有某种联系。

scripts.text: Just lying here, not being able to do anything...it's so frustrating.
scripts.translation: ..只能躺在这里，什么都做不了......真让人沮丧。

scripts.text: Here, take this journal to Mr. Kidd.
scripts.translation: 拿着，把这本日志交给基德先生。

scripts.text: It should've been done a while ago.
Oh, bring this crystal to him as well.
scripts.translation: 哦，这块结晶体也一并交给他。

scripts.text: Ah..the journal..Yes, I should record this incident onto the journal.
scripts.translation: 啊......日志......是的，我应该把这次事件记在日志里。

scripts.text: Here's the journal and the crystal.
Take them to Mr. Kidd for me.
- You received the journal from Rin.
scripts.translation: - 你从琳恩那里收到了日志。

scripts.text: Instead of a journal, it's more like a bunch of documents being exchanged. -
scripts.translation: 与其说是日志，不如说是一叠互相传阅的文件。 -

scripts.text: Can you show it to me?
Oh, I don't have it with me. I'll go bring it right away.
scripts.translation: 哦，我没带在身上。我马上去拿。

scripts.text: ^4d4dff(Wait, what did I do with it? I didn't sell it or anything, did I?)^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff（等等，我把它放哪儿了？我没卖掉吧^000000？）

scripts.text: Hurry up; deliver the journal and crystal to Mr. Kidd.
scripts.translation: 快点，把日志和结晶体交给基德先生。

scripts.text: ..Argh.. I'm still recovering .. I'm not supposed to move~
- You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 携带物品过多时，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Hey, you've come back at just the right time.
Look at him; this is ridiculous.
I know what I did is unforgivable, no matter how good my reason might be.
scripts.translation: 我知道自己做的一切不可原谅，不管理由多么正当。

scripts.text: ..But... *Sigh*... It's too late to regret it now, isn't it?
scripts.translation: ......可是......*叹气*......现在后悔也来不及了，不是吗？

scripts.text: Don't you know? He's Rayan Moore who dared to release Satan Morocc, deceive everyone, and bring havoc to this world.
scripts.translation: 你不知道吗？他就是拉扬·摩尔，那个胆敢释放魔王梦罗克、欺骗众人并给世界带来浩劫的人。

scripts.text: Not only that, he slaughtered his own comrades without mercy!
scripts.translation: 不仅如此，他还毫不留情地屠杀了自己的同伴！

scripts.text: ..I.. I.. I killed them with my own hands!
He still hasn't gotten over the fact that he killed all of his comrades.-
scripts.translation: 他仍然无法接受自己杀死了所有同伴的事实。 -

scripts.text: He doesn't look like the Rayan I know.
scripts.translation: 他看起来不像我认识的那个拉扬。

scripts.text: I don't know. This Rayan seems to be a completely different individual than the one we know.
scripts.translation: 我不知道。这个拉扬似乎和我们认识的那个人完全不同。

scripts.text: I guess this is what they call Multiple Personality Disorder.
scripts.translation: 我想这就是所谓的多重人格障碍。

scripts.text: This Rayan isn't the Rayan Moore that plotted the conspiracy,
scripts.translation: 这个拉扬不是策划阴谋的拉扬·摩尔，

scripts.text: but another personality hidden inside of him.
scripts.translation: 而是隐藏在他体内的另一个人格。

scripts.text: Hey, calm down. Why don't you speak slowly?
..It was me.. I was only going to pretend to break the seal of Satan Morocc...
scripts.translation: ......是我......我原本只是想假装打破魔王梦罗克的封印......

scripts.text: Don't you see? I meant for it to just be an act! I was going to throw the town in panic...
scripts.translation: 你们不明白吗？那只是演戏！我本想让城镇陷入恐慌......

scripts.text: ..That would be my chance to spread the teachings of Freya, our messiah.
scripts.translation: ......那样我就有机会传播我们救世主芙蕾雅的教义。

scripts.text: Man, how can you be so stupid?!
scripts.translation: 天哪，你怎么能这么愚蠢？！

scripts.text: I was studying some documents for my plan, and then I found something by accident.
scripts.translation: 我在研究计划相关的文件时，偶然发现了某样东西。

scripts.text: That was when I became a completely different person.. *Sob*
scripts.translation: 就在那时，我变成了另一个人......*抽泣*

scripts.text: ..My plan.. It was like I wasn't myself anymore. I wanted to release Satan Morocc for real.
scripts.translation: ......我的计划......我好像不再是自己了。我想真正释放魔王梦罗克。

scripts.text: I kidnapped children.. Threatened my comrades.
scripts.translation: 我绑架了孩子......还威胁同伴。

scripts.text: ..I held the true ritual to break the seal and release Satan Morocc...
scripts.translation: ......我举行了真正的仪式，要打破封印、释放魔王梦罗克......

scripts.text: Wah.. My.. My head hurts.. This.. No, you can't.. Waaah!
- Suddenly Rayan started talking nonsense and then pulled his hair out in anguish.
scripts.translation: - 拉扬突然开始胡言乱语，痛苦地揪着自己的头发。

scripts.text: It seems as if he is trying to resist the evil personality within him. -
scripts.translation: 看起来他正在试图抵抗体内的邪恶人格。 -

scripts.text: - Wanting to stop Rayan from going berserk, you smacked the back of his head with the journal. Rayan staggered and then fell to the ground. Nice job! -
scripts.translation: - 为了阻止拉扬发狂，你用日志敲了他的后脑勺。拉扬踉跄几步，倒在地上。干得好！ -

scripts.text: - Wanting to stop Rayan from going berserk, you sucker punched him in the 'ole bread basket. Rayan staggered and then fell to the ground...! -
scripts.translation: - 为了阻止拉扬发狂，你狠狠揍了他的肚子。拉扬踉跄几步，倒在地上......！ -

scripts.text: - Wanting to stop Rayan from going berserk, you slapped his face with the journal. Rayan staggered and then fell onto the ground. Wah! -
scripts.translation: - 为了阻止拉扬发狂，你用日志扇了他的脸。拉扬踉跄几步，倒在地上。哇！ -

scripts.text: - By your sudden violent move, the Bloody Crystal of Darkness flew out of your jacket, and rolled on the ground toward Rayan. -
scripts.translation: - 你突然动手时，黑暗的血色结晶体从夹克里飞出，滚到了拉扬身边。 -
为什么......这里没有次元裂缝啊......？

scripts.text: He's come.. My master has arrived!!
As you command, master. I'm here to serve you!
scripts.translation: 遵命，主人。我来为您效命！

scripts.text: I'll be back at full strength,
scripts.translation: 我会以完全的力量归来，

scripts.text: and I'll pay you back for locking me in the darkness for hundreds of years!^000000
scripts.translation: 为被你们囚禁在黑暗中数百年一事向你们讨^000000还！

scripts.text: Are you Rayan? Or are you someone else now?!
scripts.translation: 你是拉扬吗？还是变成别人了？！

scripts.text: You're too late. My master has already departed!
scripts.translation: 太迟了。我的主人已经离开了！

scripts.text: You're too foolish to understand his great will.
scripts.translation: 你们太愚蠢了，无法理解他伟大的意志。

scripts.text: This is the last time you'll ever see me.
scripts.translation: 这是你最后一次见到我了。

scripts.text: I'm kind of busy right now.
..I've brought back the journal and something else..
..Er, sorry. I forgot to bring the journal! I'll be right back.
scripts.translation: ......呃，抱歉。我忘了带日志！我马上回来。

scripts.text: You know, that voice.. Do you think it was Satan Morocc...?
scripts.translation: 你知道，那个声音......你觉得那是魔王梦罗克吗......？

scripts.text: B.ased on what the more normal Rayan has told us,
scripts.translation: 也许吧。根据那个比较清醒的拉扬所说，

scripts.text: it seems that another personality within him was forcibly created by Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation: 似乎是魔王梦罗克强行在他体内制造了另一个人格。

scripts.text: Satan Morocc must have chosen Rayan to break his seal.
scripts.translation: 魔王梦罗克一定是选中了拉扬来打破封印。

scripts.text: He's been controlling Rayan from deep inside his mind..
scripts.translation: 他一直在拉扬内心深处控制着他...

scripts.text: And... That Mad Rayan seems to have a connection with your Bloody Crystal of Darkness.
scripts.translation: 而且...那个疯狂的拉扬似乎与你的黑暗的血色结晶体有某种联系。

scripts.text: I didn't see that side of Rayan until you came; he was very cooperative and feeble up until then.
scripts.translation: 在你来之前，我没见过拉扬的另一面；此前他一直很配合，也很虚弱。

scripts.text: The original Rayan seemed to remember everything that happened while he was controlled by that mad personality..
scripts.translation: 原本的拉扬似乎记得在被那个疯狂人格控制期间发生的一切...

scripts.text: He was in shock after learning that he's killed all his comrades with his own hand.
scripts.translation: 得知自己亲手杀死了所有同伴后，他陷入了震惊。

scripts.text: He started acting differently once you approached him. I must record all of this in the journal.
scripts.translation: 当你靠近他时，他开始变得不一样了。我必须把这些都记录在日志里。

scripts.text: Right. He completely changed once he touched the crystal, as if he himself became Satan Morocc.
scripts.translation: 没错。当他触碰到结晶体后，他完全变了，仿佛他自己变成了魔王梦罗克。

scripts.text: I've marked Rayan's body in case he ran away.
scripts.translation: 我在拉扬身上做了标记，以防他逃跑。

scripts.text: I'll give you the pattern number of his magic wavelength. Can you give the number to Echinacea?
scripts.translation: 我会给你他的魔法波长模式编号。你能把这个编号给紫锥菊吗？

scripts.text: She'll take care of the rest.
Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
scripts.translation: 不要漏掉任何一个字符。好吗？

scripts.text: Here, bring this journal with you.
Please don't forget the pattern number. Alright? Make sure that Echinacea gets it.
scripts.translation: 请别忘了模式编号。好吗？一定要让紫锥菊收到。

scripts.text: Report to Echinacea in the Ash Vacuum, and give her the pattern number.
scripts.translation: 去阿什真空向紫锥菊汇报，并把模式编号给她。

scripts.text: The pattern number is ^4d4dff[SDHF92F-SDF]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
scripts.translation: 模式编号是 [S^4d4dffDHF92F-S^000000DF]。不要漏掉任何一个字符。好吗？

scripts.text: Report to Echinacea in the Ash Vacuum, and give her the pattern number.
scripts.translation: 去阿什真空向紫锥菊汇报，并把模式编号给她。

scripts.text: The pattern number is ^4d4dff[VWNM94GVWN90]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
scripts.translation: 模式编号是 [V^4d4dffWNM94GVW^000000N90]。不要漏掉任何一个字符。好吗？

scripts.text: Report to Echinacea in the Ash Vacuum, and give her the pattern number.
scripts.translation: 去阿什真空向紫锥菊汇报，并把模式编号给她。

scripts.text: The pattern number is ^4d4dff[CM3-TRDFGHE0]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
scripts.translation: 模式编号是 [C^4d4dffM3-TRDFG^000000HE0]。不要漏掉任何一个字符。好吗？

scripts.text: Yes? Why are you back again?
Make sure you don't forget it again. The pattern number is...
scripts.translation: 这次可别再忘了。模式编号是...

scripts.text: ^4d4dff[{0}]^000000. Don't leave out even one character. Okay?
I need to take a break...
Ahhh~ I'm a sick person. I need to rest!
scripts.translation: 啊哈~ 我生病了，需要休息！

scripts.text: I don't want to do anything else~
Hurry up and go, don't bother me~
- For some reason, Rayan is shivering in fear. -
scripts.translation: - 不知为何，拉扬正瑟瑟发抖。 -

scripts.text: He's not being himself for some reason.
scripts.translation: 他不知为何变得不像他自己了。

scripts.text: I'm just glad that he's sane enough to speak to me.
scripts.translation: 还好他神智清醒，还能和我说话。

scripts.text: I don't know what's going on with him.
scripts.translation: 我不知道他到底怎么了。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 携带物品过多时，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: You have found a pile of dirt and deep tracks under thick bushes.
scripts.translation: 你在茂密的灌木丛下发现了一堆泥土和深深的痕迹。

scripts.text: There are deep footprints and spilled blood around the area.
scripts.translation: 周围有深深的脚印和洒落的血迹。

scripts.text: Some desperate fighting definitely happened here.
scripts.translation: 这里显然发生过激烈的战斗。

scripts.text: There are some broken branches to the side of a set of footprints that look like they're skidding backwards...
scripts.translation: 在一串向后滑行的脚印旁，有一些折断的树枝...

scripts.text: Somebody must have been fallen down on the ground, or...
scripts.translation: 有人一定是摔倒在地的，或者...

scripts.text: I've been having a strange feeling around this area...
scripts.translation: 我在这附近一直有种奇怪的感觉...

scripts.text: It feels like faint mana.. ?!... Yes, I can barely see an aura.
scripts.translation: 感觉像是微弱的玛娜...？！...是的，我隐约能看到灵气。

scripts.text: Hmm.. This place must be where Rin fought with Rayan's gang.
scripts.translation: 嗯... 这里应该是琳恩和拉扬的手下战斗的地方。

scripts.text: I don't see anything that looks important.
scripts.translation: 我没看到什么重要的东西。

scripts.text: As you took a careful look,
you notice something shining in the ground.
scripts.translation: 你注意到地面上有东西在闪闪发光。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffYou have found a 'Bloody Crystal of Darkness'.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff你发现了一个“黑暗的血色结晶体^000000”。

scripts.text: I don't think I'll find anything else here...
scripts.translation: 我觉得这里不会再找到其他东西了...

scripts.text: There are traces of a battle here, including spilled blood.
scripts.translation: 这里有战斗的痕迹，包括洒落的血迹。

scripts.text: There's also a pile of dirt that seems out of place.
scripts.translation: 还有一堆看起来格格不入的泥土。

scripts.text: There are traces of a battle here, and spilled blood.
scripts.translation: 这里有战斗的痕迹，以及洒落的血迹。

scripts.text: You find many footprints on the ground.
scripts.translation: 你在地面上发现了许多脚印。

scripts.text: Considering all the blood on the ground, a battle must have occurred here fairly recently.
scripts.translation: 考虑到地上大量的血迹，这里最近一定发生过战斗。

scripts.text: The footprints continue over the hill.
scripts.translation: 脚印一直延伸到山丘那边。

scripts.text: Somebody left a mark under this small tree.
scripts.translation: 有人在这棵小树下面留下了标记。

scripts.text: The mark is weathered and faded,
but it is an arrow pointing southwest.
scripts.translation: 但它是一个指向西南方的箭头。

scripts.text: There's some scribbling on the tree,
but you can't decipher what it means.
scripts.translation: 但你无法辨认出它的含义。

scripts.text: A mysterious force is repelling you, and you're unable to push forward into this area.
scripts.translation: 一股神秘力量排斥着你，让你无法继续深入。

scripts.text: As soon as you touched the crystal,
you feel your body being pulled into the space gap.
scripts.translation: 就感觉身体被拉进了次元裂缝。

scripts.text: You remember Kidd's confused voice, screaming your name.
scripts.translation: 你还记得基德困惑地喊着你的名字。

scripts.text: By the way, where am I?
I can't see things.. I'm getting dizzy...
I can hear a crowd of people coming...
scripts.translation: 我听到人群走来的声音...

scripts.text: Argh! It's too dark to see...!
scripts.translation: 啊！太黑了，什么都看不见...！

scripts.text: Shut up! It's creepy that you all look alike. Bring it on! I'm not afraid of you!
scripts.translation: 闭嘴！你们长得一模一样，真让人毛骨悚然。放马过来，我才不怕你们！

scripts.text: I'm not going to let you run away again!
scripts.translation: 这次我不会再让你们逃掉！

scripts.text: Why? Why is Rin here? Wait, where am I?
scripts.translation: 为什么？琳恩为什么会在这里？等等，我在哪里？

scripts.text: Argh.. I can't move at all...
Hah, how impressive! You run like a rabbit!
scripts.translation: 哈，真了不起！你跑得像只兔子！

scripts.text: I should have you killed you when I had the chance.
scripts.translation: 我早该有机会时就杀了你。

scripts.text: I didn't expect you to be so persistent...
That's what I wanted to say!
You played me like a chess piece,
and now I want to tear you apart in five pieces. Why don't you just shut up and surrender before I kill you?
scripts.translation: 现在我要把你撕成五块。趁我动手杀你之前，乖乖投降吧！

scripts.text: Hah.. You still have no idea, huh? You already lost this game, lady.
scripts.translation: 哈...你还是不明白吗？这场游戏你已经输了，女士。

scripts.text: I'm sorry that I have to do this.
scripts.translation: 很抱歉，我不得不这么做。

scripts.text: You feel helpless: you can do nothing but watch her slowly get overpowered..
scripts.translation: 你感到无能为力，只能眼睁睁看着她渐渐落入下风...

scripts.text: Then, the pressure on your body suddenly dissipates.
scripts.translation: 就在这时，压在你身上的力量突然消散。

scripts.text: - You cannot proceed with the quest when you're carrying too many items with you. -
scripts.translation: - 携带物品过多时，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: You have found a laceration on the dead body;
scripts.translation: 你在尸体上发现一道裂伤；

scripts.text: he must have been killed by Rin.
scripts.translation: 他一定是被琳恩杀死的。

scripts.text: It's creepy to touch a corpse, but you have decided to check his pockets for any clues.
scripts.translation: 摸尸体虽然让人毛骨悚然，但你决定检查他的口袋，看看有没有什么线索。

scripts.text: It's creepy to touch a corpse, but you have decided to shake and turn the body
scripts.translation: 虽然摸尸体很可怕，你还是决定翻动尸体寻找线索。

scripts.text: A scroll flew out of the body's jacket pocket.
scripts.translation: 一张卷轴从尸体的夹克口袋里飞了出来。

scripts.text: You're not sure what this scroll is for, but obviously it seems pretty important.
scripts.translation: 你不确定这张卷轴是做什么用的，但显然它看起来非常重要。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffYou have obtained a Sealed Magic Scroll.
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff你获得了一张封印魔法卷轴。

scripts.text: You have found a Dandelion Member who was killed by Rin.
scripts.translation: 你发现了一名被琳恩杀死的蒲公英成员。

scripts.text: It's just a corpse, but there seems to be something unnatural about it.
scripts.translation: 这只是一具尸体，但似乎有什么不自然的地方。

scripts.text: Now's not the time to examine corpses.
scripts.translation: 现在不是检查尸体的时候。

scripts.text: You better take care of your living enemies first!
scripts.translation: 你最好先处理活着的敌人！

scripts.text: - You find a side door that leads to the basement.
scripts.translation: - 你发现一扇通往地下室的侧门。

scripts.text: A faint light is shining through the hinges.
There are people inside, talking loudly. -

scripts.translation: 我们做了你要求的一切，但是.

scripts.text: We did something that we shouldn't have.
All we wanted was just to shake up the town just a little bit,
scripts.translation: 拉扬！我们只是想让城镇稍微乱一阵子，

scripts.text: not summon Satan Morocc! The ritual failed like we first planned, but...
scripts.translation: 没想召唤魔王梦罗克！仪式像原计划那样失败了，可是...

scripts.text: That's right. It failed, but what happened? Satan Morocc resurrected himself.
scripts.translation: 没错。它失败了，但结果呢？魔王梦罗克复活了。

scripts.text: He'll bring the end of this world.
scripts.translation: 他将带来这个世界的终结。

scripts.text: We can't even go back to our country now!
scripts.translation: 我们现在甚至无法回到自己的国家！

scripts.text: ...We all knew that we would be disposed after we stopped being useful.. Just like pawns in a chess match.
scripts.translation: ...我们都知道，一旦失去利用价值就会被处理掉...就像棋子一样。

scripts.text: What the hell's wrong with you?
Why, can't you still forget the Assassin?
scripts.translation: 怎么，你还忘不了那个刺客吗？

scripts.text: ...Hey, tell us. What should we do now?
Let me ask you one question.
...Did you... Did you really summon Satan Morocc?
scripts.translation: ...你...你真的召唤了魔王梦罗克吗？

scripts.text: Did you really ask us to help you resurrect Satan Morocc?!
scripts.translation: 你真的叫我们帮你复活魔王梦罗克？！

scripts.text: If your silence means yes, I'm out!
scripts.translation: 如果你的沉默意味着是，那我走了！

scripts.text: I didn't know then, but I know now. I'm leaving!
scripts.translation: 我当时不知道，但现在我知道了。我要离开！

scripts.text: Thank you for following my lead so far.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你们一直听从我的指挥。

scripts.text: But you're nothing but puppets of the goddess.. *Giggle Giggle*
scripts.translation: 但你们不过是女神的傀儡罢了。*咯咯笑 咯咯笑*

scripts.text: Hey, hey! What are you doing?!
- You hear loud thuds and thumping in the midst of their yelling and screaming.
scripts.translation: - 在他们的叫喊声中，你听到沉重的撞击声。

scripts.text: It sounds like they're having a serious dispute.-
scripts.translation: 听起来他们正在发生激烈的争执。-

scripts.text: I have no idea what they're talking about. Why are they fighting?
scripts.translation: 我完全不知道他们在说什么。他们为什么在打架？

scripts.text: You're too stupid to understand my master's great will...
scripts.translation: 你们太愚蠢，理解不了主人的伟大意志...

scripts.text: ...Oh, right. I completely forgot about 'it.' It's time to take it back.
scripts.translation: ...哦，对了。我差点忘了“它”。该把它拿回来了。
你们觉得呢？*咯咯笑 咯咯笑*

scripts.text: What the?! Does he know I'm here?!

scripts.translation: - 你使用了一张蝴蝶翅膀。-

scripts.text: - The side to the basement is open.
scripts.translation: - 通往地下室的小门开了。

scripts.text: You can enter if you want. -
You have decided to not enter the basement.
- This door seems to lead to the basement,
scripts.translation: - 这扇门似乎通往地下室，

scripts.text: A man covered in blood is standing at a corner with a mysterious grin.
scripts.translation: 一个浑身是血的男人站在角落里，脸上带着诡异的微笑。

scripts.text: I guess it was the right timing.
By the way, who is this guy?
scripts.translation: 顺便问一下，这家伙是谁？

scripts.text: He looks kind of.. He's insane, isn't he?
scripts.translation: 他看起来有点...他疯了吧？

scripts.text: Woah! Where did you come from?
They're all dead.. I've killed them.
Hehehe, I just followed the will of my master.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿，我只是听从主人的意志。

scripts.text: What? Is this really the Rayan we've been chasing?
scripts.translation: 什么？这真的是我们一直在追捕的拉扬吗？

scripts.text: Right, you said Rayan was having a dispute with his buddies..
scripts.translation: 对了，你说拉扬和同伙起了争执...

scripts.text: ...Ray... Rayan? That's my name? That's right...
Where am I? What's all this blood?!
scripts.translation: 我在哪？这些血是怎么回事？！

scripts.text: ...Huh? Where am I? What happened to my friends?
scripts.translation: ...咦？我在哪？我的朋友们怎么了？

scripts.text: ...I guess I was right. He really is Rayan Moore.
scripts.translation: ...看来我猜对了。他真的是拉扬·摩尔。

scripts.text: He seems... He seems really confused. Maybe even unstable.
scripts.translation: 他看起来...非常困惑，甚至可能精神不稳定。

scripts.text: Well, it's the perfect time to capture this guy before he can kill us.
scripts.translation: 趁他还没杀我们，正好可以抓住他。

scripts.text: Rin will know if this is the real Rayan because I've never seen him without his mask..
scripts.translation: 琳恩能判断他是不是真正的拉扬，因为我从没见过他摘下面具...

scripts.text: I'll bring this guy to Rin so she can interrogate him.
scripts.translation: 我要把这家伙带给琳恩，让她审问他。

scripts.text: I'll see you at the camp.
- You watched Mr. Kidd arrest the unconscious Rayan and take out a teleportation item. You decide to return to town. -
scripts.translation: - 你看着基德先生逮捕了昏迷的拉扬，并拿出了一件瞬间移动道具。你决定返回城镇。 -

scripts.text: I live to serve my master!
scripts.translation: 我活着就是为了侍奉我的主人！

scripts.text: You find a horribly dismembered dead body.
scripts.translation: 你发现一具被肢解得惨不忍睹的尸体。

scripts.text: It is disgusting to decribe the status of the Corpse!.
You find a horribly disfigured corpse.
scripts.translation: 你发现一具面目全非的尸体。

scripts.text: that appears to have been crushed to death.
You find a terribly mutated corpse.
scripts.translation: 你发现了一具变异得可怕的尸体。

scripts.text: You find a terribly mutilated corpse.
scripts.translation: 你发现了一具被残害得可怕的尸体。

scripts.text: You find a horribly disfigured corpse.
scripts.translation: 你发现了一具面目全非的尸体。
